α.shortDef: of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first: --Alpha. Often used (usually , before a vowel) also in composition (as a contraction from ἄνευ) in the sense of privation; so, in many words, beginning with this letter; occasionally in the sense of union (as a contraction of ἅμα).

ἀαρών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אַהֲרוֹן); Aaron, the brother of Moses:--Aaron.

ἀβαδδών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֲבַדּוֹן); a destroying angel:--Abaddon.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and βάρος
ἀβαρής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and βάρος; weightless, i.e. (figuratively) not burdensome:--from being burdensome.

ἀββᾶ.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (אַב); father as a vocative:--Abba.

ἄβελ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (הֶבֶל); Abel, the son of Adam:--Abel.

ἀβιά.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֲבִיָּה); Abijah, the name of two Israelites:--Abia.

ἀβιαθάρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֶבְיָתָר); Abiathar, an Israelite:--Abiathar.

ἀβιληνή.shortDef: of foreign origin (compare אָבֵל); Abilene, a region of Syria:--Abilene.

ἀβιούδ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֲבִיהוּד); Abihud, an Israelite:--Abiud.

ἀβραάμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אַבְרָהָם); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch:--Abraham. (In Acts 7:16 the text should probably read Jacob.)

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a variation of βυθός
ἄβυσσος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a variation of βυθός; depthless, i.e. (specially) (infernal) "abyss":--deep, (bottomless) pit.

ἄγαβος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (compare חָגָב); Agabus, an Israelite:--Agabus.

ἀγαθοεργέω.shortDef: from ἀγαθός and ἔργον; to work good:--do good.

ἀγαθοποιέω.shortDef: from ἀγαθοποιός; to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty):--(when) do good (well).

ἀγαθοποιός.shortDef: from ἀγαθός and ποιέω; a well-doer, i.e. virtuous:--them that do well.

ἀγαθός.shortDef: a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun):--benefit, good(-s, things), well. Compare καλός.

ἀγαθωσύνη.shortDef: from ἀγαθός; goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence:--goodness.

ἀγαλλίασις.shortDef: from ἀγαλλιάω; exultation; specially, welcome:--gladness, (exceeding) joy.

ἀγαλλιάω.shortDef: from agan (much) and ἅλλομαι; properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult:--be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and γάμος
ἄγαμος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and γάμος; unmarried:--unmarried.

ἀγανακτέω.shortDef: from  (much) and  (grief; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant:--be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.

ἀγαπάω.shortDef: perhaps from  (much) (or compare עֲגַב); to love (in a social or moral sense):--(be-)love(-ed). Compare φιλέω.

ἀγάπη.shortDef: from ἀγαπάω; love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast:--(feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love.

ἀγαπητός.shortDef: from ἀγαπάω; beloved:--(dearly, well) beloved, dear.

ἄγαρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (הָגָר); Hagar, the concubine of Abraham:--Hagar.

ἀγγαρεύω.shortDef: of foreign origin (compare אִגְּרָא); properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service:--compel (to go).

ἀγγεῖον.shortDef: from  (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of ἀγκάλη); a receptacle:--vessel.

ἀγγελία.shortDef: from ἄγγελος; an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept:--message.

ἄγγελος.shortDef: from  (probably derived from ἄγω; compare ἀγέλη) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor:--angel, messenger.

ἄγε.shortDef: imperative of ἄγω; properly, lead, i.e. come on:--go to.

glosses: from Α (as negative particle) and γενεαλογέω
ἀγενεαλόγητος.shortDef: from Α (as negative particle) and γενεαλογέω; unregistered as to birth:--without descent.

glosses: from Α (as negative particle) and γένος
ἀγενής.shortDef: from Α (as negative particle) and γένος; properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble:--base things.

ἁγιάζω.shortDef: from ἅγιος; to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate:--hallow, be holy, sanctify.

ἁγιασμός.shortDef: from ἁγιάζω; properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier:--holiness, sanctification.

ἅγιον.shortDef: neuter of ἅγιος; a sacred thing (i.e. spot):--holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.

ἅγιος.shortDef: from  (an awful thing) (compare ἁγνός, θάλπω); sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated):--(most) holy (one, thing), saint.

ἁγιότης.shortDef: from ἅγιος; sanctity (i.e. properly, the state):--holiness.

ἁγιωσύνη.shortDef: from ἅγιος; sacredness (i.e. properly, the quality):--holiness.

ἄγκιστρον.shortDef: from the same as ἀγκάλη; a hook (as bent):--hook.

ἄγκυρα.shortDef: from the same as ἀγκάλη; an "anchor" (as crooked):--anchor.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and the same as γναφεύς
ἄγναφος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and the same as γναφεύς; properly, unfulled, i.e. (by implication) new (cloth):--new.

ἁγνεία.shortDef: from ἁγνός; cleanliness (the quality), i.e. (specially) chastity:--purity.

ἁγνίζω.shortDef: from ἁγνός; to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally):--purify (self).

ἁγνισμός.shortDef: from ἁγνίζω; a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially) lustration:--purification.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and νοιέω
ἀγνοέω.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and νοιέω; not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination):--(be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.

ἀγνόημα.shortDef: from ἀγνοέω; a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming:--error.

ἁγνός.shortDef: from the same as ἅγιος; properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect:--chaste, clean, pure.

ἁγνότης.shortDef: from ἁγνός; cleanness (the state), i.e. (figuratively) blamelessness:--pureness.

ἁγνῶς.shortDef: adverb from ἁγνός; purely, i.e. honestly:--sincerely.

glosses: from Α (as negative particle) and γνῶσις
ἀγνωσία.shortDef: from Α (as negative particle) and γνῶσις; ignorance (properly, the state):--ignorance, not the knowledge.

glosses: from Α (as negative particle) and γνωστός
ἄγνωστος.shortDef: from Α (as negative particle) and γνωστός; unknown:--unknown.

ἀγορά.shortDef: from  (to gather; probably akin to ἐγείρω); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare:--market(-place), street.

ἀγοράζω.shortDef: from ἀγορά; properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem:--buy, redeem.

ἀγοραῖος.shortDef: from ἀγορά; relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar:--baser sort, low.

ἄγρα.shortDef: from ἄγω; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish):--draught.

glosses: from Α (as negative particle) and γράμμα
ἀγράμματος.shortDef: from Α (as negative particle) and γράμμα; unlettered, i.e. illiterate:--unlearned.

glosses: from ἀγρός and αὐλέω (in the sense of αὐλή)
ἀγραυλέω.shortDef: from ἀγρός and αὐλέω (in the sense of αὐλή); to camp out:--abide in the field.

ἀγρεύω.shortDef: from ἄγρα; to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap:--catch.

ἀγριέλαιος.shortDef: from ἄγριος and ἐλαία; an oleaster:--olive tree (which is) wild.

ἄγριος.shortDef: from ἀγρός; wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce):--wild, raging.

ἀγρίππας.shortDef: apparently from ἄγριος and ἵππος; wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods:--Agrippa.

ἀγρός.shortDef: from ἄγω; a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet:--country, farm, piece of ground, land.

glosses: ultimately from Α (as negative particle) and ὕπνος
ἀγρυπνέω.shortDef: ultimately from Α (as negative particle) and ὕπνος; to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake:--watch.

ἀγρυπνία.shortDef: from ἀγρυπνέω; sleeplessness, i.e. a keeping awake:--watch.

ἄγω.shortDef: a primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce:--be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.

ἀγωγή.shortDef: reduplicated from ἄγω; a bringing up, i.e. mode of living:--manner of life.

ἀγών.shortDef: from ἄγω; properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety:--conflict, contention, fight, race.

ἀγωνία.shortDef: from ἀγών; a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish:--agony.

ἀγωνίζομαι.shortDef: from ἀγών; to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something):--fight, labor fervently, strive.

ἀδάμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אָדָם); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative):--Adam.

ἀδάπανος.shortDef: from Α (as negative particle); and δαπάνη; costless, i.e. gratuitous:--without expense.

ἀδδί.shortDef: probably of Hebrew origin (compare עֲדִי); Addi, an Israelite:--Addi.

ἀδελφή.shortDef: feminine of ἀδελφός; a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically):--sister.

glosses: from Α (as a connective particle) and  (the womb)
ἀδελφός.shortDef: from Α (as a connective particle) and  (the womb); a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like Α):--brother.

ἀδελφότης.shortDef: from ἀδελφός; brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity:--brethren, brotherhood.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and δῆλος
ἄδηλος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and δῆλος; hidden, figuratively, indistinct:--appear not, uncertain.

glosses: from a derivative of  (to be sated to loathing)
ἀδημονέω.shortDef: from a derivative of  (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind):--be full of heaviness, be very heavy.

glosses: from Α (as negative particle) and εἴδω
ᾅδης.shortDef: from Α (as negative particle) and εἴδω; properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls:--grave, hell.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διακρίνω
ἀδιάκριτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διακρίνω; properly, undistinguished, i.e. (actively) impartial:--without partiality.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of διά and λείπω
ἀδιάλειπτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of διά and λείπω; unintermitted, i.e. permanent:--without ceasing, continual.

ἀδιαλείπτως.shortDef: adverb from ἀδιάλειπτος; uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion):--without ceasing.

glosses: from a derivative of a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διαφθείρω
ἀδιαφθορία.shortDef: from a derivative of a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of διαφθείρω; incorruptibleness, i.e. (figuratively) purity (of doctrine):--uncorruptness.

ἀδικέω.shortDef: from ἄδικος; to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically):--hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.

ἀδίκημα.shortDef: from ἀδικέω; a wrong done:--evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.

ἀδικία.shortDef: from ἄδικος; (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act):--iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and δίκη
ἄδικος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and δίκη; unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen:--unjust, unrighteous.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and δόκιμος
ἀδόκιμος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and δόκιμος; unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally):--castaway, rejected, reprobate.

ἄδολος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle); and δόλος; undeceitful, i.e. (figuratively) unadulterated:--sincere.

ἀδραμυττηνός.shortDef: from  (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to Adramyttium:--of Adramyttium.

ἀδρίας.shortDef: from  (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian):--Adria.

ἀδυνατέω.shortDef: from ἀδύνατος; to be unable, i.e. (passively) impossible:--be impossible.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and δυνατός
ἀδύνατος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and δυνατός; unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible:--could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak.

glosses: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration)
ἀεί.shortDef: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly:--always, ever.

ἀετός.shortDef: from the same as ἀήρ; an eagle (from its wind-like flight):--eagle.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ζύμη
ἄζυμος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ζύμη; unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week:--unleavened (bread).

ἀζώρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (compare עַזּוּר); Azor, an Israelite:--Azorigin

ἄζωτος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אַשְׁדּוֹד); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine:--Azotus.

ἀήρ.shortDef: from  (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient):--air. Compare ψύχω.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and θάνατος
ἀθανασία.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and θάνατος; deathlessness:--immortality.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of  (statute
ἀθέμιτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of  (statute; from the base of τίθημι); illegal; by implication, flagitious:--abominable, unlawful thing.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and θεός
ἄθεος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and θεός; godless:--without God.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι (in the sense of enacting)
ἄθεσμος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal:--wicked.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι
ἀθετέω.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τίθημι; to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate:--cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject.

ἀθέτησις.shortDef: from ἀθετέω; cancellation (literally or figuratively):--disannulling, put away.

ἀθῆναι.shortDef: plural of  (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); Athenæ, the capitol of Greece:-- Athens.

ἀθηναῖος.shortDef: from Ἀθῆναι; an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ:--Athenian.

glosses: from  (a contest in the public lists)
ἀθλέω.shortDef: from  (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games:--strive.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and θυμός
ἀθυμέω.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and θυμός; to be spiritless, i.e. disheartened:--be dismayed.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of τίθημι (meaning a penalty)
ἄθωος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of τίθημι (meaning a penalty); not guilty:--innocent.

αἴγειος.shortDef: from  (a goat); belonging to a goat:--goat.

glosses: from aisso (to rush) and ἅλς (in the sense of the sea)
αἰγιαλός.shortDef: from aisso (to rush) and ἅλς (in the sense of the sea); a beach (on which the waves dash):--shore.

αἰγύπτιος.shortDef: from Αἴγυπτος; an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus:--Egyptian.

αἴγυπτος.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile:--Egypt.

ἀΐδιος.shortDef: from ἀεί; everduring (forward and backward, or forward only):--eternal, everlasting.

glosses: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and εἴδω (through the idea of downcast eyes)
αἰδώς.shortDef: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and εἴδω (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe:--reverence, shamefacedness.

αἰθίοψ.shortDef: from  (to scorch) and  (the face, from ὀπτάνομαι); an Æthiopian (as a blackamoor):--Ethiopian.

αἷμα.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred:--blood.

glosses: from αἷμα and a derivative of ἐκχέω
αἱματεκχυσία.shortDef: from αἷμα and a derivative of ἐκχέω; an effusion of blood:--shedding of blood.

αἱμοῤῥέω.shortDef: from αἷμα and ῥέω; to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage:--diseased with an issue of blood.

αἰνέας.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Ænĕas, an Israelite:--Æneas.

αἴνεσις.shortDef: from αἰνέω; a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering):--praise.

glosses: from a derivative of αἶνος (in its primary sense)
αἴνιγμα.shortDef: from a derivative of αἶνος (in its primary sense); an obscure saying ("enigma"), i.e. (abstractly) obscureness:--X darkly.

αἶνος.shortDef: apparently a prime word; properly, a story, but used in the sense of ἔπαινος; praise (of God):--praise.

glosses: of Hebrew origin (a derivative of עַיִן
αἰνών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (a derivative of עַיִן, place of springs); Ænon, a place in Palestine:--Ænon.

αἱρέομαι.shortDef: probably akin to αἴρω; to take for oneself, i.e. to prefer:--choose. Some of the forms are borrowed from a cognate  ; which is otherwise obsolete.

αἵρεσις.shortDef: from αἱρέομαι; properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion:--heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect.

αἱρετίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of αἱρέομαι; to make a choice:--choose.

αἱρετικός.shortDef: from the same as αἱρετίζω; a schismatic:--heretic (the Greek word itself).

αἴρω.shortDef: a primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare נָשָׂא) to expiate sin:--away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).

αἰσθάνομαι.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the senses):--perceive.

αἰσθητήριον.shortDef: from a derivative of αἰσθάνομαι; properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment:--senses.

αἰσχροκερδής.shortDef: from αἰσχρός and  (gain); sordid:--given to (greedy of) filthy lucre.

αἰσχροκερδῶς.shortDef: adverb from αἰσχροκερδής; sordidly:--for filthy lucre's sake.

αἰσχρολογία.shortDef: from αἰσχρός and λόγος; vile conversation:--filthy communication.

αἰσχρόν.shortDef: neuter of αἰσχρός; a shameful thing, i.e. indecorum:--shame.

αἰσχρός.shortDef: from the same as αἰσχύνομαι; shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal):--filthy.

αἰσχύνη.shortDef: from αἰσχύνομαι; shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely):--dishonesty, shame.

αἰσχύνομαι.shortDef: from  (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself):--be ashamed.

αἰτέω.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case):--ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require. Compare πυνθάνομαι.

αἴτημα.shortDef: from αἰτέω; a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking:--petition, request, required.

αἰτία.shortDef: from the same as αἰτέω; a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved):--accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).

αἰτίαμα.shortDef: from a derivative of αἰτία; a thing charged:--complaint.

αἴτιον.shortDef: neuter of αἴτιος; a reason or crime (like αἰτία):--cause, fault.

αἴτιος.shortDef: from the same as αἰτέω; causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer:--author.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φαίνω (compare ἐξαίφνης) (meaning non-apparent)
αἰφνίδιος.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φαίνω (compare ἐξαίφνης) (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially) suddenly:--sudden, unawares.

αἰχμαλωτεύω.shortDef: from αἰχμάλωτος; to capture (like αἰχμαλωτίζω):--lead captive.

αἰχμαλωτίζω.shortDef: from αἰχμάλωτος; to make captive:--lead away captive, bring into captivity.

glosses: from  (a spear) and a derivative of the same as ἅλωσις
αἰχμάλωτος.shortDef: from  (a spear) and a derivative of the same as ἅλωσις; properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive:--captive.

αἰών.shortDef: from the same as ἀεί; properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future):--age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end). Compare χρόνος.

αἰώνιος.shortDef: from αἰών; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well):--eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

ἀκαθαρσία.shortDef: from ἀκάθαρτος; impurity (the quality), physically or morally:--uncleanness.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of καθαίρω (meaning cleansed)
ἀκάθαρτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of καθαίρω (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially, (demonic)):--foul, unclean.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and καιρός (meaning unseasonable)
ἀκαιρέομαι.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and καιρός (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion:--lack opportunity.

glosses: adverb from the same as ἀκαιρέομαι
ἀκαίρως.shortDef: adverb from the same as ἀκαιρέομαι; inopportunely:--out of season.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and κακός
ἄκακος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and κακός; not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting:--harmless, simple.

glosses: probably from the same as ἀκμήν
ἄκανθα.shortDef: probably from the same as ἀκμήν; a thorn:--thorn.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and καρπός
ἄκαρπος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and καρπός; barren (literally or figuratively):--without fruit, unfruitful.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταγινώσκω
ἀκατάγνωστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταγινώσκω; unblamable:--that cannot be condemned.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of κατά and καλύπτω
ἀκατακάλυπτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of κατά and καλύπτω; unveiled:--uncovered.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατακρίνω
ἀκατάκριτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατακρίνω; without (legal) trial:--uncondemned.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταλύω
ἀκατάλυτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταλύω; indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent:--endless.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταπαύω
ἀκατάπαυστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καταπαύω; unrefraining:--that cannot cease.

ἀκαταστασία.shortDef: from ἀκατάστατος; instability, i.e. disorder:--commotion, confusion, tumult.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καθίστημι
ἀκατάστατος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of καθίστημι; inconstant:--unstable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατέχω
ἀκατάσχετος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κατέχω; unrestrainable:--unruly.

glosses: of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood
ἀκελδαμά.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to חֵלֶק and דָּם); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem:--Aceldama.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι
ἀκέραιος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι; unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent:--harmless, simple.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and κλίνω
ἀκλινής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and κλίνω; not leaning, i.e. (figuratively) firm:--without wavering.

ἀκμάζω.shortDef: from the same as ἀκμήν; to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature:--be fully ripe.

glosses: accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to  (a point) and meaning the same
ἀκμήν.shortDef: accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to  (a point) and meaning the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still:--yet.

ἀκοή.shortDef: from ἀκούω; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard):--audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.

glosses: from Α (as a particle of union) and  (a road)
ἀκολουθέω.shortDef: from Α (as a particle of union) and  (a road); properly, to be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a disciple):--follow, reach.

ἀκούω.shortDef: a primary verb; to hear (in various senses):--give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand.

ἀκρασία.shortDef: from ἀκρατής; want of self-restraint:--excess, incontinency.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and κράτος
ἀκρατής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and κράτος; powerless, i.e. without self-control:--incontinent.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι
ἄκρατος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of κεράννυμι; undiluted:--without mixture.

ἀκρίβεια.shortDef: from the same as ἀκριβέστατος; exactness:--perfect manner.

glosses: superlative of  (a derivative of the same as ἄκρον)
ἀκριβέστατος.shortDef: superlative of  (a derivative of the same as ἄκρον); most exact:--most straitest.

glosses: neuter of the comparative of the same as ἀκριβέστατος
ἀκριβέστερον.shortDef: neuter of the comparative of the same as ἀκριβέστατος; (adverbially) more exactly:--more perfect(-ly).

ἀκριβόω.shortDef: from the same as ἀκριβέστατος; to be exact, i.e. ascertain:--enquire diligently.

glosses: adverb from the same as ἀκριβέστατος
ἀκριβῶς.shortDef: adverb from the same as ἀκριβέστατος; exactly:--circumspectly, diligently, perfect(-ly).

glosses: apparently from the same as ἄκρον
ἀκρίς.shortDef: apparently from the same as ἄκρον; a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation):--locust.

ἀκροατήριον.shortDef: from ἀκροατής; an audience-room:--place of hearing.

ἀκροατής.shortDef: from  (to listen; apparently an intensive of ἀκούω); a hearer (merely):--hearer.

glosses: from ἄκρον and probably a modified form of  (the penis or male sexual organ)
ἀκροβυστία.shortDef: from ἄκρον and probably a modified form of  (the penis or male sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person:--not circumcised, uncircumcised (with ἔχω), uncircumcision.

ἀκρογωνιαῖος.shortDef: from ἄκρον and γωνία; belonging to the extreme corner:--chief corner.

ἀκροθίνιον.shortDef: from ἄκρον and  (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty:--spoils.

glosses: neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of ἀκμήν
ἄκρον.shortDef: neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of ἀκμήν; the extremity:--one end… other, tip, top, uttermost participle

ἀκύλας.shortDef: probably for Latin aquila (an eagle); Akulas, an Israelite:--Aquila.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and κυρόω
ἀκυρόω.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and κυρόω; to invalidate:--disannul, make of none effect.

glosses: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κωλύω
ἀκωλύτως.shortDef: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κωλύω; in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely:--no man forbidding him.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἑκών
ἄκων.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἑκών; unwilling:--against the will.

ἀλάβαστρον.shortDef: neuter of  (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone; properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material):--(alabaster) box.

ἀλαζονεία.shortDef: from ἀλαζών; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) self-confidence:--boasting, pride.

ἀλαλάζω.shortDef: from  ( a shout, "halloo"); to vociferate, i.e. (by implication) to wail; figuratively, to clang:--tinkle, wail.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of λαλέω
ἀλάλητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of λαλέω; unspeakable:--unutterable, which cannot be uttered.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and λαλέω
ἄλαλος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and λαλέω; mute:--dumb.

glosses: from Α (as particle of union) and the base of λιπαρός
ἀλείφω.shortDef: from Α (as particle of union) and the base of λιπαρός; to oil (with perfume):--anoint.

ἀλεκτοροφωνία.shortDef: from ἀλέκτωρ and φωνή; cock-crow, i.e. the third night-watch:--cockcrowing.

ἀλέκτωρ.shortDef: from  (to ward off); a cock or male fowl:--cock.

ἀλεξανδρεύς.shortDef: from  (the city so called); an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria:--of Alexandria, Alexandrian.

ἀλεξανδρῖνος.shortDef: from the same as Ἀλεξανδρεύς; Alexandrine, or belonging to Alexandria:--of Alexandria.

glosses: from the same as (the first part of) ἀλέκτωρ and ἀνήρ
ἀλέξανδρος.shortDef: from the same as (the first part of) ἀλέκτωρ and ἀνήρ; man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man:--Alexander.

ἀλήθεια.shortDef: from ἀληθής; truth:--true, X truly, truth, verity.

ἀληθεύω.shortDef: from ἀληθής; to be true (in doctrine and profession):--speak (tell) the truth.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and λανθάνω
ἀληθής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and λανθάνω; true (as not concealing):--true, truly, truth.

ἀλήθω.shortDef: from the same as ἄλευρον; to grind:--grind.

ἀληθῶς.shortDef: adverb from ἀληθής; truly:--indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very.

ἁλιεύς.shortDef: from ἅλς; a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher:--fisher(-man).

ἁλιεύω.shortDef: from ἁλιεύς; to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish:--go a-fishing.

ἀλλά.shortDef: neuter plural of ἄλλος; properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations):--and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.

ἀλλαχόθεν.shortDef: from ἄλλος; from elsewhere:--some other way.

ἀλληγορέω.shortDef: from ἄλλος and  (to harangue (compare ἀγορά)); to allegorize:--be an allegory (the Greek word itself).

glosses: of Hebrew origin (imperative of הָלַל and יָהּ)
ἀλληλουϊα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (imperative of הָלַל and יָהּ); praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation:--alleluiah.

ἀλλήλων.shortDef: Genitive plural from ἄλλος reduplicated; one another:--each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-)selves, (selves) together (sometimes with μετά or πρός).

ἀλλογενής.shortDef: from ἄλλος and γένος; foreign, i.e. not a Jew:--stranger.

glosses: middle voice of apparently a primary verb
ἅλλομαι.shortDef: middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to jump; figuratively, to gush:--leap, spring up.

ἄλλος.shortDef: a primary word; "else," i.e. different (in many applications):--more, one (another), (an-, some an-)other(-s, -wise).

ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος.shortDef: from ἀλλότριος and ἐπίσκοπος; overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs):--busybody in other men's matters.

ἀλλότριος.shortDef: from ἄλλος; another's, i.e. not one's own; by extension foreign, not akin, hostile:--alien, (an-)other (man's, men's), strange(-r).

ἀλλόφυλος.shortDef: from ἄλλος and φυλή; foreign, i.e. (specially) Gentile:--one of another nation.

ἀλοάω.shortDef: from the same as ἅλων; to tread out grain:--thresh, tread out the corn.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and λόγος
ἄλογος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and λόγος; irrational:--brute, unreasonable.

ἀλόη.shortDef: of foreign origin (compare ἀκάνθινος); aloes (the gum):--aloes.

glosses: comparative of a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and λύπη
ἀλυπότερος.shortDef: comparative of a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and λύπη; more without grief:--less sorrowful.

ἅλυσις.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle:--bonds, chain.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of λυσιτελεῖ
ἀλυσιτελής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of λυσιτελεῖ; gainless, i.e. (by implication) pernicious:--unprofitable.

ἀλφαῖος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (compare חֶלֶף); Alphæus, an Israelite:--Alpheus.

glosses: probably from the base of εἱλίσσω
ἅλων.shortDef: probably from the base of εἱλίσσω; a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed):--floor.

ἀλώπηξ.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a fox, i.e. (figuratively) a cunning person:--fox.

glosses: from a collateral form of αἱρέομαι
ἅλωσις.shortDef: from a collateral form of αἱρέομαι; capture, be taken.

ἅμα.shortDef: a primary particle; properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association:--also, and, together, with(-al).

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and μανθάνω
ἀμαθής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and μανθάνω; ignorant:--unlearned.

ἀμαράντινος.shortDef: from ἀμάραντος; "amaranthine", i.e. (by implication) fadeless:--that fadeth not away.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μαραίνω
ἀμάραντος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μαραίνω; unfading, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--that fadeth not away.

glosses: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of μέρος
ἁμαρτάνω.shortDef: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of μέρος; properly, to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), i.e. (figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin:--for your faults, offend, sin, trespass.

ἁμαρτία.shortDef: from ἁμαρτάνω; a sin (properly abstract):--offence, sin(-ful).

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a form of μάρτυς
ἀμάρτυρος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a form of μάρτυς; unattested:--without witness.

ἁμαρτωλός.shortDef: from ἁμαρτάνω; sinful, i.e. a sinner:--sinful, sinner.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and μάχη
ἄμαχος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and μάχη; peaceable:--not a brawler.

ἀμάω.shortDef: from ἅμα; properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap:--reap down.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μεθύω
ἀμέθυστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μεθύω; the "amethyst" (supposed to prevent intoxication):--amethyst.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέλω
ἀμελέω.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέλω; to be careless of:--make light of, neglect, be negligent, no regard.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μέμφομαι
ἄμεμπτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μέμφομαι; irreproachable:--blameless, faultless, unblamable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέριμνα
ἀμέριμνος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέριμνα; not anxious:--without care(-fulness), secure.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετατίθημι
ἀμετάθετος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετατίθημι; unchangeable, or (neuter as abstract) unchangeability:--immutable(-ility).

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετακινέω
ἀμετακίνητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετακινέω; immovable:--unmovable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μεταμέλλομαι
ἀμεταμέλητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μεταμέλλομαι; irrevocable:--without repentance, not to be repented of.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μετανοέω
ἀμετανόητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μετανοέω; unrepentant:--impenitent.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέτρον
ἄμετρος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέτρον; immoderate:--(thing) without measure.

ἀμήν.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אָמֵן); properly, firm, i.e. (figuratively) trustworthy; adverbially, surely (often as interjection, so be it):--amen, verily.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and μήτηρ
ἀμήτωρ.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and μήτηρ; motherless, i.e. of unknown maternity:--without mother.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μιαίνω
ἀμίαντος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μιαίνω; unsoiled, i.e. (figuratively) pure:--undefiled.

ἀμιναδάβ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עַמִּינָדָב); Aminadab, an Israelite:--Aminadab.

ἄμμος.shortDef: perhaps from ἅμα; sand (as heaped on the beach):--sand.

ἀμνός.shortDef: apparently a primary word; a lamb:--lamb.

glosses: probably from the base of ἀμφότερος and that of ἅλων
ἄμπελος.shortDef: probably from the base of ἀμφότερος and that of ἅλων; a vine (as coiling about a support):--vine.

ἀμπελουργός.shortDef: from ἄμπελος and ἔργον; a vine-worker, i.e. pruner:--vine-dresser.

ἀμπλίας.shortDef: contracted for Latin ampliatus (enlarged); Amplias, a Roman Christian:--Amplias.

glosses: middle voice of a primary verb
ἀμύνομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a primary verb; to ward off (for oneself), i.e. protect:--defend.

glosses: from a compound of the base of ἀμφότερος and βάλλω
ἀμφίβληστρον.shortDef: from a compound of the base of ἀμφότερος and βάλλω; a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish):--net.

glosses: from the base of ἀμφότερος and  (to invest)
ἀμφιέννυμι.shortDef: from the base of ἀμφότερος and  (to invest); to enrobe:--clothe.

glosses: from the base of ἀμφότερος and πόλις
ἀμφίπολις.shortDef: from the base of ἀμφότερος and πόλις; a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia:--Amphipolis.

glosses: from the base of ἀμφότερος and ὁδός
ἄμφοδον.shortDef: from the base of ἀμφότερος and ὁδός; a fork in the road:--where two ways meet.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μωμάομαι
ἀμώμητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μωμάομαι; unblamable:--blameless.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and μῶμος
ἄμωμος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and μῶμος; unblemished (literally or figuratively):--without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblamable.

ἀμών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אָמוֹן); Amon, an Israelite:--Amon.

ἀμώς.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אָמוֹץ); Amos, an Israelite:--Amos.

ἄν.shortDef: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty:--(what-, where-, wither-, who-)soever. Usually unexpressed except by the subjunctive or potential mood. Also contracted for ἐάν.

ἀνά.shortDef: a primary preposition and adverb; properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.):--and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through. In compounds (as a prefix) it often means (by implication) repetition, intensity, reversal, etc.

glosses: from ἀνά and the base of βάσις
ἀναβαίνω.shortDef: from ἀνά and the base of βάσις; to go up (literally or figuratively):--arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up).

glosses: middle voice from ἀνά and βάλλω
ἀναβάλλομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀνά and βάλλω; to put off (for oneself):--defer.

glosses: from ἀνά and a derivative of the base of βάσις
ἀναβιβάζω.shortDef: from ἀνά and a derivative of the base of βάσις; to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net):--draw.

ἀναβλέπω.shortDef: from ἀνά and βλέπω; to look up; by implication, to recover sight:--look (up), see, receive sight.

ἀνάβλεψις.shortDef: from ἀναβλέπω; restoration of sight:--recovery of sight.

ἀναβοάω.shortDef: from ἀνά and βοάω; to halloo:--cry (aloud, out).

glosses: from ἀνά and the base of ἄγγελος
ἀναγγέλλω.shortDef: from ἀνά and the base of ἄγγελος; to announce (in detail):--declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell.

ἀναγεννάω.shortDef: from ἀνά and γεννάω; to beget or (by extension) bear (again):--beget, (bear) X (again).

ἀναγινώσκω.shortDef: from ἀνά and γινώσκω; to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read:--read.

ἀναγκαῖος.shortDef: from ἀνάγκη; necessary; by implication, close (of kin):--near, necessary, necessity, needful.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of ἀναγκάζω
ἀναγκαστῶς.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of ἀναγκάζω; compulsorily:--by constraint.

glosses: from ἀνά and the base of ἀγκάλη
ἀνάγκη.shortDef: from ἀνά and the base of ἀγκάλη; constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress:--distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful.

glosses: middle voice from ἀνά and γνωρίζω
ἀναγνωρίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀνά and γνωρίζω; to make (oneself) known:--be made known.

ἀνάγω.shortDef: from ἀνά and ἄγω; to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away:--bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up.

ἀναδείκνυμι.shortDef: from ἀνά and δεικνύω; to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint:--appoint, shew.

ἀναδέχομαι.shortDef: from ἀνά and δέχομαι; to entertain (as a guest):--receive.

ἀναδίδωμι.shortDef: from ἀνά and δίδωμι; to hand over:--deliver.

ἀναζάω.shortDef: from ἀνά and ζάω; to recover life (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)live again, revive.

ἀναζητέω.shortDef: from ἀνά and ζητέω; to search out:--seek.

ἀναζώννυμι.shortDef: from ἀνά and ζώννυμι; to gird afresh:--gird up.

glosses: from ἀνά and a compound of the base of ζῶον and πῦρ
ἀναζωπυρέω.shortDef: from ἀνά and a compound of the base of ζῶον and πῦρ; to re-enkindle:--stir up.

ἀναθάλλω.shortDef: from ἀνά and  (to flourish); to revive:--flourish again.

ἀνάθεμα.shortDef: from ἀνατίθεμαι; a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person):--accused, anathema, curse, X great.

ἀναθεματίζω.shortDef: from ἀνάθεμα; to declare or vow under penalty of execration:--(bind under a) curse, bind with an oath.

ἀναθεωρέω.shortDef: from ἀνά and θεωρέω; to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively):--behold, consider.

ἀνάθημα.shortDef: from ἀνατίθεμαι (like ἀνάθεμα, but in a good sense); a votive offering:--gift.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle (compare ἄνευ)) and αἰδώς
ἀναίδεια.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle (compare ἄνευ)) and αἰδώς; impudence, i.e. (by implication) importunity:--importunity.

glosses: from ἀνά and (the active of) αἱρέομαι
ἀναιρέω.shortDef: from ἀνά and (the active of) αἱρέομαι; to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder:--put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and αἴτιος (in the sense of αἰτία)
ἀναίτιος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and αἴτιος (in the sense of αἰτία); innocent:--blameless, guiltless.

ἀνακαθίζω.shortDef: from ἀνά and καθίζω; properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up:--sit up.

glosses: from ἀνά and a derivative of καινός
ἀνακαινίζω.shortDef: from ἀνά and a derivative of καινός; to restore:--renew.

glosses: from ἀνά and a derivative of καινός
ἀνακαινόω.shortDef: from ἀνά and a derivative of καινός; to renovate:--renew.

glosses: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and καλύπτω
ἀνακαλύπτω.shortDef: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and καλύπτω; to unveil:--open, (un-)taken away.

ἀνακάμπτω.shortDef: from ἀνά and κάμπτω; to turn back:--(re-)turn.

ἀνακεῖμαι.shortDef: from ἀνά and κεῖμαι; to recline (as a corpse or at a meal):--guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table.

glosses: from ἀνά and κεφαλαιόω (in its original sense)
ἀνακεφαλαίομαι.shortDef: from ἀνά and κεφαλαιόω (in its original sense); to sum up:--briefly comprehend, gather together in one.

ἀνακλίνω.shortDef: from ἀνά and κλίνω; to lean back:--lay, (make) sit down.

ἀνακόπτω.shortDef: from ἀνά and κόπτω; to beat back, i.e. check:--hinder.

ἀνακράζω.shortDef: from ἀνά and κράζω; to scream up (aloud):--cry out.

ἀνακρίνω.shortDef: from ἀνά and κρίνω; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine:--ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search.

glosses: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and κύπτω
ἀνακύπτω.shortDef: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and κύπτω; to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated:--lift up, look up.

ἀναλαμβάνω.shortDef: from ἀνά and λαμβάνω; to take up:--receive up, take (in, unto, up).

glosses: from ἀνά and a form of the alternate of αἱρέομαι
ἀναλίσκω.shortDef: from ἀνά and a form of the alternate of αἱρέομαι; properly, to use up, i.e. destroy:--consume.

glosses: from a compound of ἀνά and λόγος
ἀναλογία.shortDef: from a compound of ἀνά and λόγος; proportion:--proportion.

ἀναλογίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀναλογία; to estimate, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate:--consider.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἅλς
ἄναλος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἅλς; saltless, i.e. insipid:--X lose saltness.

ἀναλύω.shortDef: from ἀνά and λύω; to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively):--depart, return.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἁμαρτάνω
ἀναμάρτητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἁμαρτάνω; sinless:--that is without sin.

ἀναμένω.shortDef: from ἀνά and μένω; to await:--wait for.

ἀναμιμνήσκω.shortDef: from ἀνά and μιμνήσκω; to remind; (reflexively) to recollect:--call to mind, (bring to , call to, put in), remember(-brance).

glosses: from ἀνά and a derivative of νέος
ἀνανεόω.shortDef: from ἀνά and a derivative of νέος; to renovate, i.e. reform:--renew.

ἀνανήφω.shortDef: from ἀνά and νήφω; to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses:--recover self.

ἀνανίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חֲנַנְיָה); Ananias, the name of three Israelites:--Ananias.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἀντί and ῥέω
ἀναντίῤῥητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἀντί and ῥέω; indisputable:--cannot be spoken against.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἄξιος
ἀνάξιος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἄξιος; unfit:--unworthy.

ἀνάπαυσις.shortDef: from ἀναπαύω; intermission; by implication, recreation:--rest.

ἀναπαύω.shortDef: from ἀνά and παύω; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh:--take ease, refresh, (give, take) rest.

ἀναπείθω.shortDef: from ἀνά and πείθω; to incite:--persuade.

ἀναπέμπω.shortDef: from ἀνά and πέμπω; to send up or back:--send (again).

glosses: from ἀνά (in the sense of intensity) and  (maimed)
ἀνάπηρος.shortDef: from ἀνά (in the sense of intensity) and  (maimed); crippled:--maimed.

ἀναπίπτω.shortDef: from ἀνά and πίπτω; to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back:--lean, sit down (to meat).

ἀναπληρόω.shortDef: from ἀνά and πληρόω; to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience):--fill up, fulfill, occupy, supply.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἀπολογέομαι
ἀναπολόγητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἀπολογέομαι; indefensible:--without an excuse, inexcusable.

glosses: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and πτύσσω
ἀναπτύσσω.shortDef: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and πτύσσω; to unroll (a scroll or volume):--open.

ἀνάπτω.shortDef: from ἀνά and ἅπτω; to enkindle:--kindle, light.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἀριθμέω
ἀναρίθμητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἀριθμέω; unnumbered, i.e. without number:--innumerable.

ἀνασείω.shortDef: from ἀνά and σείω; figuratively, to excite:--move, stir up.

glosses: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of σκεῦος
ἀνασκευάζω.shortDef: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of σκεῦος; properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset:--subvert.

ἀνασπάω.shortDef: from ἀνά and σπάω; to take up or extricate:--draw up, pull out.

ἀνάστασις.shortDef: from ἀνίστημι; a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth):--raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.

glosses: from a derivative of ἀνίστημι (in the sense of removal)
ἀναστατόω.shortDef: from a derivative of ἀνίστημι (in the sense of removal); properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively):--trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.

ἀνασταυρόω.shortDef: from ἀνά and σταυρόω; to recrucify (figuratively):--crucify afresh.

ἀναστενάζω.shortDef: from ἀνά and στενάζω; to sigh deeply:--sigh deeply.

ἀναστρέφω.shortDef: from ἀνά and στρέφω; to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live:--abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.

glosses: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τάσσω
ἀνατάσσομαι.shortDef: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τάσσω; to arrange:--set in order.

glosses: from ἀνά and the base of τέλος
ἀνατέλλω.shortDef: from ἀνά and the base of τέλος; to (cause to) arise:--(a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.

glosses: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τίθημι
ἀνατίθεμαι.shortDef: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τίθημι; to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound:--communicate, declare.

ἀνατολή.shortDef: from ἀνατέλλω; a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural):--dayspring, east, rising.

glosses: from ἀνά and the base of τροπή
ἀνατρέπω.shortDef: from ἀνά and the base of τροπή; to overturn (figuratively):--overthrow, subvert.

ἀνατρέφω.shortDef: from ἀνά and τρέφω; to rear (physically or mentally):--bring up, nourish (up).

ἀναφαίνω.shortDef: from ἀνά and φαίνω; to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out:--(should) appear, discover.

ἀναφέρω.shortDef: from ἀνά and φέρω; to take up (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).

ἀναφωνέω.shortDef: from ἀνά and φωνέω; to exclaim:--speak out.

glosses: from a comparative of ἀνά and  (to pour)
ἀνάχυσις.shortDef: from a comparative of ἀνά and  (to pour); properly, effusion, i.e. (figuratively) license:--excess.

ἀναχωρέω.shortDef: from ἀνά and χωρέω; to retire:--depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self.

ἀνάψυξις.shortDef: from ἀναψύχω; properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively) revival:--revival.

ἀναψύχω.shortDef: from ἀνά and ψύχω; properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve:--refresh.

glosses: from a derivative of a compound of ἀνήρ and πούς
ἀνδραποδιστής.shortDef: from a derivative of a compound of ἀνήρ and πούς; an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet):--menstealer.

ἀνδρέας.shortDef: from ἀνήρ; manly; Andreas, an Israelite:--Andrew.

ἀνδρίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀνήρ; to act manly:--quit like men.

ἀνδρόνικος.shortDef: from ἀνήρ and νῖκος; man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite:--Adronicus.

ἀνδροφόνος.shortDef: from ἀνήρ and φόνος; a murderer:--manslayer.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἐγκαλέω
ἀνέγκλητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἐγκαλέω; unaccused, i.e. (by implication) irreproachable:--blameless.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκδιηγέομαι
ἀνεκδιήγητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκδιηγέομαι; not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable:--unspeakable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκλαλέω
ἀνεκλάλητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκλαλέω; not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable:--unspeakable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκλείπω
ἀνέκλειπτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐκλείπω; not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible:--that faileth not.

glosses: comparative of a derivative of ἀνέχομαι
ἀνεκτότερος.shortDef: comparative of a derivative of ἀνέχομαι; more endurable:--more tolerable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἐλεήμων
ἀνελεήμων.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἐλεήμων; merciless:--unmerciful.

ἀνεμίζω.shortDef: from ἄνεμος; to toss with the wind:--drive with the wind.

ἄνεμος.shortDef: from the base of ἀήρ; wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth):--wind.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as ἐνδέχεται
ἀνένδεκτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as ἐνδέχεται; unadmitted, i.e. (by implication) not supposable:--impossible.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐξερευνάω
ἀνεξερεύνητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἐξερευνάω; not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable:--unsearchable.

ἀνεξίκακος.shortDef: from ἀνέχομαι and κακός; enduring of ill, i.e. forbearing:--patient.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐκ and a derivative of ἴχνος
ἀνεξιχνίαστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐκ and a derivative of ἴχνος; not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable:--past finding out; unsearchable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐπί and αἰσχύνομαι
ἀνεπαίσχυντος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἐπί and αἰσχύνομαι; not ashamed, i.e. irreprehensible: --that needeth not to be ashamed.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἐπιλαμβάνομαι
ἀνεπίληπτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἐπιλαμβάνομαι; not arrested, i.e. (by implication) inculpable:--blameless, unrebukeable.

ἀνέρχομαι.shortDef: from ἀνά and ἔρχομαι; to ascend:--go up.

ἄνεσις.shortDef: from ἀνίημι; relaxation or (figuratively) relief:--eased, liberty, rest.

ἀνετάζω.shortDef: from ἀνά and  (to test); to investigate (judicially):--(should have) examined(-d).

ἄνευ.shortDef: a primary particle; without:--without. Compare Α.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and εὔθετος
ἀνεύθετος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and εὔθετος; not well set, i.e. inconvenient:--not commodious.

ἀνευρίσκω.shortDef: from ἀνά and εὑρίσκω; to find out:--find.

glosses: middle voice from ἀνά and ἔχω
ἀνέχομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀνά and ἔχω; to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with:--bear with, endure, forbear, suffer.

glosses: from Α (as a particle of union) and an obsolete  (a brood)
ἀνεψιός.shortDef: from Α (as a particle of union) and an obsolete  (a brood); properly, akin, i.e. (specially) a cousin:--sister's son.

ἀνήκω.shortDef: from ἀνά and ἥκω; to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper:--convenient, be fit.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and  (lame)
ἀνήμερος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and  (lame); savage:--fierce.

ἀνήρ.shortDef: a primary word (compare ἄνθρωπος); a man (properly as an individual male):--fellow, husband, man, sir.

ἀνθίστημι.shortDef: from ἀντί and ἵστημι; to stand against, i.e. oppose:--resist, withstand.

glosses: from ἀντί and the middle voice of ὁμολογέω
ἀνθομολογέομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and the middle voice of ὁμολογέω; to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise:--give thanks.

ἀνθρακιά.shortDef: from ἄνθραξ; a bed of burning coals:--fire of coals.

ἄνθραξ.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a live coal:--coal of fire.

ἀνθρωπάρεσκος.shortDef: from ἄνθρωπος and ἀρέσκω; man-courting, i.e. fawning:--men-pleaser.

ἀνθρώπινος.shortDef: from ἄνθρωπος; human:--human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men.

ἀνθρωποκτόνος.shortDef: from ἄνθρωπος and (to kill); a manslayer:--murderer. Compare φονεύς.

ἄνθρωπος.shortDef: from ἀνήρ and  (the countenance; from ὀπτάνομαι); man-faced, i.e. a human being:--certain, man.

ἀνθυπατεύω.shortDef: from ἀνθύπατος; to act as proconsul:--be the deputy.

glosses: from ἀντί and a superlative of ὑπέρ
ἀνθύπατος.shortDef: from ἀντί and a superlative of ὑπέρ; instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul:--deputy.

ἀνίημι.shortDef: from ἀνά and  (to send); to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from:--forbear, leave, loose.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἵλεως
ἀνίλεως.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἵλεως; inexorable:--without mercy.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of νίπτω
ἄνιπτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of νίπτω; without ablution:--unwashen.

ἀνίστημι.shortDef: from ἀνά and ἵστημι; to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive):--arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right).

ἄννα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חַנָּה); Anna, an Israelitess:--Anna.

ἄννας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חֲנַנְיָה); Annas (i.e. Ἀνανίας), an Israelite:--Annas.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of νοιέω
ἀνόητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of νοιέω; unintelligent; by implication, sensual:--fool(-ish), unwise.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and νοῦς
ἄνοια.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and νοῦς; stupidity; by implication, rage:--folly, madness.

ἀνοίγω.shortDef: from ἀνά and  (to open); to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications):--open.

ἀνοικοδομέω.shortDef: from ἀνά and οἰκοδομέω; to rebuild:--build again.

ἀνομία.shortDef: from ἄνομος; illegality, i.e. violation of law or (genitive case) wickedness:--iniquity, X transgress(-ion of) the law, unrighteousness.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and νόμος
ἄνομος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and νόμος; lawless, i.e. (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication, a Gentile), or (positively) wicked:--without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked.

ἀνόμως.shortDef: adverb from ἄνομος; lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law:--without law.

glosses: from ἀνά and a derivative of the base of ὀρθός
ἀνορθόω.shortDef: from ἀνά and a derivative of the base of ὀρθός; to straighten up:--lift (set) up, make straight.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὅσιος
ἀνόσιος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὅσιος; wicked:--unholy.

ἀνταγωνίζομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and ἀγωνίζομαι; to struggle against (figuratively) ("antagonize"):--strive against.

glosses: from a compound of ἀντί and ἀλλάσσω
ἀντάλλαγμα.shortDef: from a compound of ἀντί and ἀλλάσσω; an equivalent or ransom:--in exchange.

ἀνταναπληρόω.shortDef: from ἀντί and ἀναπληρόω; to supplement:--fill up.

ἀνταποδίδωμι.shortDef: from ἀντί and ἀποδίδωμι; to requite (good or evil):--recompense, render, repay.

ἀνταπόδομα.shortDef: from ἀνταποδίδωμι; a requital (properly, the thing):--recompense.

ἀνταποκρίνομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and ἀποκρίνομαι; to contradict or dispute:--answer again, reply against.

ἀντέπω.shortDef: from ἀντί and ἔπω; to refute or deny:--gainsay, say against.

glosses: from ἀντί and the middle voice of ἔχω
ἀντέχομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and the middle voice of ἔχω; to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for:--hold fast, hold to, support.

ἀντί.shortDef: a primary particle; opposite, i.e. instead or because of (rarely in addition to):--for, in the room of. Often used in composition to denote contrast, requital, substitution, correspondence, etc.

ἀντιβάλλω.shortDef: from ἀντί and βάλλω; to bandy:--have.

ἀντιδιατίθεμαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and διατίθεμαι; to set oneself opposite, i.e. be  disputatious:--that oppose themselves.

ἀντίδικος.shortDef: from ἀντί and δίκη; an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy):--adversary.

glosses: from a compound of ἀντί and τίθημι
ἀντίθεσις.shortDef: from a compound of ἀντί and τίθημι; opposition, i.e. a conflict (of theories):--opposition.

ἀντικαθίστημι.shortDef: from ἀντί and καθίστημι; to set down (troops) against, i.e. withstand:--resist.

ἀντικαλέω.shortDef: from ἀντί and καλέω; to invite in return:--bid again.

ἀντίκειμαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and κεῖμαι; to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to:--adversary, be contrary, oppose.

glosses: from ἀντί and the middle voice of λαμβάνω
ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and the middle voice of λαμβάνω; to take hold of in turn, i.e. succor; also to participate:--help, partaker, support.

ἀντιλέγω.shortDef: from ἀντί and λέγω; to dispute, refuse:--answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against.

ἀντιλογία.shortDef: from a derivative of ἀντιλέγω; dispute, disobedience:--contradiction, gainsaying, strife.

ἀντιλοιδορέω.shortDef: from ἀντί and λοιδορέω; to rail in reply:--revile again.

ἀντίλυτρον.shortDef: from ἀντί and λύτρον; a redemption-price:--ransom.

ἀντιμετρέω.shortDef: from ἀντί and μετρέω; to mete in return:--measure again.

glosses: from a compound of ἀντί and μισθός
ἀντιμισθία.shortDef: from a compound of ἀντί and μισθός; requital, correspondence:--recompense.

ἀντιόχεια.shortDef: from  (a Syrian king); Antiochia, a place in Syria:--Antioch.

ἀντιοχεύς.shortDef: from Ἀντιόχεια; an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia:--of Antioch.

ἀντιπαρέρχομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and παρέρχομαι; to go along opposite:--pass by on the other side.

glosses: contracted for a compound of ἀντί and a derivative of πατήρ
ἀντίπας.shortDef: contracted for a compound of ἀντί and a derivative of πατήρ; Antipas, a Christian:--Antipas.

ἀντιπατρίς.shortDef: from the same as Ἀντίπας; Antipatris, a place in Palestine:--Antipatris.

ἀντιπέραν.shortDef: from ἀντί and πέραν; on the opposite side:--over against.

glosses: from ἀντί and πίπτω (including its alternate)
ἀντιπίπτω.shortDef: from ἀντί and πίπτω (including its alternate); to oppose:--resist.

ἀντιστρατεύομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and στρατεύομαι; (figuratively) to attack, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--war against.

glosses: from ἀντί and the middle voice of τάσσω
ἀντιτάσσομαι.shortDef: from ἀντί and the middle voice of τάσσω; to range oneself against, i.e. oppose:--oppose themselves, resist.

glosses: neuter of a compound of ἀντί and τύπος
ἀντίτυπον.shortDef: neuter of a compound of ἀντί and τύπος; corresponding ("antitype"), i.e. a representative, counterpart:--(like) figure (whereunto).

ἀντίχριστος.shortDef: from ἀντί and Χριστός; an opponent of the Messiah:--antichrist.

ἀντλέω.shortDef: from  (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.):--draw (out).

ἄντλημα.shortDef: from ἀντλέω; a baling-vessel:--thing to draw with.

glosses: from a compound of ἀντί and ὀφθαλμός
ἀντοφθαλμέω.shortDef: from a compound of ἀντί and ὀφθαλμός; to face:--bear up into.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὕδωρ
ἄνυδρος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὕδωρ; waterless, i.e. dry:--dry, without water.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποκρίνομαι
ἀνυπόκριτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποκρίνομαι; undissembled, i.e. sincere:--without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποτάσσω
ἀνυπότακτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποτάσσω; unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper):--disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.

ἄνω.shortDef: adverb from ἀντί; upward or on the top:--above, brim, high, up.

ἀνώγεον.shortDef: from ἄνω and γῆ; above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story:--upper room.

ἄνωθεν.shortDef: from ἄνω; from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew:--from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.

ἀνωτερικός.shortDef: from ἀνώτερος; superior, i.e. (locally) more remote:--upper.

ἀνώτερος.shortDef: comparative degree of ἄνω; upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book:--above, higher.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of ὠφέλιμος
ἀνωφελής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of ὠφέλιμος; useless or (neuter) inutility:--unprofitable(-ness).

ἀξίνη.shortDef: probably from  (to break; compare ῥήγνυμι); an axe:--axe.

ἄξιος.shortDef: probably from ἄγω; deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise):--due reward, meet, (un-)worthy.

ἀξιόω.shortDef: from ἄξιος; to deem entitled or fit:--desire, think good, count (think) worthy.

ἀξίως.shortDef: adverb from ἄξιος; appropriately:--as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy).

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὁρατός
ἀόρατος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὁρατός; invisible:--invisible (thing).

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of ἄγγελος
ἀπαγγέλλω.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of ἄγγελος; to announce:--bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.

ἀπάγχομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to choke; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death):--hang himself.

ἀπάγω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἄγω; to take off (in various senses):--bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παιδεύω
ἀπαίδευτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παιδεύω; uninstructed, i.e. (figuratively) stupid:--unlearned.

ἀπαίρω.shortDef: from ἀπό and αἴρω; to lift off, i.e. remove:--take (away).

ἀπαιτέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and αἰτέω; to demand back:--ask again, require.

ἀπαλγέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to smart); to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic:--be past feeling.

ἀπαλλάσσω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἀλλάσσω; to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove:--deliver, depart.

glosses: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀλλότριος
ἀπαλλοτριόω.shortDef: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀλλότριος; to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant:-- alienate, be alien.

glosses: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀντί
ἀπαντάω.shortDef: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀντί; to meet away, i.e. encounter:--meet.

ἅπαξ.shortDef: probably from ἅπας; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively):--once.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παραβαίνω
ἀπαράβατος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παραβαίνω; not passing away, i.e. untransferable (perpetual):-- unchangeable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παρασκευάζω
ἀπαρασκεύαστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παρασκευάζω; unready:--unprepared.

ἀπαρνέομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἀρνέομαι; to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain:--deny.

ἀπάρτι.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἄρτι; from now, i.e. henceforth (already):--from henceforth.

ἀπαρτισμός.shortDef: from a derivative of ἀπάρτι; completion:--finishing.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and ἄρχομαι
ἀπαρχή.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and ἄρχομαι; a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively):--first-fruits.

glosses: from Α (as a particle of union) and πᾶς
ἅπας.shortDef: from Α (as a particle of union) and πᾶς; absolutely all or (singular) every one:--all (things), every (one), whole.

ἀπατάω.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; to cheat, i.e. delude:--deceive.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and πατήρ
ἀπάτωρ.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and πατήρ; fatherless, i.e. of unrecorded paternity:--without father.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and αὐγάζω
ἀπαύγασμα.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and αὐγάζω; an off-flash, i.e. effulgence:--brightness.

glosses: from ἀπό and the same as εἴδω
ἀπείδω.shortDef: from ἀπό and the same as εἴδω; to see fully:--see.

ἀπείθεια.shortDef: from ἀπειθής; disbelief (obstinate and rebellious):--disobedience, unbelief.

ἀπειθέω.shortDef: from ἀπειθής; to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely):--not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and πείθω
ἀπειθής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and πείθω; unpersuadable, i.e. contumacious:--disobedient.

ἀπειλέω.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication, to forbid:--threaten.

ἀπειλή.shortDef: from ἀπειλέω; a menace:--X straitly, threatening.

ἄπειμι.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to go); to go away:--go. Compare ἄπειμι.

glosses: reflexive past of a compound of ἀπό and ἔπω
ἀπειπόμην.shortDef: reflexive past of a compound of ἀπό and ἔπω; to say off for oneself, i.e. disown:--renounce.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of πειράω
ἀπείραστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of πειράω; untried, i.e. not temptable:--not to be tempted.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and πεῖρα
ἄπειρος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and πεῖρα; inexperienced, i.e. ignorant:--unskilful.

ἀπεκδέχομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἐκδέχομαι; to expect fully:--look (wait) for.

glosses: middle voice from ἀπό and ἐκδύω
ἀπεκδύομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀπό and ἐκδύω; to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil:--put off, spoil.

ἀπελαύνω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἐλαύνω; to dismiss:--drive.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and ἐλέγχω
ἀπελεγμός.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and ἐλέγχω; refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt:--nought.

ἀπελεύθερος.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἐλεύθερος; one freed away, i.e. a freedman:--freeman.

ἀπελλῆς.shortDef: of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian:--Apelles.

ἀπελπίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἐλπίζω; to hope out, i.e. fully expect:--hope for again.

ἀπέναντι.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἔναντι; from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against:--before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of πέραν
ἀπέραντος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of πέραν; unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable:--endless.

glosses: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of περισπάω
ἀπερισπάστως.shortDef: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of περισπάω; undistractedly, i.e. free from (domestic) solicitude:--without distraction.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of περιτέμνω
ἀπερίτμητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of περιτέμνω; uncircumcised (figuratively):--uncircumcised.

ἀπέρχομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἔρχομαι; to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively:--come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past.

glosses: third person singular present indicative active of ἀπέχω used impersonally
ἀπέχει.shortDef: third person singular present indicative active of ἀπέχω used impersonally; it is sufficient:--it is enough.

ἀπέχομαι.shortDef: middle voice (reflexively) of ἀπέχω; to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain:--abstain.

ἀπέχω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἔχω; (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively):--be, have, receive.

ἀπιστέω.shortDef: from ἄπιστος; to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey:--believe not.

ἀπιστία.shortDef: from ἄπιστος; faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience):--unbelief.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and πιστός
ἄπιστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and πιστός; (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing):--that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).

ἁπλότης.shortDef: from ἁπλοῦς; singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal):--bountifulness, liberal(-ity), simplicity, singleness.

glosses: probably from Α (as a particle of union) and the base of πλέκω
ἁπλοῦς.shortDef: probably from Α (as a particle of union) and the base of πλέκω; properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear):--single.

glosses: adverb from ἁπλοῦς (in the objective sense of ἁπλότης)
ἁπλῶς.shortDef: adverb from ἁπλοῦς (in the objective sense of ἁπλότης); bountifully; --liberally.

ἀπό.shortDef: a primary particle; "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative):--(X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with. In composition (as a prefix) it usually denotes separation, departure, cessation, completion, reversal, etc.

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of βάσις
ἀποβαίνω.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of βάσις; literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate:--become, go out, turn.

ἀποβάλλω.shortDef: from ἀπό and βάλλω; to throw off; figuratively, to lose:--cast away.

ἀποβλέπω.shortDef: from ἀπό and βλέπω; to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard:--have respect.

ἀπόβλητος.shortDef: from ἀποβάλλω; cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected:--be refused.

ἀποβολή.shortDef: from ἀποβάλλω; rejection; figuratively, loss:--casting away, loss.

glosses: past participle of a compound of ἀπό and γίνομαι
ἀπογενόμενος.shortDef: past participle of a compound of ἀπό and γίνομαι; absent, i.e. deceased (figuratively, renounced):--being dead.

ἀπογραφή.shortDef: from ἀπογράφω; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment:--taxing.

ἀπογράφω.shortDef: from ἀπό and γράφω; to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol:--tax, write.

ἀποδείκνυμι.shortDef: from ἀπό and δεικνύω; to show off, i.e. exhibit; figuratively, to demonstrate, i.e. accredit:--(ap-)prove, set forth, shew.

ἀποδεκατόω.shortDef: from ἀπό and δεκατόω; to tithe (as debtor or creditor):--(give, pay, take) tithe.

ἀποδέχομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and δέχομαι; to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things):--accept, receive (gladly).

ἀποδημέω.shortDef: from ἀπόδημος; to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land:--go (travel) into a far country, journey.

ἀπόδημος.shortDef: from ἀπό and δῆμος; absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller:--taking a far journey.

ἀποδίδωμι.shortDef: from ἀπό and δίδωμι; to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications):--deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.

glosses: from ἀπό and a compound of διά and ὁρίζω
ἀποδιορίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and a compound of διά and ὁρίζω; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party):--separate.

ἀποδοκιμάζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and δοκιμάζω; to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate:--disallow, reject.

ἀπόθεσις.shortDef: from ἀποτίθημι; a laying aside (literally or figuratively):--putting away (off).

ἀποθήκη.shortDef: from ἀποτίθημι; a repository, i.e. granary:--barn, garner.

ἀποθησαυρίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and θησαυρίζω; to treasure away:--lay up in store.

ἀποθλίβω.shortDef: from ἀπό and θλίβω; to crowd (from every side):--press.

ἀποθνήσκω.shortDef: from ἀπό and θνήσκω; to die off (literally or figuratively):--be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).

ἀποκαθίστημι.shortDef: from ἀπό and καθίστημι; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization):--restore (again).

ἀποκαλύπτω.shortDef: from ἀπό and καλύπτω; to take off the cover, i.e. disclose:--reveal.

ἀποκάλυψις.shortDef: from ἀποκαλύπτω; disclosure:--appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.

glosses: from a comparative of ἀπό and a compound of  (the head) and δοκέω (in the sense of watching)
ἀποκαραδοκία.shortDef: from a comparative of ἀπό and a compound of  (the head) and δοκέω (in the sense of watching); intense anticipation:--earnest expectation.

ἀποκαταλλάσσω.shortDef: from ἀπό and καταλλάσσω; to reconcile fully:--reconcile.

ἀπόκειμαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and κεῖμαι; to be reserved; figuratively, to await:--be appointed, (be) laid up.

ἀποκεφαλίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and κεφαλή; to decapitate:--behead.

ἀποκλείω.shortDef: from ἀπό and κλείω; to close fully:--shut up.

ἀποκόπτω.shortDef: from ἀπό and κόπτω; to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts):--cut off. Compare κατατομή.

glosses: from ἀποκρίνομαι (in its original sense of judging)
ἀπόκριμα.shortDef: from ἀποκρίνομαι (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision:--sentence.

ἀποκρίνομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and ; to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare עָנָה) to begin to speak (where an address is expected):--answer.

ἀποκρύπτω.shortDef: from ἀπό and κρύπτω; to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret:--hide.

ἀπόκρυφος.shortDef: from ἀποκρύπτω; secret; by implication, treasured:--hid, kept secret.

ἀποκτείνω.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to slay); to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy:--put to death, kill, slay.

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of κῦμα
ἀποκυέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of κῦμα; to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively):--beget, produce.

ἀποκυλίω.shortDef: from ἀπό and κυλιόω; to roll away:--roll away (back).

ἀπολαμβάνω.shortDef: from ἀπό and λαμβάνω; to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside:--receive, take.

glosses: from a comparative of ἀπό and  (to enjoy)
ἀπόλαυσις.shortDef: from a comparative of ἀπό and  (to enjoy); full enjoyment:--enjoy(-ment).

ἀπολείπω.shortDef: from ἀπό and λείπω; to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake:--leave, remain.

ἀπολείχω.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to "lick"); to lick clean:--lick.

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of ὄλεθρος
ἀπόλλυμι.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of ὄλεθρος; to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively:--destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.

ἀπολλύων.shortDef: active participle of ἀπόλλυμι; a destroyer (i.e. Satan):--Apollyon.

glosses: from the pagan deity  (i.e. the sun
ἀπολλωνία.shortDef: from the pagan deity  (i.e. the sun; from ἀπόλλυμι); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia:--Apollonia.

glosses: probably from the same as Ἀπολλωνία
ἀπολλῶς.shortDef: probably from the same as Ἀπολλωνία; Apollos, an Israelite:--Apollos.

glosses: middle voice from a compound of ἀπό and λόγος
ἀπολογέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from a compound of ἀπό and λόγος; to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self):--answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.

ἀπολογία.shortDef: from the same as ἀπολογέομαι; a plea ("apology"):--answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.
