ἀπολούω.shortDef: from ἀπό and λούω; to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively):--wash (away).

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and λύτρον
ἀπολύτρωσις.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and λύτρον; (the act) ransom in full, i.e. (figuratively) riddance, or (specially) Christian salvation:--deliverance, redemption.

ἀπολύω.shortDef: from ἀπό and λύω; to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce:--(let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty.

glosses: middle voice from ἀπό and  (to squeeze
ἀπομάσσομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀπό and  (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away:--wipe off.

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of νόμος
ἀπονέμω.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of νόμος; to apportion, i.e. bestow:--give.

ἀπονίπτω.shortDef: from ἀπό and νίπτω; to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically):--wash.

ἀποπίπτω.shortDef: from ἀπό and πίπτω; to fall off:--fall.

ἀποπλανάω.shortDef: from ἀπό and πλανάω; to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth):--err, seduce.

ἀποπλέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and πλέω; to set sail:--sail away.

ἀποπλύνω.shortDef: from ἀπό and πλύνω; to rinse off:--wash.

ἀποπνίγω.shortDef: from ἀπό and πνίγω; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth):--choke.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and the base of πορεύομαι
ἀπορέω.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and the base of πορεύομαι; to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally):-- (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.

ἀπορία.shortDef: from the same as ἀπορέω; a (state of) quandary:--perplexity.

ἀποῤῥίπτω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ῥίπτω; to hurl off, i.e. precipitate (oneself):--cast.

glosses: from ἀπό and a derivative of ὀρφανός
ἀπορφανίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and a derivative of ὀρφανός; to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse):--take.

glosses: from ἀπό and a derivative of σκεῦος
ἀποσκευάζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and a derivative of σκεῦος; to pack up (one's) baggage:--take up… carriages.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and a derivative of σκιά
ἀποσκίασμα.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and a derivative of σκιά; a shading off, i.e. obscuration:--shadow.

ἀποσπάω.shortDef: from ἀπό and σπάω; to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously):--(with-)draw (away), after we were gotten from.

glosses: feminine of the same as ἀποστάσιον
ἀποστασία.shortDef: feminine of the same as ἀποστάσιον; defection from truth (properly, the state) ("apostasy"):--falling away, forsake.

glosses: neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of ἀφίστημι
ἀποστάσιον.shortDef: neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of ἀφίστημι; properly, something separative, i.e. (specially) divorce:--(writing of) divorcement.

glosses: from ἀπό and a derivative of στέγη
ἀποστεγάζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and a derivative of στέγη; to unroof:--uncover.

ἀποστέλλω.shortDef: from ἀπό and στέλλω; set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively:--put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty).

ἀποστερέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to deprive); to despoil:--defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.

ἀπόστολος.shortDef: from ἀποστέλλω; a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers):--apostle, messenger, he that is sent.

glosses: from ἀπό and a (presumed) derivative of στόμα
ἀποστοματίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and a (presumed) derivative of στόμα; to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner):--provoke to speak.

ἀποστρέφω.shortDef: from ἀπό and στρέφω; to turn away or back (literally or figuratively):--bring again, pervert, turn away (from).

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of στυγνητός
ἀποστυγέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of στυγνητός; to detest utterly:--abhor.

ἀποσυνάγωγος.shortDef: from ἀπό and συναγωγή; excommunicated:--(put) out of the synagogue(-s).

glosses: middle voice from ἀπό and τάσσω
ἀποτάσσομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἀπό and τάσσω; literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce:--bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.

ἀποτελέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and τελέω; to complete entirely, i.e. consummate:--finish.

ἀποτίθημι.shortDef: from ἀπό and τίθημι; to put away (literally or figuratively):--cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).

ἀποτινάσσω.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to jostle); to brush off:--shake off.

ἀποτίνω.shortDef: from ἀπό and τίνω; to pay in full:--repay.

ἀποτολμάω.shortDef: from ἀπό and τολμάω; to venture plainly:--be very bold.

ἀποτομία.shortDef: from the base of ἀποτόμως; (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. rigor:--severity.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of a comparative of ἀπό and  (to cut)
ἀποτόμως.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of a comparative of ἀπό and  (to cut); abruptly, i.e. peremptorily:--sharply(-ness).

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of τροπή
ἀποτρέπω.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of τροπή; to deflect, i.e. (reflexively) avoid:--turn away.

ἀπουσία.shortDef: from the participle of ἄπειμι; a being away:--absence.

ἀποφέρω.shortDef: from ἀπό and φέρω; to bear off (literally or relatively):--bring, carry (away).

ἀποφεύγω.shortDef: from ἀπό and φεύγω; (figuratively) to escape:--escape.

ἀποφθέγγομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and φθέγγομαι; to enunciate plainly, i.e. declare:--say, speak forth, utterance.

glosses: from ἀπό and the middle voice of φορτίζω
ἀποφορτίζομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and the middle voice of φορτίζω; to unload:--unlade.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and χράομαι
ἀπόχρησις.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and χράομαι; the act of using up, i.e. consumption:--using.

ἀποχωρέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and χωρέω; to go away:--depart.

ἀποχωρίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and χωρίζω; to rend apart; reflexively, to separate:--depart (asunder).

ἀποψύχω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ψύχω; to breathe out, i.e. faint:--hearts failing.

ἄππιος.shortDef: of Latin origin; (in the genitive, i.e. possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman:--Appii.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of πρός and  (to go)
ἀπρόσιτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of πρός and  (to go); inaccessible:--which no man can approach.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of προσκόπτω
ἀπρόσκοπος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of προσκόπτω; actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin:--none (void of, without) offence.

glosses: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of πρόσωπον and λαμβάνω (compare προσωπολήπτης)
ἀπροσωπολήπτως.shortDef: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of πρόσωπον and λαμβάνω (compare προσωπολήπτης); in a way not accepting the person, i.e. impartially:--without respect of persons.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of πταίω
ἄπταιστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of πταίω; not stumbling, i.e. (figuratively) without sin:--from falling.

ἅπτομαι.shortDef: reflexive of ἅπτω; properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. to touch (in many implied relations):--touch.

ἅπτω.shortDef: a primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire:--kindle, light.

ἀπφία.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Collosæ:--Apphia.

glosses: from ἀπό and the middle voice of  or  (to shove)
ἀπωθέομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and the middle voice of  or  (to shove); to push off, figuratively, to reject:--cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from).

glosses: from a presumed derivative of ἀπόλλυμι
ἀπώλεια.shortDef: from a presumed derivative of ἀπόλλυμι; ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal):--damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste.

ἀρά.shortDef: probably from αἴρω; properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation:--curse.

glosses: probably from αἴρω (through the idea of drawing a conclusion)
ἄρα.shortDef: probably from αἴρω (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows):--haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore. Often used in connection with other particles, especially γέ or οὖν (after) or εἰ (before). Compare also ἆρα.

ἆρα.shortDef: a form of ἄρα, denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed:--therefore.

ἀραβία.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֲרָב); Arabia, a region of Asia:--Arabia.

ἀράμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רָם); Aram (i.e. Ram), an Israelite:--Aram.

ἄραψ.shortDef: from Ἀραβία; an Arab or native of Arabia:--Arabian.

ἀργέω.shortDef: from ἀργός; to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay:--linger.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἔργον
ἀργός.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἔργον; inactive, i.e. unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless:--barren, idle, slow.

ἀργύρεος.shortDef: from ἄργυρος; made of silver:--(of) silver.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of ἄργυρος
ἀργύριον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of ἄργυρος; silvery, i.e. (by implication) cash; specially, a silverling (i.e. drachma or shekel):--money, (piece of) silver (piece).

ἀργυροκόπος.shortDef: from ἄργυρος and κόπτω; a beater (i.e. worker) of silver:--silversmith.

ἄργυρος.shortDef: from  (shining); silver (the metal, in the articles or coin):--silver.

glosses: from  (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of πήγνυμι
ἄρειος πάγος.shortDef: from  (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of πήγνυμι; rock of Ares, a place in Athens:--Areopagus, Mars' Hill.

ἀρεοπαγίτης.shortDef: from Ἄρειος Πάγος; an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill:--Areopagite.

ἀρεσκεία.shortDef: from a derivative of ἀρέσκω; complaisance:--pleasing.

glosses: probably from αἴρω (through the idea of exciting emotion)
ἀρέσκω.shortDef: probably from αἴρω (through the idea of exciting emotion); to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so):--please.

ἀρεστός.shortDef: from ἀρέσκω; agreeable; by implication, fit:--(things that) please(-ing), reason.

ἀρέτας.shortDef: of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian:--Aretas.

ἀρέτη.shortDef: from the same as ἄῤῥην; properly, manliness (valor), i.e. excellence (intrinsic or attributed):--praise, virtue.

ἀρήν.shortDef: perhaps the same as ἄῤῥην; a lamb (as a male):--lamb.

ἀριθμέω.shortDef: from ἀριθμός; to enumerate or count:--number.

ἀριθμός.shortDef: from αἴρω; a number (as reckoned up):--number.

ἀριμαθαία.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רָמָה); Arimathæa (or Ramah), a place in Palestine:--Arimathæa.

glosses: from the same as ἄριστον and ἄρχω
ἀρίσταρχος.shortDef: from the same as ἄριστον and ἄρχω; best ruling; Aristarchus, a Macedonian:--Aristarchus.

ἀριστάω.shortDef: from ἄριστον; to take the principle meal:--dine.

glosses: apparently a comparative of the same as ἄριστον
ἀριστερός.shortDef: apparently a comparative of the same as ἄριστον; the left hand (as second-best):--left (hand).

glosses: from the same as ἄριστον and βουλή
ἀριστόβουλος.shortDef: from the same as ἄριστον and βουλή; best counselling; Aristoboulus, a Christian:--Aristobulus.

glosses: apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as ἄῤῥην
ἄριστον.shortDef: apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as ἄῤῥην; the best meal (or breakfast; perhaps from  ("early")), i.e. luncheon:--dinner.

glosses: apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to αἴρω through the idea of raising a barrier)
ἀρκέω.shortDef: apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to αἴρω through the idea of raising a barrier); properly, to ward off, i.e. (by implication) to avail (figuratively, be satisfactory):--be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient.

ἄρκτος.shortDef: probably from ἀρκέω; a bear (as obstructing by ferocity):--bear.

glosses: probably from αἴρω (perhaps with Α (as a particle of union) prefixed)
ἅρμα.shortDef: probably from αἴρω (perhaps with Α (as a particle of union) prefixed); a chariot (as raised or fitted together (compare ἁρμός)):--chariot.

ἀρμαγεδδών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (הַר and מְגִדּוֹן); Armageddon (or Har-Meggiddon), a symbolic name:--Armageddon.

ἁρμόζω.shortDef: from ἁρμός; to joint, i.e. (figuratively) to woo (reflexively, to betroth):--espouse.

ἁρμός.shortDef: from the same as ἅρμα; an articulation (of the body):--joint.

glosses: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of ῥέω
ἀρνέομαι.shortDef: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of ῥέω; to contradict, i.e. disavow, reject, abnegate:--deny, refuse.

ἁρπαγή.shortDef: from ἁρπάζω; pillage (properly abstract):--extortion, ravening, spoiling.

ἁρπάζω.shortDef: from a derivative of αἱρέομαι; to seize (in various applications):--catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force).

ἀῤῥαβών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֲרָבוֹן); a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest:--earnest.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as ῥαφίς
ἄῤῥαφος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as ῥαφίς; unsewed, i.e. of a single piece:--without seam.

ἄῤῥην.shortDef: probably from αἴρω; male (as stronger for lifting):--male, man.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and the same as ῥητῶς
ἄῤῥητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and the same as ῥητῶς; unsaid, i.e. (by implication) inexpressible:--unspeakable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ῥώννυμι
ἄῤῥωστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ῥώννυμι; infirm:--sick (folk, -ly).

ἀρσενοκοίτης.shortDef: from ἄῤῥην and κοίτη; a sodomite:--abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.

glosses: contracted from a compound of Ἄρτεμις and δῶρον
ἀρτεμάς.shortDef: contracted from a compound of Ἄρτεμις and δῶρον; gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian:--Artemas.

glosses: probably from the same as ἀρτέμων
ἄρτεμις.shortDef: probably from the same as ἀρτέμων; prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities:--Diana.

ἀρτέμων.shortDef: from a derivative of ἄρτι; properly, something ready (or else more remotely from αἴρω (compare ἄρτος); something hung up), i.e. (specially) the topsail (rather foresail or jib) of a vessel:--mainsail.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of αἴρω (compare ἄρτος) through the idea of suspension
ἄρτι.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of αἴρω (compare ἄρτος) through the idea of suspension; just now:--this day (hour), hence(-forth), here(-after), hither(-to), (even) now, (this) present.

ἀρτιγέννητος.shortDef: from ἄρτι and γεννητός; just born, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert:--new born.

ἄρτιος.shortDef: from ἄρτι; fresh, i.e. (by implication) complete:--perfect.

ἄρτος.shortDef: from αἴρω; bread (as raised) or a loaf:--(shew-)bread, loaf.

glosses: from a presumed derivative of αἴρω
ἀρτύω.shortDef: from a presumed derivative of αἴρω; to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments):--season.

ἀρφαξάδ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אַרְפַּכְשַׁד); Arphaxad, a post-diluvian patriarch:--Arphaxad.

ἀρχάγγελος.shortDef: from ἄρχω and ἄγγελος; a chief angel:--archangel.

ἀρχαῖος.shortDef: from ἀρχή; original or primeval:--(them of) old (time).

ἀρχέλαος.shortDef: from ἄρχω and Λαοδικεύς; people-ruling; Archelaus, a Jewish king:--Archelaus.

ἀρχή.shortDef: from ἄρχομαι; (properly abstract) a commencement, or (concretely) chief (in various applications of order, time, place, or rank):--beginning, corner, (at the, the) first (estate), magistrate, power, principality, principle, rule.

ἀρχηγός.shortDef: from ἀρχή and ἄγω; a chief leader:--author, captain, prince.

glosses: from ἀρχή and a derivative of ἱερός
ἀρχιερατικός.shortDef: from ἀρχή and a derivative of ἱερός; high-priestly:--of the high-priest.

ἀρχιερεύς.shortDef: from ἀρχή and ἱερεύς; the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest:--chief (high) priest, chief of the priests.

ἀρχιποίμην.shortDef: from ἀρχή and ποιμήν; a head shepherd:--chief shepherd.

ἄρχιππος.shortDef: from ἀρχή and ἵππος; horse-ruler; Archippus, a Christian:--Archippus.

ἀρχισυνάγωγος.shortDef: from ἀρχή and συναγωγή; director of the synagogue services:--(chief) ruler of the synagogue.

ἀρχιτέκτων.shortDef: from ἀρχή and τέκτων; a chief constructor, i.e. "architect":--masterbuilder.

ἀρχιτελώνης.shortDef: from ἀρχή and τελώνης; a principle tax-gatherer:--chief among the publicans.

glosses: from ἀρχή and a compound of τρεῖς and κλίνω (a dinner-bed
ἀρχιτρίκλινος.shortDef: from ἀρχή and a compound of τρεῖς and κλίνω (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches); director of the entertainment:--governor (ruler) of the feast.

glosses: middle voice of ἄρχω (through the implication
ἄρχομαι.shortDef: middle voice of ἄρχω (through the implication, of precedence); to commence (in order of time):--(rehearse from the) begin(-ning).

ἄρχω.shortDef: a primary verb; to be first (in political rank or power):--reign (rule) over.

ἄρχων.shortDef: present participle of ἄρχω; a first (in rank or power):--chief (ruler), magistrate, prince, ruler.

glosses: from αἴρω (in the sense of sending off scent)
ἄρωμα.shortDef: from αἴρω (in the sense of sending off scent); an aromatic:--(sweet) spice.

ἀσά.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אָסָא); Asa, an Israelite:--Asa.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σαλεύω
ἀσάλευτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σαλεύω; unshaken, i.e. (by implication) immovable (figuratively):--which cannot be moved, unmovable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σβέννυμι
ἄσβεστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σβέννυμι; not extinguished, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--not to be quenched, unquenchable.

ἀσέβεια.shortDef: from ἀσεβής; impiety, i.e. (by implication) wickedness:--ungodly(-liness).

ἀσεβέω.shortDef: from ἀσεβής; to be (by implied act) impious or wicked:--commit (live, that after should live) ungodly.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σέβομαι
ἀσεβής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σέβομαι; irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked:-- ungodly (man).

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed  (of uncertain derivation
ἀσέλγεια.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed  (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent); licentiousness (sometimes including other vices):--filthy, lasciviousness, wantonness.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of σημαίνω
ἄσημος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of σημαίνω; unmarked, i.e. (figuratively) ignoble:--mean.

ἀσήρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אָשֵׁר); Aser (i.e. Asher), an Israelite tribe:--Aser.

ἀσθένεια.shortDef: from ἀσθενής; feebleness (of mind or body); by implication, malady; morally, frailty:--disease, infirmity, sickness, weakness.

ἀσθενέω.shortDef: from ἀσθενής; to be feeble (in any sense):--be diseased, impotent folk (man), (be) sick, (be, be made) weak.

ἀσθένημα.shortDef: from ἀσθενέω; a scruple of conscience:--infirmity.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of σθενόω
ἀσθενής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of σθενόω; strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral):--more feeble, impotent, sick, without strength, weak(-er, -ness, thing).

ἀσία.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore:--Asia.

ἀσιανός.shortDef: from Ἀσία; an Asian (i.e. Asiatic) or an inhabitant of Asia:--of Asia.

ἀσιάρχης.shortDef: from Ἀσία and ἀρχή; an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor:--chief of Asia.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and σῖτος
ἄσιτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and σῖτος; without (taking) food:--fasting.

glosses: probably from the same as σκεῦος
ἀσκέω.shortDef: probably from the same as σκεῦος; to elaborate, i.e. (figuratively) train (by implication, strive):--exercise.

ἀσκός.shortDef: from the same as ἀσκέω; a leathern (or skin) bag used as a bottle:--bottle.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή
ἀσμένως.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή; with pleasure:--gladly.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and σοφός
ἄσοφος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and σοφός; unwise:--fool.

glosses: from Α (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of σπάω
ἀσπάζομαι.shortDef: from Α (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of σπάω; to enfold in the arms, i.e. (by implication) to salute, (figuratively) to welcome:--embrace, greet, salute, take leave.

ἀσπασμός.shortDef: from ἀσπάζομαι; a greeting (in person or by letter):--greeting, salutation.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and σπιλόω
ἄσπιλος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and σπιλόω; unblemished (physically or morally):--without spot, unspotted.

ἀσπίς.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a buckler (or round shield); used of a serpent (as coiling itself), probably the "asp":--asp.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σπένδω
ἄσπονδος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of σπένδω; literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless:--implacable, truce-breaker.

ἀσσάριον.shortDef: of Latin origin; an assarius or as, a Roman coin:--farthing.

glosses: neuter comparative of the base of ἐγγύς
ἆσσον.shortDef: neuter comparative of the base of ἐγγύς; more nearly, i.e. very near:--close.

ἄσσος.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; Assus, a city of Asia MInor:--Assos.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἵστημι
ἀστατέω.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἵστημι; to be non-stationary, i.e. (figuratively) homeless:--have no certain dwelling-place.

ἀστεῖος.shortDef: from  (a city); urbane, i.e. (by implication) handsome:--fair.

glosses: probably from the base of στρώννυμι
ἀστήρ.shortDef: probably from the base of στρώννυμι; a star (as strown over the sky), literally or figuratively:--star.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of στηρίζω
ἀστήρικτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of στηρίζω; unfixed, i.e. (figuratively) vacillating:--unstable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of  (to cherish affectionately)
ἄστοργος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of  (to cherish affectionately); hard-hearted towards kindred:--without natural affection.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and  (an aim)
ἀστοχέω.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and  (an aim); to miss the mark, i.e. (figuratively) deviate from truth:--err, swerve.

ἀστραπή.shortDef: from ἀστράπτω; lightning; by analogy, glare:--lightning, bright shining.

ἀστράπτω.shortDef: probably from  ἀστήρ; to flash as lightning:--lighten, shine.

ἄστρον.shortDef: neuter from ἀστήρ; properly, a constellation; put for a single star (natural or artificial):--star.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συγκρίνω
ἀσύγκριτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συγκρίνω; incomparable; Asyncritus, a Christian:--Asyncritos.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and σύμφωνος
ἀσύμφωνος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and σύμφωνος; inharmonious (figuratively):--agree not.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and συνετός
ἀσύνετος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and συνετός; unintelligent; by implication, wicked:--foolish, without understanding.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συντίθεμαι
ἀσύνθετος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of συντίθεμαι; properly, not agreed, i.e. treacherous to compacts:-- covenant-breaker.

ἀσφάλεια.shortDef: from ἀσφαλής; security (literally or figuratively):--certainty, safety.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail")
ἀσφαλής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail"); secure (literally or figuratively):--certain(-ty), safe, sure.

ἀσφαλίζω.shortDef: from ἀσφαλής; to render secure:--make fast (sure).

ἀσφαλῶς.shortDef: adverb from ἀσφαλής; securely (literally or figuratively):--assuredly, safely.

ἀσχημονέω.shortDef: from ἀσχήμων; to be (i.e. act) unbecoming:--behave self uncomely (unseemly).

ἀσχημοσύνη.shortDef: from ἀσχήμων; an indecency; by implication, the pudenda:--shame, that which is unseemly.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἔχω (in the sense of its congener σχῆμα)
ἀσχήμων.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἔχω (in the sense of its congener σχῆμα); properly, shapeless, i.e. (figuratively) inelegant:--uncomely.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σώζω
ἀσωτία.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of σώζω; properly, unsavedness, i.e. (by implication) profligacy:--excess, riot.

glosses: adverb from the same as ἀσωτία
ἀσώτως.shortDef: adverb from the same as ἀσωτία; dissolutely:--riotous.

ἀτακτέω.shortDef: from ἄτακτος; to be (i.e. act) irregular:--behave self disorderly.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τάσσω
ἄτακτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of τάσσω; unarranged, i.e. (by implication) insubordinate (religiously):--unruly.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and τέκνον
ἄτεκνος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and τέκνον; childless:--childless, without children.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a particle of union) and  (to stretch)
ἀτενίζω.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a particle of union) and  (to stretch); to gaze intently:--behold earnestly (stedfastly), fasten (eyes), look (earnestly, stedfastly, up stedfastly), set eyes.

glosses: a particle probably akin to ἄνευ
ἄτερ.shortDef: a particle probably akin to ἄνευ; aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively):--in the absence of, without.

ἀτιμάζω.shortDef: from ἄτιμος; to render infamous, i.e. (by implication) contemn or maltreat:--despise, dishonour, suffer shame, entreat shamefully.

ἀτιμία.shortDef: from ἄτιμος; infamy, i.e. (subjectively) comparative indignity, (objectively) disgrace:--dishonour, reproach, shame, vile.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and τιμή
ἄτιμος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and τιμή; (negatively) unhonoured or (positively) dishonoured:--despised, without honour, less honourable (comparative degree).

ἀτιμόω.shortDef: from ἄτιμος; used like ἀτιμάζω, to maltreat:--handle shamefully.

ἀτμίς.shortDef: from the same as ἀήρ; mist:--vapour.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of τομώτερος
ἄτομος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of τομώτερος; uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time):-- moment.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and τόπος
ἄτοπος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and τόπος; out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked:--amiss, harm, unreasonable.

ἀττάλεια.shortDef: from  (a king of Pergamus); Attaleia, a place in Pamphylia:--Attalia.

αὐγή.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn:--break of day.

αὐγοῦστος.shortDef: from Latin ("august"); Augustus, a title of the Roman emperor:--Augustus.

glosses: from αὐτός and the base of ἡδονή
αὐθάδης.shortDef: from αὐτός and the base of ἡδονή; self-pleasing, i.e. arrogant:--self-willed.

glosses: from αὐτός and the same as αἱρετίζω
αὐθαίρετος.shortDef: from αὐτός and the same as αἱρετίζω; self-chosen, i.e. (by implication) voluntary:--of own accord, willing of self.

glosses: from a compound of αὐτός and an obsolete  (a worker)
αὐθεντέω.shortDef: from a compound of αὐτός and an obsolete  (a worker); to act of oneself, i.e. (figuratively) dominate:--usurp authority over.

αὐλέω.shortDef: from αὐλός; to play the flute:--pipe.

αὐλή.shortDef: from the same as ἀήρ; a yard (as open to the wind); by implication, a mansion:--court, (sheep-)fold, hall, palace.

αὐλίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from αὐλή; to pass the night (properly, in the open air):--abide, lodge.

αὐλός.shortDef: from the same as ἀήρ; a flute (as blown):--pipe.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb
αὐξάνω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive):--grow (up), (give the) increase.

glosses: from a derivative of the same as ἀήρ (meaning a breeze
αὔριον.shortDef: from a derivative of the same as ἀήρ (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air); properly, fresh, i.e. (adverb with ellipsis of ἡμέρα) to-morrow:--(to-)morrow, next day.

glosses: from a (presumed) derivative of the same as ἀήρ (meaning blown)
αὐστηρός.shortDef: from a (presumed) derivative of the same as ἀήρ (meaning blown); rough (properly as a gale), i.e. (figuratively) severe:--austere.

αὐτάρκεια.shortDef: from αὐτάρκης; self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence:--contentment, sufficiency.

αὐτάρκης.shortDef: from αὐτός and ἀρκέω; self-complacent, i.e. contented:--content.

glosses: from αὐτός and a derivative or κατακρίνω
αὐτοκατάκριτος.shortDef: from αὐτός and a derivative or κατακρίνω; self-condemned:--condemned of self.

glosses: from αὐτός and the same as μάτην
αὐτόματος.shortDef: from αὐτός and the same as μάτην; self-moved ("automatic"), i.e. spontaneous:--of own accord, of self.

αὐτόπτης.shortDef: from αὐτός and ὀπτάνομαι; self-seeing, i.e. an eye-witness:--eye-witness.

glosses: from the particle  (perhaps akin to the base of ἀήρ through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward)
αὐτός.shortDef: from the particle  (perhaps akin to the base of ἀήρ through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward); the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative ἑαυτοῦ) of the third person , and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons:--her, it(-self), one, the other, (mine) own, said, (self-), the) same, ((him-, my-, thy- )self, (your-)selves, she, that, their(-s), them(-selves), there(-at, - by, -in, -into, -of, -on, -with), they, (these) things, this (man), those, together, very, which. Compare αὑτοῦ.

αὐτοῦ.shortDef: genitive (i.e. possessive) of αὐτός, used as an adverb of location; properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place:--(t-)here.

αὑτοῦ.shortDef: contracted for ἑαυτοῦ; self (in some oblique case or reflexive relation):--her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they.

αὐτόχειρ.shortDef: from αὐτός and χείρ; self-handed, i.e. doing personally:--with … own hands.

glosses: from  (probably from a base akin to that of ἀήρ) (dust
αὐχμηρός.shortDef: from  (probably from a base akin to that of ἀήρ) (dust, as dried by wind); properly, dirty, i.e. (by implication) obscure:--dark.

ἀφαιρέω.shortDef: from ἀπό and αἱρέομαι; to remove (literally or figuratively):--cut (smite) off, take away.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and φαίνω
ἀφανής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and φαίνω; non-apparent:--that is not manifest.

ἀφανίζω.shortDef: from ἀφανής; to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed):-- corrupt, disfigure, perish, vanish away.

ἀφανισμός.shortDef: from ἀφανίζω; disappearance, i.e. (figuratively) abrogation:--vanish away.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φαίνω
ἄφαντος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φαίνω; non-manifested, i.e. invisible:--vanished out of sight.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and the base of ἑδραῖος
ἀφεδρών.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and the base of ἑδραῖος; a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy:--draught.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φείδομαι
ἀφειδία.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φείδομαι; unsparingness, i.e. austerity (asceticism):--neglecting.

glosses: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and  (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot)
ἀφελότης.shortDef: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and  (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot); smoothness, i.e. (figuratively) simplicity:--singleness.

ἄφεσις.shortDef: from ἀφίημι; freedom; (figuratively) pardon:--deliverance, forgiveness, liberty, remission.

ἁφή.shortDef: from ἅπτομαι; probably a ligament (as fastening):--joint.

ἀφθαρσία.shortDef: from ἄφθαρτος; incorruptibility; genitive, unending existence; (figuratively) genuineness:--immortality, incorruption, sincerity.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φθείρω
ἄφθαρτος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of φθείρω; undecaying (in essence or continuance):--not (in-, un-)corruptible, immortal.

ἀφίημι.shortDef: from ἀπό and  (to send; an intensive form of , to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow):--cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up.

glosses: from ἀπό and the base of ἱκανός
ἀφικνέομαι.shortDef: from ἀπό and the base of ἱκανός; to go (i.e. spread) forth (by rumor):--come abroad.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάγαθος
ἀφιλάγαθος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάγαθος; hostile to virtue:--despiser of those that are good.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάργυρος
ἀφιλάργυρος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and φιλάργυρος; unavaricious:--without covetousness, not greedy of filthy lucre.

ἄφιξις.shortDef: from ἀφικνέομαι; properly, arrival, i.e. (by implication) departure:--departing.

ἀφίστημι.shortDef: from ἀπό and ἵστημι; to remove, i.e. (actively) instigate to revolt; usually (reflexively) to desist, desert, etc.:--depart, draw (fall) away, refrain, withdraw self.

ἄφνω.shortDef: adverb from ἀφανής (contraction); unawares, i.e. unexpectedly:--suddenly.

glosses: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φόβος
ἀφόβως.shortDef: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and φόβος; fearlessly:--without fear.

ἀφομοιόω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ὁμοιόω; to assimilate closely:--make like.

ἀφοράω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ὁράω; to consider attentively:--look.

ἀφορίζω.shortDef: from ἀπό and ὁρίζω; to set off by boundary, i.e. (figuratively) limit, exclude, appoint, etc.:--divide, separate, sever.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and ὁρμάω
ἀφορμή.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and ὁρμάω; a starting-point, i.e. (figuratively) an opportunity:--occasion.

ἀφρίζω.shortDef: from ἀφρός; to froth at the mouth (in epilepsy):--foam.

ἀφρός.shortDef: apparently a primary word; froth, i.e. slaver:--foaming.

ἀφροσύνη.shortDef: from ἄφρων; senselessness, i.e. (euphemistically) egotism; (morally) recklessness:--folly, foolishly(-ness).

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and φρήν
ἄφρων.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and φρήν; properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving:--fool(-ish), unwise.

glosses: from a compound of ἀπό and ὕπνος
ἀφυπνόω.shortDef: from a compound of ἀπό and ὕπνος; properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber:--fall asleep.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and φωνή
ἄφωνος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and φωνή; voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning:--dumb, without signification.

ἀχάζ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אָחָז); Achaz, an Israelite:--Achaz.

ἀχαΐα.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe:--Achaia.

ἀχαϊκός.shortDef: from Ἀχαΐα; an Achaian; Achaicus, a Christian:--Achaicus.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of χαρίζομαι
ἀχάριστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of χαρίζομαι; thankless, i.e. ungrateful:--unthankful.

ἀχείμ.shortDef: probably of Hebrew origin (compare יוֹקִים); Achim, an Israelite:--Achim.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and χειροποίητος
ἀχειροποίητος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and χειροποίητος; unmanufactured, i.e. inartificial:--made without (not made with) hands.

ἀχλύς.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; dimness of sight, i.e. (probably) a cataract:--mist.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of χρή (compare χρεία)
ἀχρεῖος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of χρή (compare χρεία); useless, i.e. (euphemistically) unmeritorious:--unprofitable.

ἀχρειόω.shortDef: from ἀχρεῖος; to render useless, i.e. spoil:--become unprofitable.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and χρηστός
ἄχρηστος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and χρηστός; inefficient, i.e. (by implication) detrimental:--unprofitable.

glosses: akin to ἄκρον (through the idea of a terminus)
ἄχρι.shortDef: akin to ἄκρον (through the idea of a terminus); (of time) until or (of place) up to:--as far as, for, in(-to), till, (even, un-)to, until, while. Compare μέχρι.

ἄχυρον.shortDef: perhaps remotely from  (to shed forth); chaff (as diffusive):--chaff.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ψεῦδος
ἀψευδής.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ψεῦδος; veracious:--that cannot lie.

ἄψινθος.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; wormwood (as a type of bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity):--wormwood.

glosses: from Α (as a negative particle) and ψυχή
ἄψυχος.shortDef: from Α (as a negative particle) and ψυχή; lifeless, i.e. inanimate (mechanical):--without life.

βάαλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בַּעַל); Baal, a Phœnician deity (used as a symbol of idolatry):--Baal.

βαβυλών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בָּבֶל); Babylon, the capitol of Chaldæa (literally or figuratively (as a type of tyranny)):-- Babylon.

βαθμός.shortDef: from the same as βάθος; a step, i.e. (figuratively) grade (of dignity):--degree.

βάθος.shortDef: from the same as βαθύς; profundity, i.e. (by implication) extent; (figuratively) mystery:--deep(-ness, things), depth.

βαθύς.shortDef: from the base of βάσις; profound (as going down), literally or figuratively:--deep, very early.

glosses: a diminutive of a derivative probably of the base of βάσις
βαΐον.shortDef: a diminutive of a derivative probably of the base of βάσις; a palm twig (as going out far):--branch.

βαλαάμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בִּלְעָם); Balaam, a Mesopotamian (symbolic of a false teacher):--Balaam.

βαλάκ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בָּלָק); Balak, a Moabite:--Balac.

glosses: probably remotely from βάλλω (as a depository)
βαλάντιον.shortDef: probably remotely from βάλλω (as a depository); a pouch (for money):--bag, purse.

βάλλω.shortDef: a primary verb; to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense):--arise, cast (out), X dung, lay, lie, pour, put (up), send, strike, throw (down), thrust. Compare ῥίπτω.

βαπτίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of βάπτω; to immerse, submerge; to make whelmed (i.e. fully wet); used only (in the New Testament) of ceremonial ablution, especially (technically) of the ordinance of Christian baptism:--Baptist, baptize, wash.

βαπτισμός.shortDef: from βαπτίζω; ablution (ceremonial or Christian):--baptism, washing.

βαπτιστής.shortDef: from βαπτίζω; a baptizer, as an epithet of Christ's forerunner:--Baptist.

βάπτω.shortDef: a primary verb; to whelm, i.e. cover wholly with a fluid; in the New Testament only in a qualified or special sense, i.e. (literally) to moisten (a part of one's person), or (by implication) to stain (as with dye):--dip.

βαραββᾶς.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (גָּאוֹן and אֲבַגְתָא); son of Abba; Bar-abbas, an Israelite:--Barabbas.

βαράκ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בָּרָק); Barak, an Israelite:--Barak.

βαραχίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בֶּרֶכְיָה); Barachias (i.e. Berechijah), an Israelite:--Barachias.

βάρβαρος.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a foreigner (i.e. non-Greek):--barbarian(-rous).

βαρέω.shortDef: from βαρύς; to weigh down (figuratively):--burden, charge, heavy, press.

βαρθολομαῖος.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and תַּלְמַי); son of Tolmai; Bar-tholomæus, a Christian apostle:--Bartholomeus.

βαριησοῦς.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and יְהוֹשׁוּעַ); son of Jesus (or Joshua); Bar-jesus, an Israelite:--Barjesus.

βαριωνᾶς.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and יוֹנָה); son of Jonas (or Jonah); Bar-jonas, an Israelite:--Bar-jona.

βαρνάβας.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and נְבִיא); son of Nabas (i.e. prophecy); Barnabas, an Israelite:--Barnabas.

glosses: probably from the same as βάσις (through the notion of going down
βάρος.shortDef: probably from the same as βάσις (through the notion of going down; compare βάθος); weight; in the New Testament only, figuratively, a load, abundance, authority:--burden(-some), weight.

glosses: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and probably צְבָא)
βαρσαβᾶς.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and probably צְבָא); son of Sabas (or Tsaba); Bar-sabas, the name of two Israelites:--Barsabas.

βαρτιμαῖος.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (בַּר and טָמֵא); son of Timæus (or the unclean); Bar-timæus, an Israelite:--Bartimæus.

βαρύς.shortDef: from the same as βάρος; weighty, i.e. (fig) burdensome, grave:--grievous, heavy, weightier.

βαρύτιμος.shortDef: from βαρύς and τιμή; highly valuable:--very precious.

βασανίζω.shortDef: from βάσανος; to torture:--pain, toil, torment, toss, vex.

glosses: perhaps remotely from the same as βάσις (through the notion of going to the bottom)
βάσανος.shortDef: perhaps remotely from the same as βάσις (through the notion of going to the bottom); a touch-stone, i.e. (by analogy) torture:--torment.

βασιλεία.shortDef: from βασιλεύς; properly, royalty, i.e. (abstractly) rule, or (concretely) a realm (literally or figuratively):--kingdom, + reign.

βασίλειον.shortDef: neuter of βασίλειος; a palace:--king's court.

glosses: probably from βάσις (through the notion of a foundation of power)
βασιλεύς.shortDef: probably from βάσις (through the notion of a foundation of power); a sovereign (abstractly, relatively, or figuratively):--king.

βασιλεύω.shortDef: from βασιλεύς; to rule (literally or figuratively):--king, reign.

βασιλικός.shortDef: from βασιλεύς; regal (in relation), i.e. (literally) belonging to (or befitting) the sovereign (as land, dress, or a courtier), or (figuratively) preeminent:--king's, nobleman, royal.

βάσις.shortDef: from  (to walk); a pace ("base"), i.e. (by implication) the foot:--foot.

βασκαίνω.shortDef: akin to φάσκω; to malign, i.e. (by extension) to fascinate (by false representations):--bewitch.

glosses: perhaps remotely derived from the base of βάσις (through the idea of removal)
βαστάζω.shortDef: perhaps remotely derived from the base of βάσις (through the idea of removal); to lift, literally or figuratively (endure, declare, sustain, receive, etc.):--bear, carry, take up.

βάτος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בַּת); a bath, or measure for liquids:--measure.

βαττολογέω.shortDef: from  (a proverbial stammerer) and λόγος; to stutter, i.e. (by implication) to prate tediously:--use vain repetitions.

βδέλυγμα.shortDef: from βδελύσσω; a detestation, i.e. (specially) idolatry:--abomination.

βδελύσσω.shortDef: from a (presumed) derivative of  (to stink); to be disgusted, i.e. (by implication) detest (especially of idolatry):--abhor, abominable.

glosses: from the base of βάσις (through the idea of basality)
βέβαιος.shortDef: from the base of βάσις (through the idea of basality); stable (literally or figuratively):--firm, of force, stedfast, sure.

glosses: from the base of βάσις and  (a threshold)
βέβηλος.shortDef: from the base of βάσις and  (a threshold); accessible (as by crossing the door-way), i.e. (by implication, of Jewish notions) heathenish, wicked:--profane (person).

glosses: of Chaldee origin (by parody on בַּעַל זְבוּב)
βεελζεβούλ.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (by parody on בַּעַל זְבוּב); dung-god; Beelzebul, a name of Satan:--Beelzebub.

βελίαλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בְּלִיַּעַל); worthlessness; Belial, as an epithet of Satan:--Belial.

βέλος.shortDef: from βάλλω; a missile, i.e. spear or arrow:--dart.

glosses: neuter of a compound of a derivative of βάλλω (used for the comparative of ἀγαθός)
βελτίον.shortDef: neuter of a compound of a derivative of βάλλω (used for the comparative of ἀγαθός); better:--very well.

βενιαμίν.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בִּנְיָמִין); Benjamin, an Israelite:--Benjamin.

glosses: from a provincial form of φέρω and νίκη
βερνίκη.shortDef: from a provincial form of φέρω and νίκη; victorious; Bernice, a member of the Herodian family:--Bernice.

glosses: perhaps a provincial from a derivative of πέραν (Perœa
βέροια.shortDef: perhaps a provincial from a derivative of πέραν (Perœa, i.e. the region beyond the coast-line); Berœa, a place in Macedonia:--Berea.

βεροιαῖος.shortDef: from Βέροια; a Berœoean or native of Berœa:--of Berea.

βηθαβαρά.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בַּיִת and עֲבָרָה); ferry-house; Bethabara (i.e. Bethabarah), a place on the Jordan:--Bethabara.

βηθανία.shortDef: of Chaldee origin; date-house; Beth-any, a place in Palestine:--Bethany.

glosses: of Chaldee origin (compare בַּיִת and חֵסֵד)
βηθεσδά.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare בַּיִת and חֵסֵד); house of kindness; Beth-esda, a pool in Jerusalem:--Bethesda.

βηθλεέμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בֵּית לְעַפְרָה); Bethleem (i.e. Beth-lechem), a place in Palestine:--Bethlehem.

glosses: of Chaldee origin (compare בַּיִת and צַיָּד)
βηθσαϊδά.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare בַּיִת and צַיָּד); fishing-house; Bethsaida, a place in Palestine:--Bethsaida.

glosses: of Chaldee origin (compare בַּיִת and פַּג)
βηθφαγή.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare בַּיִת and פַּג); fig-house; Beth-phage, a place in Palestine:--Bethphage.

βῆμα.shortDef: from the base of βάσις; a step, i.e. foot-breath; by implication, a rostrum, i.e. a tribunal:--judgment-seat, set (foot) on, throne.

glosses: probably akin to βίος (through the idea of vital activity)
βία.shortDef: probably akin to βίος (through the idea of vital activity); force:--violence.

βιάζω.shortDef: from βία; to force, i.e. (reflexively) to crowd oneself (into), or (passively) to be seized:--press, suffer violence.

βιαστής.shortDef: from βιάζω; a forcer, i.e. (figuratively) energetic:--violent.

βιβλιαρίδιον.shortDef: a diminutive of βιβλίον; a booklet:--little book.

βιβλίον.shortDef: a diminutive of βίβλος; a roll:--bill, book, scroll, writing.

βίβλος.shortDef: properly, the inner bark of the papyrus plant, i.e. (by implication) a sheet or scroll of writing:--book.

glosses: a reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb (perhaps causative of βόσκω)
βιβρώσκω.shortDef: a reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb (perhaps causative of βόσκω); to eat:--eat.

βιθυνία.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Bithynia, a region of Asia:--Bithynia.

βίος.shortDef: a primary word; life, i.e. (literally) the present state of existence; by implication, the means of livelihood:--good, life, living.

βίωσις.shortDef: from βιόω; living (properly, the act, by implication, the mode):--manner of life.

βιωτικός.shortDef: from a derivative of βιόω; relating to the present existence:--of (pertaining to, things that pertain to) this life.

βλάπτω.shortDef: a primary verb; properly, to hinder, i.e. (by implication) to injure:--hurt.

βλαστάνω.shortDef: from  (a sprout); to germinate; by implication, to yield fruit:--bring forth, bud, spring (up).

glosses: perhaps the same as the base of βλαστάνω
βλάστος.shortDef: perhaps the same as the base of βλαστάνω; Blastus, an officer of Herod Agrippa:--Blastus.

βλασφημέω.shortDef: from βλάσφημος; to vilify; specially, to speak impiously:--(speak) blaspheme(-er, -mously, -my), defame, rail on, revile, speak evil.

βλασφημία.shortDef: from βλάσφημος; vilification (especially against God):--blasphemy, evil speaking, railing.

glosses: from a derivative of βλάπτω and φήμη
βλάσφημος.shortDef: from a derivative of βλάπτω and φήμη; scurrilious, i.e. calumnious (against men), or (specially) impious (against God):--blasphemer(-mous), railing.

βλέμμα.shortDef: from βλέπω; vision (properly concrete; by implication, abstract):--seeing.

βλέπω.shortDef: a primary verb; to look at (literally or figuratively):--behold, beware, lie, look (on, to), perceive, regard, see, sight, take heed. Compare ὀπτάνομαι.

βλητέος.shortDef: from βάλλω; fit to be cast (i.e. applied):--must be put.

βοανεργές.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (בֵּן and רְגַז); sons of commotion; Boanerges, an epithet of two of the apostles:--Boanerges.

glosses: apparently a prolonged form of a primary verb
βοάω.shortDef: apparently a prolonged form of a primary verb; to halloo, i.e. shout (for help or in a tumultuous way):--cry.

βοή.shortDef: from βοάω; a halloo, i.e. call (for aid, etc.):--cry.

βοήθεια.shortDef: from βοηθός; aid; specially, a rope or chain for frapping a vessel:--help.

βοηθέω.shortDef: from βοηθός; to aid or relieve:--help, succor.

βοηθός.shortDef: from βοή and theo (to run); a succorer:--helper.

βόθυνος.shortDef: akin to βαθύνω; a hole (in the ground); specially, a cistern:--ditch, pit.

βολή.shortDef: from βάλλω; a throw (as a measure of distance):--cast.

βολίζω.shortDef: from βολίς; to heave the lead:--sound.

βολίς.shortDef: from βάλλω; a missile, i.e. javelin:--dart.

βοόζ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בֹּעַז); Booz, (i.e. Boaz), an Israelite:--Booz.

βοῤῥᾶς.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; the north (properly, wind):--north.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb (compare βιβρώσκω
βόσκω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb (compare βιβρώσκω, βοῦς); to pasture; by extension to, fodder; reflexively, to graze:--feed, keep.

βοσόρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בְּעוֹר); Bosor (i.e. Beor), a Moabite:--Bosor.

βοτάνη.shortDef: from βόσκω; herbage (as if for grazing):--herb.

βότρυς.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a bunch (of grapes):--(vine) cluster (of the vine).

βουλευτής.shortDef: from βουλεύω; an adviser, i.e. (specially) a councillor or member of the Jewish Sanhedrin:--counsellor.

βουλεύω.shortDef: from βουλή; to advise, i.e. (reflexively) deliberate, or (by implication) resolve:--consult, take counsel, determine, be minded, purpose.

βουλή.shortDef: from βούλομαι; volition, i.e. (objectively) advice, or (by implication) purpose:--+ advise, counsel, will.

glosses: middle voice of a primary verb
βούλομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a primary verb; to "will," i.e. (reflexively) be willing:--be disposed, minded, intend, list, (be, of own) will (-ing). Compare θέλω.

βουνός.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; a hillock:--hill.

glosses: probably from the base of βόσκω
βοῦς.shortDef: probably from the base of βόσκω; an ox (as grazing), i.e. an animal of that species ("beef"):--ox.

βραβεῖον.shortDef: from  (an umpire of uncertain derivation); an award (of arbitration), i.e. (specially) a prize in the public games:--prize.

βραβεύω.shortDef: from the same as βραβεῖον; to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail):--rule.

βραδύνω.shortDef: from βραδύς; to delay:--be slack, tarry.

glosses: from βραδύς and a prolonged form of πλέω
βραδυπλοέω.shortDef: from βραδύς and a prolonged form of πλέω; to sail slowly:--sail slowly.

βραδύς.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; slow; figuratively, dull:--slow.

βραχίων.shortDef: properly, comparative of βραχύς, but apparently in the sense of  (to wield); the arm, i.e. (figuratively) strength:--arm.

βραχύς.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; short (of time, place, quantity, or number):--few words, little (space, while).

βρέφος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; an infant (properly, unborn) literally or figuratively:--babe, (young) child, infant.

βρέχω.shortDef: a primary verb; to moisten (especially by a shower):--(send) rain, wash.

βρυγμός.shortDef: from βρύχω; a grating (of the teeth):--gnashing.

βρύχω.shortDef: a primary verb; to grate the teeth (in pain or rage):--gnash.

βρύω.shortDef: a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. (by implication) to gush:--send forth.

βρῶμα.shortDef: from the base of βιβρώσκω; food (literally or figuratively), especially (ceremonially) articles allowed or forbidden by the Jewish law:--meat, victuals.

βρῶσις.shortDef: from the base of βιβρώσκω; (abstractly) eating (literally or figuratively); by extension (concretely) food (literally or figuratively):--eating, food, meat.

βυθίζω.shortDef: from βυθός; to sink; by implication, to drown:--begin to sink, drown.

βυθός.shortDef: a variation of βάθος; depth, i.e. (by implication) the sea:--deep.

βύσσινος.shortDef: from βύσσος; made of linen (neuter a linen cloth):--fine linen.

βύσσος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (בּוּץ); white linen:--fine linen.

βωμός.shortDef: from the base of βάσις; properly, a stand, i.e. (specially) an altar:--altar.

γαββαθά.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare גַּב); the knoll; gabbatha, a vernacular term for the Roman tribunal in Jerusalem:-- Gabbatha.

γαβριήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גַּבְרִיאֵל); Gabriel, an archangel:--Gabriel.

γάδ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גָּד); Gad, a tribe of Israelites:--Gad.

glosses: from  (a town east of the Jordan)
γαδαρηνός.shortDef: from  (a town east of the Jordan); a Gadarene or inhabitant of Gadara:--Gadarene.

γάζα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עַזָּה); Gazah (i.e. Azzah), a place in Palestine:--Gaza.

γαζοφυλάκιον.shortDef: from γάζα and φυλακή; a treasure-house, i.e. a court in the temple for the collection-boxes:--treasury.

γάϊος.shortDef: of Latin origin; Gaius (i.e. Caius), a Christian:--Gaius.

γαλάτης.shortDef: from Γαλατία; a Galatian or inhabitant of Galatia:--Galatian.

γαλατία.shortDef: of foreign origin; Galatia, a region of Asia:--Galatia.

γαλατικός.shortDef: from Γαλατία; Galatic or relating to Galatia:--of Galatia.

γαλιλαία.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גָּלִיל); Galilæa (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine:--Galilee.

γαλιλαῖος.shortDef: from Γαλιλαία; Galilean or belonging to Galilea:--Galilean, of Galilee.

γαλλίων.shortDef: of Latin origin; Gallion (i.e. Gallio), a Roman officer:--Gallio.

γαμαλιήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גַּמְלִיאֵל); Gamaliel (i.e. Gamliel), an Israelite:--Gamaliel.

γαμέω.shortDef: from γάμος; to wed (of either sex):--marry (a wife).

γαμίσκω.shortDef: from γάμος; to espouse (a daughter to a husband):--give in marriage.

γάρ.shortDef: a primary particle; properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles):--and, as, because (that), but, even, for, indeed, no doubt, seeing, then, therefore, verily, what, why, yet.

γαστήρ.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; the stomach; by analogy, the matrix; figuratively, a gourmand:--belly, + with child, womb.

glosses: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed):--and besides
γέ.shortDef: a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed):--and besides, doubtless, at least, yet.

γεδεών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גִּדְעוֹן); Gedeon (i.e. Gid(e)on), an Israelite:--Gedeon (in the King James Version).

γέεννα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גַּיְא and הִנֹּם); valley of (the son of) Hinnom; ge-henna (or Ge-Hinnom), a valley of Jerusalem, used (figuratively) as a name for the place (or state) of everlasting punishment:--hell.

glosses: of Chaldee origin (compare גַּת and שֶׁמֶן)
γεθσημανῆ.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare גַּת and שֶׁמֶן); oil-press; Gethsemane, a garden near Jerusalem:--Gethsemane.

γείτων.shortDef: from γῆ; a neighbour (as adjoining one's ground); by implication, a friend:--neighbour.

γελάω.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; to laugh (as a sign of joy or satisfaction):--laugh.

γέλως.shortDef: from γελάω; laughter (as a mark of gratification):--laughter.

γεμίζω.shortDef: transitive from γέμω; to fill entirely:--fill (be) full.

γέμω.shortDef: a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. be full:--be full.

γενεά.shortDef: from (a presumed derivative of) γένος; a generation; by implication, an age (the period or the persons):--age, generation, nation, time.

γενεαλογέω.shortDef: from γενεά and λόγος; to reckon by generations, i.e. trace in genealogy:--count by descent.

γενεαλογία.shortDef: from the same as γενεαλογέω; tracing by generations, i.e. "genealogy":--genealogy.

glosses: neuter plural of a derivative of γένεσις
γενέσια.shortDef: neuter plural of a derivative of γένεσις; birthday ceremonies:--birthday.

γένεσις.shortDef: from the same as γενεά; nativity; figuratively, nature:--generation, nature(-ral).

glosses: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of γενεά
γενετή.shortDef: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of γενεά; birth:--birth.

γεννάω.shortDef: from a variation of γένος; to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate:--bear, beget, be born, bring forth, conceive, be delivered of, gender, make, spring.

γέννημα.shortDef: from γεννάω; offspring; by analogy, produce (literally or figuratively):--fruit, generation.

γεννησαρέτ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (compare כִּנְּרוֹת); Gennesaret (i.e. Kinnereth), a lake and plain in Palestine:--Gennesaret.

γεννητός.shortDef: from γεννάω; born:--they that are born.

γένος.shortDef: from γίνομαι; "kin" (abstract or concrete, literal or figurative, individual or collective):--born, country(-man), diversity, generation, kind(-red), nation, offspring, stock.

γεργεσηνός.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גִּרְגָּשִׁי); a Gergesene (i.e. Girgashite) or one of the aborigines of Palestine:--Gergesene.

γερουσία.shortDef: from γέρων; the eldership, i.e. (collectively) the Jewish Sanhedrin:--senate.

γεύομαι.shortDef: a primary verb; to taste; by implication, to eat; figuratively, to experience (good or ill):--eat, taste.

glosses: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of γεωργός
γεώργιον.shortDef: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of γεωργός; cultivable, i.e. a farm:--husbandry.

glosses: from γῆ and the base of ἔργον
γεωργός.shortDef: from γῆ and the base of ἔργον; a land-worker, i.e. farmer:--husbandman.

γῆ.shortDef: contracted from a primary word; soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application):--country, earth(-ly), ground, land, world.

γηράσκω.shortDef: from γῆρας; to be senescent:--be (wax) old.

glosses: a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb
γίνομαι.shortDef: a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb; to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.):--arise, be assembled, be(-come, -fall, -have self), be brought (to pass), (be) come (to pass), continue, be divided, draw, be ended, fall, be finished, follow, be found, be fulfilled, + God forbid, grow, happen, have, be kept, be made, be married, be ordained to be, partake, pass, be performed, be published, require, seem, be showed, X soon as it was, sound, be taken, be turned, use, wax, will, would, be wrought.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb
γινώσκω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed):--allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand.

γλεῦκος.shortDef: akin to γλυκύς; sweet wine, i.e. (properly) must (fresh juice), but used of the more saccharine (and therefore highly inebriating) fermented wine:--new wine.

γλυκύς.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; sweet (i.e. not bitter nor salt):--sweet, fresh.

γλῶσσα.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; the tongue; by implication, a language (specially, one naturally unacquired):--tongue.

glosses: from γλῶσσα and the base of κόσμος
γλωσσόκομον.shortDef: from γλῶσσα and the base of κόσμος; properly, a case (to keep mouthpieces of wind-instruments in) i.e. (by extension) a casket or (specially) purse:--bag.

glosses: by variation for a derivative from  (to tease cloth)
γναφεύς.shortDef: by variation for a derivative from  (to tease cloth); a cloth-dresser:--fuller.

γνήσιος.shortDef: from the same as γενέσια; legitimate (of birth), i.e. genuine:--own, sincerity, true.

γνησίως.shortDef: adverb from γνήσιος; genuinely, i.e. really:--naturally.

γνόφος.shortDef: akin to νέφος; gloom (as of a storm):--blackness.

γνώμη.shortDef: from γινώσκω; cognition, i.e. (subjectively) opinion, or (objectively) resolve (counsel, consent, etc.):--advice, + agree, judgment, mind, purpose, will.

γνωρίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of γινώσκω; to make known; subjectively, to know:--certify, declare, make known, give to understand, do to wit, wot.

γνῶσις.shortDef: from γινώσκω; knowing (the act), i.e. (by implication) knowledge:--knowledge, science.

γνωστός.shortDef: from γινώσκω; well-known:--acquaintance, (which may be) known, notable.

γόης.shortDef: from  (to wail); properly, a wizard (as muttering spells), i.e. (by implication) an imposter:--seducer.

γολγοθᾶ.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare גֻּלְגֹּלֶת); the skull; Golgotha, a knoll near Jerusalem:--Golgotha.

γόμοῤῥα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֲמֹרָה); Gomorrha (i.e. Amorah), a place near the Dead Sea:--Gomorrha.

γόμος.shortDef: from γέμω; a load (as filling), i.e. (specially) a cargo, or (by extension) wares:--burden, merchandise.

γονεύς.shortDef: from the base of γίνομαι; a parent:--parent.

glosses: from a compound of γόνυ and the alternate of πίπτω
γονυπετέω.shortDef: from a compound of γόνυ and the alternate of πίπτω; to fall on the knee:--bow the knee, kneel down.

γράμμα.shortDef: from γράφω; a writing, i.e. a letter, note, epistle, book, etc.; plural learning:--bill, learning, letter, scripture, writing, written.

γραμματεύς.shortDef: from γράμμα. a writer, i.e. (professionally) scribe or secretary:--scribe, town-clerk.

γραφή.shortDef: from γράφω; a document, i.e. holy Writ (or its contents or a statement in it):--scripture.

γράφω.shortDef: a primary verb; to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe:--describe, write(-ing, -ten).

γραώδης.shortDef: from  (an old woman) and εἶδος; crone-like, i.e. silly:--old wives'.

γρηγορεύω.shortDef: from ἐγείρω; to keep awake, i.e. watch (literally or figuratively):--be vigilant, wake, (be) watch(-ful).

γυμνάζω.shortDef: from γυμνός; to practise naked (in the games), i.e. train (figuratively):--exercise.

γυμνητεύω.shortDef: from a derivative of γυμνός; to strip, i.e. (reflexively) go poorly clad:--be naked.

γυμνός.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative):--naked.

γυναικάριον.shortDef: a diminutive from γυνή; a little (i.e. foolish) woman:--silly woman.

glosses: probably from the base of γίνομαι
γυνή.shortDef: probably from the base of γίνομαι; a woman; specially, a wife:--wife, woman.

γώγ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (גּוֹג); Gog, a symbolic name for some future Antichrist:--Gog.

γωνία.shortDef: probably akin to γόνυ; an angle:--corner, quarter.

δαβίδ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (דָּוִד); Dabid (i.e. David), the Israelite king:--David.

δαιμονίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from δαίμων; to be exercised by a dæmon:--have a (be vexed with, be possessed with) devil(-s).

glosses: neuter of a derivative of δαίμων
δαιμόνιον.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of δαίμων; a dæmonic being; by extension a deity:--devil, god.

δαίμων.shortDef: from  (to distribute fortunes); a dæmon or supernatural spirit (of a bad nature):--devil.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary root
δάκνω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary root; to bite, i.e. (figuratively) thwart:--bite.

δακρύω.shortDef: from δάκρυ; to shed tears:--weep. Compare κλαίω.

δαλμανουθά.shortDef: probably of Chaldee origin; Dalmanutha, a place in Palestine:--Dalmanutha.

δαλματία.shortDef: probably of foreign derivation; Dalmatia, a region of Europe:--Dalmatia.

glosses: a variation of an obsolete primary of the same meaning
δαμάζω.shortDef: a variation of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to tame:--tame.

glosses: probably from the base of δαμάζω
δάμαλις.shortDef: probably from the base of δαμάζω; a heifer (as tame):--heifer.

glosses: probably from the base of δαμάζω
δάμαρις.shortDef: probably from the base of δαμάζω; perhaps gentle; Damaris, an Athenian woman:--Damaris.

δαμασκηνός.shortDef: from Δαμασκός; a Damascene or inhabitant of Damascus:--Damascene.

δαμασκός.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (דַּמֶּשֶׂק); Damascus, a city of Syria:--Damascus.

δανείζω.shortDef: from δάνειον; to loan on interest; reflexively, to borrow:--borrow, lend.

δάνειον.shortDef: from  (a gift); probably akin to the base of δίδωμι; a loan:--debt.

δανιήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (דָנִיֵּאל); Daniel, an Israelite:--Daniel.

δαπανάω.shortDef: from δαπάνη; to expend, i.e. (in a good sense) to incur cost, or (in a bad one) to waste:--be at charges, consume, spend.

δέ.shortDef: a primary particle (adversative or continuative); but, and, etc.:--also, and, but, moreover, now (often unexpressed in English).

δέησις.shortDef: from δέομαι; a petition:--prayer, request, supplication.

glosses: 3rd person singular active present of δέω
δεῖ.shortDef: 3rd person singular active present of δέω; also deon deh-on'; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding):--behoved, be meet, must (needs), (be) need(-ful), ought, should.

δεῖγμα.shortDef: from the base of δεικνύω; a specimen (as shown):--example.

δειγματίζω.shortDef: from δεῖγμα; to exhibit:--make a shew.

glosses: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning
δεικνύω.shortDef: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to show (literally or figuratively):--shew.

δειλιάω.shortDef: from δειλία; to be timid:--be afraid.

glosses: probably from the same as δεινῶς (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful
δεῖνα.shortDef: probably from the same as δεινῶς (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange); so and so (when the person is not specified):--such a man.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of the same as δειλός
δεινῶς.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of the same as δειλός; terribly, i.e. excessively:--grievously, vehemently.

δειπνέω.shortDef: from δεῖπνον; to dine, i.e. take the principle (or evening) meal:--sup (X -er).

δεῖπνον.shortDef: from the same as δαπάνη; dinner, i.e. the chief meal (usually in the evening):--feast, supper.

glosses: the compound of a derivative of the base of δειλός and δαίμων
δεισιδαιμονέστερος.shortDef: the compound of a derivative of the base of δειλός and δαίμων; more religious than others:--too superstitious.

δεισιδαιμονία.shortDef: from the same as δεισιδαιμονέστερος; religion:--superstition.

δεκαδύο.shortDef: from δέκα and δύο; two and ten, i.e. twelve:--twelve.

δεκαπέντε.shortDef: from δέκα and πέντε; ten and five, i.e. fifteen:--fifteen.

δεκάπολις.shortDef: from δέκα and πόλις; the ten-city region; the Decapolis, a district in Syria:--Decapolis.

δεκατέσσαρες.shortDef: from δέκα and τέσσαρες; ten and four, i.e. fourteen:--fourteen.

δεκάτη.shortDef: feminine of δέκατος; a tenth, i.e. as a percentage or (technically) tithe:--tenth (part), tithe.

δεκατόω.shortDef: from δεκάτη; to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth:--pay (receive) tithes.

δελεάζω.shortDef: from the base of δόλος; to entrap, i.e. (figuratively) delude:--allure, beguile, entice.

δεξιολάβος.shortDef: from δεξιός and λαμβάνω; a guardsman (as if taking the right) or light-armed soldier:--spearman.

δεξιός.shortDef: from δέχομαι; the right side or (feminine) hand (as that which usually takes):--right (hand, side).

δέομαι.shortDef: middle voice of δέω; to beg (as binding oneself), i.e. petition:--beseech, pray (to), make request. Compare πυνθάνομαι.

δερβαῖος.shortDef: from Δέρβη; a Derbæan or inhabitant of Derbe:--of Derbe.

δέρβη.shortDef: of foreign origin; Derbe, a place in Asia Minor:--Derbe.

δερμάτινος.shortDef: from δέρμα; made of hide:--leathern, of a skin.

δέρω.shortDef: a primary verb; properly, to flay, i.e. (by implication) to scourge, or (by analogy) to thrash:--beat, smite.

δεσμεύω.shortDef: from a (presumed) derivative of δεσμέω; to be a binder (captor), i.e. to enchain (a prisoner), to tie on (a load):-- bind.

δεσμέω.shortDef: from δεσμόν; to tie, i.e. shackle:--bind.

δέσμιος.shortDef: from δεσμόν; a captive (as bound):--in bonds, prisoner.

glosses: neuter and masculine respectively from δέω
δεσμόν.shortDef: neuter and masculine respectively from δέω; a band, i.e. ligament (of the body) or shackle (of a prisoner); figuratively, an impediment or disability:--band, bond, chain, string.

δεσμοφύλαξ.shortDef: from δεσμόν and φύλαξ; a jailer (as guarding the prisoners):--jailor, keeper of the prison.

glosses: from a derivative of δεσμόν (equivalent to δεσμέω)
δεσμωτήριον.shortDef: from a derivative of δεσμόν (equivalent to δεσμέω); a place of bondage, i.e. a dungeon:--prison.

δεσμώτης.shortDef: from the same as δεσμωτήριον; (passively) a captive:--prisoner.

δεσπότης.shortDef: perhaps from δέω and  (a husband); an absolute ruler ("despot"):--Lord, master.

δεῦρο.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto:--come (hither), hither(-to).

glosses: from δεῦρο and an imperative form of  (to go)
δεῦτε.shortDef: from δεῦρο and an imperative form of  (to go); come hither!:--come, X follow.

δευτεραῖος.shortDef: from δεύτερος; secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day:--next day.

δευτερόπρωτος.shortDef: from δεύτερος and πρῶτος; second-first, i.e. (specially) a designation of the Sabbath immediately after the Paschal week (being the second after Passover day, and the first of the seven Sabbaths intervening before Pentecost):--second … after the first.

δεύτερος.shortDef: as the comparative of δύο; (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb):--afterward, again, second(-arily, time).

glosses: middle voice of a primary verb
δέχομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a primary verb; to receive (in various applications, literally or figuratively):--accept, receive, take. Compare λαμβάνω.

δέω.shortDef: a primary verb; to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively):--bind, be in bonds, knit, tie, wind. See also δεῖ, δέομαι.

δή.shortDef: probably akin to δέ; a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc.:--also, and, doubtless, now, therefore.

δῆλος.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; clear:--+ bewray, certain, evident, manifest.

δηλόω.shortDef: from δῆλος; to make plain (by words):--declare, shew, signify.

δημᾶς.shortDef: probably for Δημήτριος; Demas, a Christian:--Demas.

glosses: from a compound of δῆμος and ἀγορά
δημηγορέω.shortDef: from a compound of δῆμος and ἀγορά; to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly:--make an oration.

δημήτριος.shortDef: from  (Ceres); Demetrius, the name of an Ephesian and of a Christian:--Demetrius.

δημιουργός.shortDef: from δῆμος and ἔργον; a worker for the people, i.e. mechanic (spoken of the Creator):--maker.

δῆμος.shortDef: from δέω; the public (as bound together socially):--people.

δημόσιος.shortDef: from δῆμος; public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public:--common, openly, publickly.

δηνάριον.shortDef: of Latin origin; a denarius (or ten asses):--pence, penny(-worth).

δήποτε.shortDef: from δή and ποτέ; a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time:--(what-)soever.

δήπου.shortDef: from δή and πού; a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless:--verily.

glosses: a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act
διά.shortDef: a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act; through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional):--after, always, among, at, to avoid, because of (that), briefly, by, for (cause) … fore, from, in, by occasion of, of, by reason of, for sake, that, thereby, therefore, X though, through(-out), to, wherefore, with (-in). In composition it retains the same general importance.

glosses: from διά and the base of βάσις
διαβαίνω.shortDef: from διά and the base of βάσις; to cross:--come over, pass (through).

διαβάλλω.shortDef: from διά and βάλλω; (figuratively) to traduce:--accuse.

glosses: middle voice of a compound of διά and βεβαιόω
διαβεβαιόομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a compound of διά and βεβαιόω; to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e. asseverate:--affirm constantly.

διαβλέπω.shortDef: from διά and βλέπω; to look through, i.e. recover full vision:--see clearly.

διάβολος.shortDef: from διαβάλλω; a traducer; specially, Satan (compare שָׂטָן):--false accuser, devil, slanderer.

glosses: from διά and the base of ἄγγελος
διαγγέλλω.shortDef: from διά and the base of ἄγγελος; to herald thoroughly:--declare, preach, signify.

διαγίνομαι.shortDef: from διά and γίνομαι; to elapse meanwhile:--X after, be past, be spent.

διαγινώσκω.shortDef: from διά and γινώσκω; to know thoroughly, i.e. ascertain exactly:--(would) enquire, know the uttermost.

διαγνωρίζω.shortDef: from γραπτός and γνωρίζω; to tell abroad:--make known.

διαγογγύζω.shortDef: from διά and γογγύζω; to complain throughout a crowd:--murmur.

διαγρηγορέω.shortDef: from διά and γρηγορεύω; to waken thoroughly:--be awake.

διάγω.shortDef: from διά and ἄγω; to pass time or life:--lead life, living.

διαδέχομαι.shortDef: from διά and δέχομαι; to receive in turn, i.e. (figuratively) succeed to:--come after.

glosses: from a compound of διά and δέω
διάδημα.shortDef: from a compound of διά and δέω; a "diadem" (as bound about the head):--crown. Compare στέφανος.

διαδίδωμι.shortDef: from διά and δίδωμι; to give throughout a crowd, i.e. deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor):--(make) distribute(-ion), divide, give.

διάδοχος.shortDef: from διαδέχομαι; a successor in office:--room.

διαζώννυμι.shortDef: from διά and ζώννυμι; to gird tightly:--gird.

διαθήκη.shortDef: from διατίθεμαι; properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will):--covenant, testament.

διαίρεσις.shortDef: from διαιρέω; a distinction or (concretely) variety:--difference, diversity.

διαιρέω.shortDef: from διά and αἱρέομαι; to separate, i.e. distribute:--divide.

διακαθαρίζω.shortDef: from διά and καθαρίζω; to cleanse perfectly, i.e. (specially) winnow:--thoroughly purge.

glosses: middle voice from διά and a compound of κατά and ἐλέγχω
διακατελέγχομαι.shortDef: middle voice from διά and a compound of κατά and ἐλέγχω; to prove downright, i.e. confute:--convince.

διακονέω.shortDef: from διάκονος; to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon:--(ad-)minister (unto), serve, use the office of a deacon.

διακονία.shortDef: from διάκονος; attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the Christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate):--(ad-)minister(-ing, -tration, -try), office, relief, service(-ing).

glosses: probably from an obsolete  (to run on errands
διάκονος.shortDef: probably from an obsolete  (to run on errands; compare διώκω); an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess):--deacon, minister, servant.

διακόσιοι.shortDef: from δίς and ἑκατόν; two hundred:--two hundred.

glosses: middle voice from διά and ἀκούω
διακούομαι.shortDef: middle voice from διά and ἀκούω; to hear throughout, i.e. patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea):--hear.

διακρίνω.shortDef: from διά and κρίνω; to separate thoroughly, i.e. (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate:--contend, make (to) differ(-ence), discern, doubt, judge, be partial, stagger, waver.

διακωλύω.shortDef: from διά and κωλύω; to hinder altogether, i.e. utterly prohibit:--forbid.

διαλαλέω.shortDef: from διά and λαλέω; to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish:--commune, noise abroad.

glosses: middle voice from διά and λέγω
διαλέγομαι.shortDef: middle voice from διά and λέγω; to say thoroughly, i.e. discuss (in argument or exhortation):--dispute, preach (unto), reason (with), speak.

διαλείπω.shortDef: from διά and λείπω; to leave off in the middle, i.e. intermit:--cease.

διάλεκτος.shortDef: from διαλέγομαι; a (mode of) discourse, i.e. "dialect":--language, tongue.

διαλλάσσω.shortDef: from διά and ἀλλάσσω; to change thoroughly, i.e. (mentally) to conciliate:--reconcile.

διαλογίζομαι.shortDef: from διά and λογίζομαι; to reckon thoroughly, i.e. (genitive case) to deliberate (by reflection or discussion):--cast in mind, consider, dispute, muse, reason, think.

διαλογισμός.shortDef: from διαλογίζομαι; discussion, i.e. (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate:--dispute, doubtful(-ing), imagination, reasoning, thought.

διαλύω.shortDef: from διά and λύω; to dissolve utterly:--scatter.

διαμαρτύρομαι.shortDef: from διά and μαρτυρέω; to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively:--charge, testify (unto), witness.

διαμάχομαι.shortDef: from διά and μάχομαι; to fight fiercely (in altercation):--strive.

διαμένω.shortDef: from διά and μένω; to stay constantly (in being or relation):--continue, remain.

διαμερίζω.shortDef: from διά and μερίζω; to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension):--cloven, divide, part.

διαμερισμός.shortDef: from διαμερίζω; disunion (of opinion and conduct):--division.

glosses: from διά and the base of νόμος
διανέμω.shortDef: from διά and the base of νόμος; to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate:--spread.

διανεύω.shortDef: from διά and νεύω; to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space:--beckon.

glosses: from a compound of διά and νοιέω
διανόημα.shortDef: from a compound of διά and νοιέω; something thought through, i.e. a sentiment:--thought.

διάνοια.shortDef: from διά and νοῦς; deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise:-- imagination, mind, understanding.

διανοίγω.shortDef: from διά and ἀνοίγω; to open thoroughly, literally (as a first-born) or figuratively (to expound):--open.

glosses: from διά and a derivative of νύξ
διανυκτερεύω.shortDef: from διά and a derivative of νύξ; to sit up the whole night:--continue all night.

διανύω.shortDef: from διά and  (to effect); to accomplish thoroughly:--finish.

glosses: from διά and the genitive case of πᾶς
διαπαντός.shortDef: from διά and the genitive case of πᾶς; through all time, i.e. (adverbially) constantly:--alway(-s), continually.

glosses: from διά and a derivative of the base of πέραν
διαπεράω.shortDef: from διά and a derivative of the base of πέραν; to cross entirely:--go over, pass (over), sail over.
