διαπλέω.shortDef: from διά and πλέω; to sail through:--sail over.

glosses: from διά and a derivative of πόνος
διαπονέω.shortDef: from διά and a derivative of πόνος; to toil through, i.e. (passively) be worried:--be grieved.

διαπορεύομαι.shortDef: from διά and πορεύομαι; to travel through:--go through, journey in, pass by.

διαπορέω.shortDef: from διά and ἀπορέω; to be thoroughly nonplussed:--(be in) doubt, be (much) perplexed.

διαπραγματεύομαι.shortDef: from διά and πραγματεύομαι; to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. (transitively and by implication) to earn in business:--gain by trading.

glosses: from διά and the base of πρίζω
διαπρίω.shortDef: from διά and the base of πρίζω; to saw asunder, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate:--cut (to the heart).

διαρπάζω.shortDef: from διά and ἁρπάζω; to seize asunder, i.e. plunder:--spoil.

διαῤῥήσσω.shortDef: from διά and ῥήγνυμι; to tear asunder:--break, rend.

διασαφέω.shortDef: from διά and  (clear); to clear thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) declare:--tell unto.

διασείω.shortDef: from διά and σείω; to shake thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to intimidate:--do violence to.

διασκορπίζω.shortDef: from διά and σκορπίζω; to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander:--disperse, scatter (abroad), strew, waste.

διασπάω.shortDef: from διά and σπάω; to draw apart, i.e. sever or dismember:--pluck asunder, pull in pieces.

διασπείρω.shortDef: from διά and σπείρω; to sow throughout, i.e. (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands:--scatter abroad.

διασπορά.shortDef: from διασπείρω; dispersion, i.e. (specially and concretely) the (converted) Israelite resident in Gentile countries:--(which are) scattered (abroad).

glosses: middle voice from διά and στέλλω
διαστέλλομαι.shortDef: middle voice from διά and στέλλω; to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e. (by implication) to enjoin:--charge, that which was (give) commanded(-ment).

διαστρέφω.shortDef: from διά and στρέφω; to distort, i.e. (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt:--perverse(-rt), turn away.

διασώζω.shortDef: from διά and σώζω; to save thoroughly, i.e. (by implication or analogy) to cure, preserve, rescue, etc.:--bring safe, escape (safe), heal, make perfectly whole, save.

διάταγμα.shortDef: from διατάσσω; an arrangement, i.e. (authoritative) edict:--commandment.

διαταράσσω.shortDef: from διά and ταράσσω; to disturb wholly, i.e. agitate (with alarm):--trouble.

διατάσσω.shortDef: from διά and τάσσω; to arrange thoroughly, i.e. (specially) institute, prescribe, etc.:--appoint, command, give, (set in) order, ordain.

διατελέω.shortDef: from διά and τελέω; to accomplish thoroughly, i.e. (subjectively) to persist:--continue.

διατηρέω.shortDef: from διά and τηρέω; to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly:--keep.

διατί.shortDef: from διά and τίς; through what cause ?, i.e. why?:--wherefore, why.

glosses: middle voice from διά and τίθημι
διατίθεμαι.shortDef: middle voice from διά and τίθημι; to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest):--appoint, make, testator.

glosses: from διά and the base of τρίβος
διατρίβω.shortDef: from διά and the base of τρίβος; to wear through (time), i.e. remain:--abide, be, continue, tarry.

glosses: from a compound of διά and τρέφω
διατροφή.shortDef: from a compound of διά and τρέφω; nourishment:--food.

διαυγάζω.shortDef: from διά and αὐγάζω; to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day):--dawn.

διαφανής.shortDef: from διά and φαίνω; appearing through, i.e. "diaphanous":--transparent.

διαφέρω.shortDef: from διά and φέρω; to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass:--be better, carry, differ from, drive up and down, be (more) excellent, make matter, publish, be of more value.

διαφεύγω.shortDef: from διά and φεύγω; to flee through, i.e. escape:--escape.

glosses: from διά and a derivative of φήμη
διαφημίζω.shortDef: from διά and a derivative of φήμη; to report thoroughly, i.e. divulgate:--blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame.

διαφθείρω.shortDef: from διαβάλλω and φθείρω; to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert):--corrupt, destroy, perish.

διάφορος.shortDef: from διαφέρω; varying; also surpassing:--differing, divers, more excellent.

διαφυλάσσω.shortDef: from διά and φυλάσσω; to guard thoroughly, i.e. protect:--keep.

glosses: from διά and a derivative of χείρ
διαχειρίζομαι.shortDef: from διά and a derivative of χείρ; to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon:--kill, slay.

glosses: from διά and the middle voice of χωρίζω
διαχωρίζομαι.shortDef: from διά and the middle voice of χωρίζω; to remove (oneself) wholly, i.e. retire:--depart.

διδακτός.shortDef: from διδάσκω; (subjectively) instructed, or (objectively) communicated by teaching:--taught, which … teacheth.

διδασκαλία.shortDef: from διδάσκαλος; instruction (the function or the information):--doctrine, learning, teaching.

διδάσκαλος.shortDef: from διδάσκω; an instructor (genitive case or specially):--doctor, master, teacher.

glosses: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb  (to learn)
διδάσκω.shortDef: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb  (to learn); to teach (in the same broad application):--teach.

διδαχή.shortDef: from διδάσκω; instruction (the act or the matter):--doctrine, hath been taught.

δίδραχμον.shortDef: from δίς and δραχμή; a double drachma (didrachm):--tribute.

δίδυμος.shortDef: prolongation from δίς; double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian:--Didymus.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses)
δίδωμι.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses); to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection):--adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield.

διεγείρω.shortDef: from διά and ἐγείρω; to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively):--arise, awake, raise, stir up.

διέξοδος.shortDef: from διά and ἔξοδος; an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge):--highway.

διερμηνεύω.shortDef: from διά and ἑρμηνεύω; to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate:--expound, interpret(-ation).

διέρχομαι.shortDef: from διά and ἔρχομαι; to traverse (literally):--come, depart, go (about, abroad, everywhere, over, through, throughout), pass (by, over, through, throughout), pierce through, travel, walk through.

διερωτάω.shortDef: from διά and ἐρωτάω; to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation:--make enquiry for.

διετής.shortDef: from δίς and ἔτος; of two years (in age):--two years old.

διετία.shortDef: from διετής; a space of two years (biennium):--two years.

διηγέομαι.shortDef: from διά and ἡγέομαι; to relate fully:--declare, shew, tell.

glosses: neuter of a compound of διά and a derivative of an alternate of φέρω
διηνεκής.shortDef: neuter of a compound of διά and a derivative of an alternate of φέρω; carried through, i.e. (adverbially with εἰς and ὁ prefixed) perpetually:--+ continually, for ever.

διθάλασσος.shortDef: from δίς and θάλασσα; having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet:--where two seas meet.

glosses: from διά and the base of ἱκανός
διϊκνέομαι.shortDef: from διά and the base of ἱκανός; to reach through, i.e. penetrate:--pierce.

διΐστημι.shortDef: from διά and ἵστημι; to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene:--go further, be parted, after the space of.

glosses: from διά and a derivative of ἰσχυρός
διϊσχυρίζομαι.shortDef: from διά and a derivative of ἰσχυρός; to stout it through, i.e. asservate:--confidently (constantly) affirm.

δικαιοκρισία.shortDef: from δίκαιος and κρίσις; a just sentence:--righteous judgment.

δίκαιος.shortDef: from δίκη; equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively):--just, meet, right(-eous).

δικαιοσύνη.shortDef: from δίκαιος; equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification:--righteousness.

δικαιόω.shortDef: from δίκαιος; to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent:--free, justify(-ier), be righteous.

δικαίωμα.shortDef: from δικαιόω; an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision:--judgment, justification, ordinance, righteousness.

δικαστής.shortDef: from a derivative of δίκη; a judger:--judge.

δίκη.shortDef: probably from δεικνύω; right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution):--judgment, punish, vengeance.

glosses: probably from a primary verb  (to cast)
δίκτυον.shortDef: probably from a primary verb  (to cast); a seine (for fishing):--net.

δίλογος.shortDef: from δίς and λόγος; equivocal, i.e. telling a different story:--double-tongued.

διό.shortDef: from διά and ὅς; through which thing, i.e. consequently:--for which cause, therefore, wherefore.

διοδεύω.shortDef: from διά and ὁδεύω; to travel through:--go throughout, pass through.

διόπερ.shortDef: from διό and περ; on which very account:--wherefore.

glosses: from the alternate of Ζεύς and the alternate of πίπτω
διοπετής.shortDef: from the alternate of Ζεύς and the alternate of πίπτω; sky-fallen (i.e. an aerolite):--which fell down from Jupiter.

glosses: from a compound of διά and a derivative of ὀρθός
διόρθωσις.shortDef: from a compound of διά and a derivative of ὀρθός, meaning to straighten thoroughly; rectification, i.e. (specially) the Messianic restauration:--reformation.

διορύσσω.shortDef: from διά and ὀρύσσω; to penetrate burglariously:--break through (up).

glosses: from the alternate of Ζεύς and a form of the base of κοράσιον
διόσκουροι.shortDef: from the alternate of Ζεύς and a form of the base of κοράσιον; sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri:--Castor and Pollux.

διότι.shortDef: from διά and ὅτι; on the very account that, or inasmuch as:--because (that), for, therefore.

glosses: from the alternate of Ζεύς and τρέφω
διοτρεφής.shortDef: from the alternate of Ζεύς and τρέφω; Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity:--Diotrephes.

glosses: from δίς and (probably) the base of πλείων
διπλοῦς.shortDef: from δίς and (probably) the base of πλείων; two-fold:--double, two-fold more.

διστάζω.shortDef: from δίς; properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion):--doubt.

δίστομος.shortDef: from δίς and στόμα; double-edged:--with two edges, two-edged.

δισχίλιοι.shortDef: from δίς and χίλιοι; two thousand:--two thousand.

διϋλίζω.shortDef: from διά and   (to filter); to strain out:--strain at (probably by misprint).

διχάζω.shortDef: from a derivative of δίς; to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively, alienate):--set at variance.

glosses: from a derivative of δίς and στάσις
διχοστασία.shortDef: from a derivative of δίς and στάσις; disunion, i.e. (figuratively) dissension:--division, sedition.

glosses: from a compound of a derivative of δίς and a derivative of  (to cut)
διχοτομέω.shortDef: from a compound of a derivative of δίς and a derivative of  (to cut); to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely:--cut asunder (in sunder).

διψάω.shortDef: from a variation of δίψος; to thirst for (literally or figuratively):--(be, be a-)thirst(-y).

δίψυχος.shortDef: from δίς and ψυχή; two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose):--double minded.

glosses: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb  (to flee
διώκω.shortDef: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb  (to flee; compare the base of δειλός and διάκονος); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute:--ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward.

δόγμα.shortDef: from the base of δοκέω; a law (civil, ceremonial or ecclesiastical):--decree, ordinance.

δογματίζω.shortDef: from δόγμα; to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule:--be subject to ordinances.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb
δοκέω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb,   (used only in an alternate in certain tenses; compare the base of δεικνύω) of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly):--be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation, seem (good), suppose, think, trow.

δοκιμάζω.shortDef: from δόκιμος; to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve:--allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try.

δοκιμή.shortDef: from the same as δόκιμος; test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness:--experience(-riment), proof, trial.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of δοκιμή
δοκίμιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of δοκιμή; a testing; by implication, trustworthiness:--trial, trying.

δόκιμος.shortDef: from δοκέω; properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved:--approved, tried.

glosses: from δέχομαι (through the idea of holding up)
δοκός.shortDef: from δέχομαι (through the idea of holding up); a stick of timber:--beam.

δολιόω.shortDef: from δόλιος; to be guileful:--use deceit.

δόλος.shortDef: from an obsolete primary verb,  (probably meaning to decoy; compare δελεάζω); a trick (bait), i.e. (figuratively) wile:--craft, deceit, guile, subtilty.

δολόω.shortDef: from δόλος; to ensnare, i.e. (figuratively) adulterate:--handle deceitfully.

δόμα.shortDef: from the base of δίδωμι; a present:--gift.

δόξα.shortDef: from the base of δοκέω; glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective):--dignity, glory(-ious), honour, praise, worship.

δοξάζω.shortDef: from δόξα; to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application):--(make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify.

δόσις.shortDef: from the base of δίδωμι; a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift:--gift, giving.

δότης.shortDef: from the base of δίδωμι; a giver:--giver.

glosses: from a presumed compound of δοῦλος and ἄγω
δουλαγωγέω.shortDef: from a presumed compound of δοῦλος and ἄγω; to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue):--bring into subjection.

δουλεύω.shortDef: from δοῦλος; to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary):--be in bondage, (do) serve(-ice).

δούλη.shortDef: feminine of δοῦλος; a female slave (involuntarily or voluntarily):--handmaid(-en).

δοῦλος.shortDef: from δέω; a slave (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary; frequently, therefore in a qualified sense of subjection or subserviency):--bond(-man), servant.

δουλόω.shortDef: from δοῦλος; to enslave (literally or figuratively):--bring into (be under) bondage, X given, become (make) servant.

δοχή.shortDef: from δέχομαι; a reception, i.e. convivial entertainment:--feast.

glosses: probably from an alternate form of  (to look)
δράκων.shortDef: probably from an alternate form of  (to look); a fabulous kind of serpent (perhaps as supposed to fascinate):--dragon.

glosses: perhaps akin to the base of δράκων (through the idea of capturing)
δράσσομαι.shortDef: perhaps akin to the base of δράκων (through the idea of capturing); to grasp, i.e. (figuratively) entrap:--take.

δραχμή.shortDef: from δράσσομαι; a drachma or (silver) coin (as handled):--piece (of silver).

δρέπανον.shortDef: from  (to pluck); a gathering hook (especially for harvesting):--sickle.

δρόμος.shortDef: from the alternate of τρέχω; a race, i.e. (figuratively) career:--course.

glosses: a feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name)
δρούσιλλα.shortDef: a feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name); Drusilla, a member of the Herodian family:--Drusilla.

δύναμαι.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; to be able or possible:--be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power.

δύναμις.shortDef: from δύναμαι; force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself):--ability, abundance, meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work.

δυνάστης.shortDef: from δύναμαι; a ruler or officer:--of great authority, mighty, potentate.

δυνατέω.shortDef: from δυνατός; to be efficient (figuratively):--be mighty.

δυνατός.shortDef: from δύναμαι; powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter possible:--able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power, strong.

glosses: prolonged forms of an obsolete primary         (to sink)
δύνω.shortDef: prolonged forms of an obsolete primary         (to sink); to go "down":--set.

glosses: a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation
δυσ-.shortDef: a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation; used only in composition as a prefix; hard, i.e. with difficulty:--+ hard, + grievous, etc.

glosses: from δυσ- and a derivative of βαστάζω
δυσβάστακτος.shortDef: from δυσ- and a derivative of βαστάζω; oppressive:--grievous to be borne.

glosses: from δυσ- and a comparative of ἐντός (meaning a bowel)
δυσεντερία.shortDef: from δυσ- and a comparative of ἐντός (meaning a bowel); a "dysentery":--bloody flux.

glosses: from δυσ- and a presumed derivative of ἑρμηνεύω
δυσερμήνευτος.shortDef: from δυσ- and a presumed derivative of ἑρμηνεύω; difficult of explanation:--hard to be uttered.

δύσκολος.shortDef: from δυσ- and  (food); properly, fastidious about eating (peevish), i.e. (genitive case) impracticable:--hard.

δυσμή.shortDef: from δύνω; the sun-set, i.e. (by implication) the western region:--west.

glosses: from δυσ- and a derivative of νοιέω
δυσνόητος.shortDef: from δυσ- and a derivative of νοιέω; difficult of perception:--hard to be understood.

glosses: from a compound of δυσ- and φήμη
δυσφημία.shortDef: from a compound of δυσ- and φήμη; defamation:--evil report.

δώδεκα.shortDef: from δύο and δέκα; two and ten, i.e. a dozen:--twelve.

δωδεκάφυλον.shortDef: from δώδεκα and φυλή; the commonwealth of Israel:--twelve tribes.

δῶμα.shortDef: from  (to build); properly, an edifice, i.e. (specially) a roof:--housetop.

glosses: accusative case of δωρεά as adverb
δωρεάν.shortDef: accusative case of δωρεά as adverb; gratuitously (literally or figuratively):--without a cause, freely, for naught, in vain.

δωρέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from δῶρον; to bestow gratuitously:--give.

ἔα.shortDef: apparent imperative of ἐάω; properly, let it be, i.e. (as interjection) aha!:--let alone.

ἐάν.shortDef: from εἰ and ἄν; a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty:--before, but, except, (and) if, (if) so, (what-, whither-)soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to whom, (who-)so(-ever). See μή.

glosses: from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of αὐτός
ἑαυτοῦ.shortDef: from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of αὐτός; him- (her-, it-, them-, also (in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons) my-, thy-, our-, your-) self (selves), etc.:--alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own(-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them(-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves).

ἐάω.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; to let be, i.e. permit or leave alone:--commit, leave, let (alone), suffer. See also ἔα.

glosses: from ἕβδομος and a modified form of δέκα
ἑβδομήκοντα.shortDef: from ἕβδομος and a modified form of δέκα; seventy:--seventy, three score and ten.

ἑβδομηκοντάκις.shortDef: multiple adverb from ἑβδομήκοντα; seventy times:--seventy times.

ἐβέρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֵבֵר); Eber, a patriarch:--Eber.

ἑβραϊκός.shortDef: from Ἐβέρ; Hebraic or the Jewish language:--Hebrew.

ἑβραῖος.shortDef: from Ἐβέρ; a Hebræan (i.e. Hebrew) or Jew:--Hebrew.

ἑβραΐς.shortDef: from Ἐβέρ; the Hebraistic (Hebrew) or Jewish (Chaldee) language:--Hebrew.

ἑβραϊστί.shortDef: adverb from Ἑβραΐς; Hebraistically or in the Jewish (Chaldee) language:--in (the) Hebrew (tongue).

ἐγγίζω.shortDef: from ἐγγύς; to make near, i.e. (reflexively) approach:--approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.

ἐγγράφω.shortDef: from ἐν and γράφω; to "engrave", i.e. inscribe:--write (in).

ἔγγυος.shortDef: from ἐν and  (a limb); pledged (as if articulated by a member), i.e. a bondsman:--surety.

glosses: from a primary verb  (to squeeze or throttle
ἐγγύς.shortDef: from a primary verb  (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time):--from , at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.

glosses: neuter of the comparative of ἐγγύς
ἐγγύτερον.shortDef: neuter of the comparative of ἐγγύς; nearer:--nearer.

glosses: probably akin to the base of ἀγορά (through the idea of collecting one's faculties)
ἐγείρω.shortDef: probably akin to the base of ἀγορά (through the idea of collecting one's faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence):--awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up.

glosses: from ἐν and a derivative of καθίημι
ἐγκάθετος.shortDef: from ἐν and a derivative of καθίημι; subinduced, i.e. surreptitiously suborned as a lier-in-wait:--spy.

glosses: neuter plural of a presumed compound from ἐν and καινός
ἐγκαίνια.shortDef: neuter plural of a presumed compound from ἐν and καινός; innovatives, i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption):--dedication.

ἐγκαινίζω.shortDef: from ἐγκαίνια; to renew, i.e. inaugurate:--consecrate, dedicate.

ἐγκαλέω.shortDef: from ἐν and καλέω; to call in (as a debt or demand), i.e. bring to account (charge, criminate, etc.):--accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge.

ἐγκαταλείπω.shortDef: from ἐν and καταλείπω; to leave behind in some place, i.e. (in a good sense) let remain over, or (in a bad sense) to desert:--forsake, leave.

ἐγκατοικέω.shortDef: from ἐν and κατοικέω; to settle down in a place, i.e. reside:--dwell among.

glosses: from ἐν and a derivative of κέντρον
ἐγκεντρίζω.shortDef: from ἐν and a derivative of κέντρον; to prick in, i.e. ingraft:--graff in(-to).

ἔγκλημα.shortDef: from ἐγκαλέω; an accusation, i.e. offence alleged:--crime laid against, laid to charge.

glosses: middle voice from ἐν and  (to gird)
ἐγκομβόομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐν and  (to gird); to engirdle oneself (for labor), i.e. figuratively (the apron as being a badge of servitude) to wear (in token of mutual deference):--be clothed with.

ἐγκόπτω.shortDef: from ἐν and κόπτω; to cut into, i.e. (figuratively) impede, detain:--hinder, be tedious unto.

ἐγκρατεύομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐγκρατής; to exercise self-restraint (in diet and chastity):--can(-not) contain, be temperate.

ἐγκρατής.shortDef: from ἐν and κράτος; strong in a thing (masterful), i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) self-controlled (in appetite, etc.):--temperate.

ἐγκρίνω.shortDef: from ἐν and κρίνω; to judge in, i.e. count among:--make of the number.

ἐγκρύπτω.shortDef: from ἐν and κρύπτω; to conceal in, i.e. incorporate with:--hid in.

glosses: from ἐν and the base of κῦμα
ἔγκυος.shortDef: from ἐν and the base of κῦμα; swelling inside, i.e. pregnant:--great with child.

ἐγχρίω.shortDef: from ἐν and χρίω; to rub in (oil), i.e. besmear:--anoint.

glosses: a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic):--I
ἐγώ.shortDef: a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic):--I, me. For the other cases and the plural see ἐμέ, ἐμοί, ἐμοῦ, ἡμᾶς, ἡμεῖς, ἡμῖν, ἡμῶν, etc.

ἐδαφίζω.shortDef: from ἔδαφος; to raze:--lay even with the ground.

ἔδαφος.shortDef: from the base of ἑδραῖος; a basis (bottom), i.e. the soil:--ground.

ἑδραῖος.shortDef: from a derivative of  (to sit); sedentary, i.e. (by implication) immovable:--settled, stedfast.

ἑδραίωμα.shortDef: from a derivative of ἑδραῖος; a support, i.e. (figuratively) basis:--ground.

ἐζεκίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חִזְקִיָּה); Ezekias (i.e. Hezekeiah), an Israelite:--Ezekias.

ἐθελοθρησκεία.shortDef: from θέλω and θρησκεία; voluntary (arbitrary and unwarranted) piety, i.e. sanctimony:--will worship.

ἐθίζω.shortDef: from ἔθος; to accustom, i.e. (neuter passive participle) customary:--custom.

ἐθνάρχης.shortDef: from ἔθνος and ἀρχή; the governor (not king) of a district:--ethnarch.

ἐθνικός.shortDef: from ἔθνος; national ("ethnic"), i.e. (specially) a Gentile:--heathen (man).

ἐθνικῶς.shortDef: adverb from ἐθνικός; as a Gentile:--after the manner of Gentiles.

ἔθνος.shortDef: probably from ἔθω; a race (as of the same habit), i.e. a tribe; specially, a foreign (non-Jewish) one (usually, by implication, pagan):--Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

ἔθος.shortDef: from ἔθω; a usage (prescribed by habit or law):--custom, manner, be wont.

ἔθω.shortDef: a primary verb; to be used (by habit or conventionality); neuter perfect participle usage:--be custom (manner, wont).

εἰ.shortDef: a primary particle of conditionality; if, whether, that, etc.:--forasmuch as, if, that, (al-)though, whether. Often used in connection or composition with other particles, especially as in εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μή(γε), εἰ καί, εἰ μή, εἰ μή τι, εἴ περ, εἴ πως, εἴ τις, ἐκ. See also ἐάν.

glosses: second person singular present of εἰμί
εἶ.shortDef: second person singular present of εἰμί; thou art:--art, be.

εἴγε.shortDef: from εἰ and γέ; if indeed, seeing that, unless, (with negative) otherwise:--if (so be that, yet).

εἰ δὲ μή(γε).shortDef: from εἰ, δέ, and μή (sometimes with γέ added); but if not:--(or) else, if (not, otherwise), otherwise.

εἶδος.shortDef: from εἴδω; a view, i.e. form (literally or figuratively):--appearance, fashion, shape, sight.

εἴδω.shortDef: a primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent ὀπτάνομαι and ὁράω; properly, to see (literally or figuratively); by implication, (in the perfect tense only) to know:--be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have) know(-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand, wish, wot. Compare ὀπτάνομαι.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of εἴδωλον
εἰδωλεῖον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of εἴδωλον; an image-fane:--idol's temple.

glosses: neuter of a compound of εἴδωλον and a presumed derivative of θύω
εἰδωλόθυτον.shortDef: neuter of a compound of εἴδωλον and a presumed derivative of θύω; an image-sacrifice, i.e. part of an idolatrous offering:--(meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.

εἰδωλολατρεία.shortDef: from εἴδωλον and λατρεία; image-worship (literally or figuratively):--idolatry.

glosses: from εἴδωλον and the base of λατρεύω
εἰδωλολάτρης.shortDef: from εἴδωλον and the base of λατρεύω; an image- (servant or) worshipper (literally or figuratively):--idolater.

εἴδωλον.shortDef: from εἶδος; an image (i.e. for worship); by implication, a heathen god, or (plural) the worship of such:--idol.

glosses: optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of εἰμί (including the other person)
εἴην.shortDef: optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of εἰμί (including the other person); might (could, would, or should) be:--mean, + perish, should be, was, were.

εἰ καί.shortDef: from εἰ and καί; if also (or even):--if (that), though.

glosses: probably from εἴκω (through the idea of failure)
εἰκῆ.shortDef: probably from εἴκω (through the idea of failure); idly, i.e. without reason (or effect):--without a cause, (in) vain(-ly).

glosses: apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to εἴκω through the idea of faintness as a copy)
εἴκω.shortDef: apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to εἴκω through the idea of faintness as a copy); to resemble:--be like.

εἰκών.shortDef: from εἴκω; a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance:--image.

εἰλικρίνεια.shortDef: from εἰλικρινής; clearness, i.e. (by implication) purity (figuratively):--sincerity.

εἰλικρινής.shortDef: from  (the sun's ray) and κρίνω; judged by sunlight, i.e. tested as genuine (figuratively):--pure, sincere.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb  (of the same meaning)
εἱλίσσω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb  (of the same meaning); to coil or wrap:--roll together. See also ἑλίσσω.

εἰ μή.shortDef: from εἰ and μή; if not:--but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till.

glosses: from εἰ μή and the neuter of τὶς
εἰ μή τι.shortDef: from εἰ μή and the neuter of τὶς; if not somewhat:--except.

glosses: the first person singular present indicative
εἰμί.shortDef: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic):--am, have been, X it is I, was. See also εἶ, εἴην, εἶναι, εἰσί, ἦν, ἔσομαι, ἐσμέν, ἐστέ, ἐστί, κέρδος, ἴσθι, ὦ.

εἶναι.shortDef: present infinitive from εἰμί; to exist:--am, was. come, is, X lust after, X please well, there is, to be, was.

εἴ περ.shortDef: from εἰ and περ; if perhaps:--if so be (that), seeing, though.

εἴ πως.shortDef: from εἰ and -πώς; if somehow:--if by any means.

εἰρηνεύω.shortDef: from εἰρήνη; to be (act) peaceful:--be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.

glosses: probably from a primary verb  (to join)
εἰρήνη.shortDef: probably from a primary verb  (to join); peace (literally or figuratively); by implication, prosperity:--one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again.

εἰρηνικός.shortDef: from εἰρήνη; pacific; by implication, salutary:--peaceable.

εἰρηνοποιέω.shortDef: from εἰρηνοποιός; to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to harmonize:--make peace.

εἰρηνοποιός.shortDef: from εἰρήνη and ποιέω; pacificatory, i.e. (subjectively) peaceable:--peacemaker.

εἰς.shortDef: a primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases:--(abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at, (back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore, + forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), …ward, (where-)fore, with. Often used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs (etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively).

εἷς.shortDef: a primary numeral; one:--a(-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See also εἷς καθ’ εἷς, μηδείς, μία, οὐδείς.

εἰσάγω.shortDef: from εἰς and ἄγω; to introduce (literally or figuratively):--bring in(-to), (+ was to) lead into.

εἰσακούω.shortDef: from εἰς and ἀκούω; to listen to:--hear.

εἰσδέχομαι.shortDef: from εἰς and δέχομαι; to take into one's favor:--receive.

εἴσειμι.shortDef: from εἰς and  (to go); to enter:--enter (go) into.

εἰσέρχομαι.shortDef: from εἰς and ἔρχομαι; to enter (literally or figuratively):--X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).

glosses: 3rd person plural present indicative of εἰμί
εἰσί.shortDef: 3rd person plural present indicative of εἰμί; they are:--agree, are, be, dure, X is, were.

glosses: from εἷς repeated with κατά inserted
εἷς καθ’ εἷς.shortDef: from εἷς repeated with κατά inserted; severally:--one by one.

εἰσκαλέω.shortDef: from εἰς and καλέω; to invite in:--call in.

εἴσοδος.shortDef: from εἰς and ὁδός; an entrance (literally or figuratively):--coming, enter(-ing) in (to).

εἰσπηδάω.shortDef: from εἰς and  (to leap); to rush in:--run (spring) in.

εἰσπορεύομαι.shortDef: from εἰς and πορεύομαι; to enter (literally or figuratively):--come (enter) in, go into.

εἰστρέχω.shortDef: from εἰς and τρέχω; to hasten inward:--run in.

εἰσφέρω.shortDef: from εἰς and φέρω; to carry inward (literally or figuratively):--bring (in), lead into.

εἶτα.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover:--after that(-ward), furthermore, then. See also ἔπειτα.

εἴτε.shortDef: from εἰ and τέ; if too:--if, or, whether.

εἴ τις.shortDef: from εἰ and τὶς; if any:--he that, if a(-ny) man('s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever.

glosses: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds)
ἐκ.shortDef: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or figurative; direct or remote):--after, among, X are, at, betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, …ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth, through, X unto, X vehemently, with(-out). Often used in composition, with the same general import; often of completion.

ἕκαστος.shortDef: as if a superlative of  (afar); each or every:--any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.

glosses: as if from ἕκαστος and τότε
ἑκάστοτε.shortDef: as if from ἕκαστος and τότε; at every time:--always.

ἑκατονταέτης.shortDef: from ἑκατόν and ἔτος; centenarian:--hundred years old.

glosses: from ἑκατόν and a presumed derivative of πλάσσω
ἑκατονταπλασίων.shortDef: from ἑκατόν and a presumed derivative of πλάσσω; a hundred times:--hundredfold.

ἑκατοντάρχης.shortDef: from ἑκατόν and ἄρχω; the captain of one hundred men:--centurion.

ἐκβάλλω.shortDef: from ἐκ and βάλλω; to eject (literally or figuratively):--bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).

glosses: from a compound of ἐκ and the base of βάσις (meaning to go out)
ἔκβασις.shortDef: from a compound of ἐκ and the base of βάσις (meaning to go out); an exit (literally or figuratively):--end, way to escape.

ἐκβολή.shortDef: from ἐκβάλλω; ejection, i.e. (specially) a throwing overboard of the cargo:--+ lighten the ship.

glosses: from ἐκ and a form of γαμίσκω (compare ἐκγαμίσκω)
ἐκγαμίζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and a form of γαμίσκω (compare ἐκγαμίσκω); to marry off a daughter:--give in marriage.

ἐκγαμίσκω.shortDef: from ἐκ and γαμίσκω; the same as 1547:--give in marriage.

glosses: neuter of a derivative of a compound of ἐκ and γίνομαι
ἔκγονον.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of a compound of ἐκ and γίνομαι; a descendant, i.e. (specially) grandchild:--nephew.

ἐκδαπανάω.shortDef: from ἐκ and δαπανάω; to expend (wholly), i.e. (figuratively) exhaust:--spend.

ἐκδέχομαι.shortDef: from ἐκ and δέχομαι; to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication) to await:--expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

ἔκδηλος.shortDef: from ἐκ and δῆλος; wholly evident:--manifest.

glosses: from a compound of ἐκ and δῆμος
ἐκδημέω.shortDef: from a compound of ἐκ and δῆμος; to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively) vacate or quit:--be absent.

ἐκδίδωμι.shortDef: from ἐκ and δίδωμι; to give forth, i.e. (specially) to lease:--let forth (out).

glosses: from ἐκ and a compound of διά and ἡγέομαι
ἐκδιηγέομαι.shortDef: from ἐκ and a compound of διά and ἡγέομαι; to narrate through wholly:--declare.

ἐκδικέω.shortDef: from ἔκδικος; to vindicate, retaliate, punish:--a (re-)venge.

ἐκδίκησις.shortDef: from ἐκδικέω; vindication, retribution:--(a-, re-)venge(-ance), punishment.

ἔκδικος.shortDef: from ἐκ and δίκη; carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher:--a (re-)venger.

ἐκδιώκω.shortDef: from ἐκ and διώκω; to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute implacably:--persecute.

glosses: from ἐκ and a derivative of δίδωμι
ἔκδοτος.shortDef: from ἐκ and a derivative of δίδωμι; given out or over, i.e. surrendered:--delivered.

glosses: from ἐκ and the base of δύνω
ἐκδύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and the base of δύνω; to cause to sink out of, i.e. (specially as of clothing) to divest:--strip, take off from, unclothe.

ἐκεῖ.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither:--there, thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place).

ἐκεῖθεν.shortDef: from ἐκεῖ; thence:--from that place, (from) thence, there.

ἐκεῖνος.shortDef: from ἐκεῖ; that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the article prefixed:--he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those. See also οὗτος.

ἐκζητέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ζητέω; to search out, i.e. (figuratively)investigate, crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship:--en- (re-)quire, seek after (carefully, diligently).

ἐκθαμβέω.shortDef: from ἔκθαμβος; to astonish utterly:--affright, greatly (sore) amaze.

ἔκθαμβος.shortDef: from ἐκ and θάμβος; utterly astounded:--greatly wondering.

glosses: from ἐκ and a derivative of τίθημι
ἔκθετος.shortDef: from ἐκ and a derivative of τίθημι; put out, i.e. exposed to perish:--cast out.

ἐκκαθαίρω.shortDef: from ἐκ and καθαίρω; to cleanse thoroughly:--purge (out).

ἐκκαίω.shortDef: from ἐκ and καίω; to inflame deeply:--burn.

ἐκκακέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and κακός; to be (bad or) weak, i.e. (by implication) to fail (in heart):--faint, be weary.

glosses: from ἐκ and the base of κέντρον
ἐκκεντέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and the base of κέντρον; to transfix:--pierce.

ἐκκλάω.shortDef: from ἐκ and κλάω; to exscind:--break off.

ἐκκλείω.shortDef: from ἐκ and κλείω; to shut out (literally or figuratively):--exclude.

glosses: from a compound of ἐκ and a derivative of καλέω
ἐκκλησία.shortDef: from a compound of ἐκ and a derivative of καλέω; a calling out, i.e. (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both):--assembly, church.

ἐκκλίνω.shortDef: from ἐκ and κλίνω; to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety):--avoid, eschew, go out of the way.

ἐκκολυμβάω.shortDef: from ἐκ and κολυμβάω; to escape by swimming:--swim out.

ἐκκομίζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and κομίζω; to bear forth (to burial):--carry out.

ἐκκόπτω.shortDef: from ἐκ and κόπτω; to exscind; figuratively, to frustrate:--cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder.

glosses: middle voice from ἐκ and κρεμάννυμι
ἐκκρέμαμαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐκ and κρεμάννυμι; to hang upon the lips of a speaker, i.e. listen closely:--be very attentive.

ἐκλαλέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and λαλέω; to divulge:--tell.

ἐκλάμπω.shortDef: from ἐκ and λάμπω; to be resplendent:--shine forth.

glosses: middle voice from ἐκ and λανθάνω
ἐκλανθάνομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐκ and λανθάνω; to be utterly oblivious of:--forget.

glosses: middle voice from ἐκ and λέγω (in its primary sense)
ἐκλέγομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐκ and λέγω (in its primary sense); to select:--make choice, choose (out), chosen.

ἐκλείπω.shortDef: from ἐκ and λείπω; to omit, i.e. (by implication) cease (die):--fail.

ἐκλεκτός.shortDef: from ἐκλέγομαι; select; by implication, favorite:--chosen, elect.

ἐκλογή.shortDef: from ἐκλέγομαι; (divine) selection (abstractly or concretely):--chosen, election.

ἐκλύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and λύω; to relax (literally or figuratively):--faint.

glosses: from ἐκ and the base of μασσάομαι
ἐκμάσσω.shortDef: from ἐκ and the base of μασσάομαι; to knead out, i.e. (by analogy) to wipe dry:--wipe.

ἐκμυκτηρίζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and μυκτηρίζω; to sneer outright at:--deride.

ἐκνεύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and νεύω; (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly withdraw:--convey self away.

ἐκνήφω.shortDef: from ἐκ and νήφω; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of stupor:--awake.

glosses: neuter of a derivative from ἑκών
ἑκούσιον.shortDef: neuter of a derivative from ἑκών; voluntariness:--willingly.

glosses: adverb from the same as ἑκούσιον
ἑκουσίως.shortDef: adverb from the same as ἑκούσιον; voluntarily:--wilfully, willingly.

ἔκπαλαι.shortDef: from ἐκ and πάλαι; long ago, for a long while:--of a long time, of old.

ἐκπειράζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πειράζω; to test thoroughly:--tempt.

ἐκπέμπω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πέμπω; to despatch:--send away (forth).

glosses: from ἐκ and a form of πέτομαι
ἐκπετάννυμι.shortDef: from ἐκ and a form of πέτομαι; to fly out, i.e. (by analogy) to extend:--stretch forth.

ἐκπίπτω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πίπτω; to drop away; specially, be driven out of one's course; figuratively, to lose, become inefficient:--be cast, fail, fall (away, off), take none effect.

ἐκπλέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πλέω; to depart by ship:--sail (away, thence).

ἐκπληρόω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πληρόω; to accomplish entirely:--fulfill.

ἐκπλήσσω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πλήσσω; to strike with astonishment:--amaze, astonish.

ἐκπνέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πνέω; to expire:--give up the ghost.

ἐκπορεύομαι.shortDef: from ἐκ and πορεύομαι; to depart, be discharged, proceed, project:--come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).

ἐκπορνεύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πορνεύω; to be utterly unchaste:--give self over to fornication.

ἐκπτύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and πτύω; to spit out, i.e. (figuratively) spurn:--reject.

ἐκριζόω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ῥιζόω; to uproot:--pluck up by the root, root up.

ἔκστασις.shortDef: from ἐξίστημι; a displacement of the mind, i.e. bewilderment, "ecstasy":--+ be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.

ἐκστρέφω.shortDef: from ἐκ and στρέφω; to pervert (figuratively):--subvert.

ἐκταράσσω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ταράσσω; to disturb wholly:--exceedingly trouble.

ἐκτείνω.shortDef: from ἐκ and teino (to stretch); to extend:--cast, put forth, stretch forth (out).

ἐκτελέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and τελέω; to complete fully:--finish.

glosses: neuter of the comparative of ἐκτενής
ἐκτενέστερον.shortDef: neuter of the comparative of ἐκτενής; more intently:--more earnestly.

ἐκτίθημι.shortDef: from ἐκ and τίθημι; to expose; figuratively, to declare:--cast out, expound.

ἐκτινάσσω.shortDef: from ἐκ and tinasso (to swing); to shake violently:--shake (off).

ἐκτός.shortDef: from ἐκ; the exterior; figuratively (as a preposition) aside from, besides:--but, except(-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless, without.

glosses: from ἐκ and the base of τροπή
ἐκτρέπω.shortDef: from ἐκ and the base of τροπή; to deflect, i.e. turn away (literally or figuratively):--avoid, turn (aside, out of the way).

ἐκτρέφω.shortDef: from ἐκ and τρέφω; to rear up to maturity, i.e. (genitive case) to cherish or train:--bring up, nourish.

glosses: from a comparative of ἐκ and  (to wound)
ἔκτρωμα.shortDef: from a comparative of ἐκ and  (to wound); a miscarriage (abortion), i.e. (by analogy) untimely birth:--born out of due time.

ἐκφέρω.shortDef: from ἐκ and φέρω; to bear out (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring forth, carry forth (out).

ἐκφεύγω.shortDef: from ἐκ and φεύγω; to flee out:--escape, flee.

ἐκφοβέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and φοβέω; to frighten utterly:--terrify.

ἔκφοβος.shortDef: from ἐκ and φόβος; frightened out of one's wits:-- sore afraid, exceedingly fear.

ἐκφύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and φύω; to sprout up:--put forth.

ἐκχέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and  (to pour); to pour forth; figuratively, to bestow:--gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth), spill.

ἐκχωρέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and χωρέω; to depart:--depart out.

ἐκψύχω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ψύχω; to expire:--give (yield) up the ghost.

glosses: feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary
ἐλαία.shortDef: feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive (the tree or the fruit):--olive (berry, tree).

glosses: neuter of the same as ἐλαία
ἔλαιον.shortDef: neuter of the same as ἐλαία; olive oil:--oil.

ἐλαιών.shortDef: from ἐλαία; an olive-orchard, i.e. (specially) the Mount of Olives:--Olivet.

ἐλαμίτης.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֵילָם); an Elamite or Persian:--Elamite.

glosses: comparative of the same as ἐλάχιστος
ἐλάσσων.shortDef: comparative of the same as ἐλάχιστος; smaller (in size, quantity, age or quality):--less, under, worse, younger.

ἐλαττονέω.shortDef: from ἐλάσσων; to diminish, i.e. fall short:--have lack.

ἐλαττόω.shortDef: from ἐλάσσων; to lessen (in rank or influence):--decrease, make lower.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternative of this) of uncertain affinity
ἐλαύνω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternative of this) of uncertain affinity; to push (as wind, oars or dæmonical power):--carry, drive, row.

glosses: probably akin to ἐλαύνω and the base of ἐλάσσων
ἐλαφρός.shortDef: probably akin to ἐλαύνω and the base of ἐλάσσων; light, i.e. easy:--light.

ἐλάχιστος.shortDef: superlative of  (short); used as equivalent to μικρός; least (in size, amount, dignity, etc.):--least, very little (small), smallest.

ἐλαχιστότερος.shortDef: comparative of ἐλάχιστος; far less:--less than the least.

ἐλεάζαρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֶלְעָזָר); Eleazar, an Israelite:--Eleazar.

ἐλέγχω.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; to confute, admonish:--convict, convince, tell a fault, rebuke, reprove.

ἐλεέω.shortDef: from ἔλεος; to compassionate (by word or deed, specially, by divine grace):--have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy (on).

ἐλεημοσύνη.shortDef: from ἔλεος; compassionateness, i.e. (as exercised towards the poor) beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction:--alms(-deeds).

ἔλεος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; compassion (human or divine, especially active):--(+ tender) mercy.

ἐλευθερία.shortDef: from ἐλεύθερος; freedom (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or ceremonial):--liberty.

glosses: probably from the alternate of ἔρχομαι
ἐλεύθερος.shortDef: probably from the alternate of ἔρχομαι; unrestrained (to go at pleasure), i.e. (as a citizen) not a slave (whether freeborn or manumitted), or (genitive case) exempt (from obligation or liability):--free (man, woman), at liberty.

ἐλευθερόω.shortDef: from ἐλεύθερος; to liberate, i.e. (figuratively) to exempt (from moral, ceremonial or mortal liability):--deliver, make free.

ἔλευσις.shortDef: from the alternate of ἔρχομαι; an advent:--coming.

ἐλεφάντινος.shortDef: from  (an "elephant"); elephantine, i.e. (by implication) composed of ivory:--of ivory.

ἐλιακείμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֶלְיָקִים); Eliakim, an Israelite:--Eliakim.

ἐλιέζερ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֱלִיעֶזֶר); Eliezer, an Israelite:--Eliezer.

ἐλιούδ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֵל and הוֹד); God of majesty; Eliud, an Israelite:--Eliud.

ἐλισάβετ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֱלִישֶׁבַע); Elisabet, an Israelitess:--Elisabeth.

ἐλισσαῖος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֱלִישָׁע); Elissæus, an Israelite:--Elissæus.

ἑλίσσω.shortDef: a form of εἱλίσσω; to coil or wrap:--fold up.

ἕλκος.shortDef: probably from ἑλκύω; an ulcer (as if drawn together):--sore.

ἑλκόω.shortDef: from ἕλκος; to cause to ulcerate, i.e. (passively) be ulcerous:--full of sores.

ἑλκύω.shortDef: probably akin to αἱρέομαι; to drag (literally or figuratively):--draw. Compare ἑλίσσω.

ἑλλάς.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; Hellas (or Greece), a country of Europe:--Greece.

ἕλλην.shortDef: from Ἑλλάς; a Hellen (Grecian) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a Greek-speaking person, especially a non-Jew:-- Gentile, Greek.

ἑλληνικός.shortDef: from Ἕλλην; Hellenic, i.e. Grecian (in language):--Greek.

ἑλληνίς.shortDef: feminine of Ἕλλην; a Grecian (i.e. non-Jewish) woman:--Greek.

ἑλληνιστής.shortDef: from a derivative of Ἕλλην; a Hellenist or Greek-speaking Jew:--Grecian.

glosses: adverb from the same as Ἑλληνιστής
ἑλληνιστί.shortDef: adverb from the same as Ἑλληνιστής; Hellenistically, i.e. in the Grecian language:--Greek.

glosses: from ἐν and λόγος (in the sense of account)
ἐλλογέω.shortDef: from ἐν and λόγος (in the sense of account); to reckon in, i.e. attribute:--impute, put on account.

ἐλμωδάμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (perhaps for אַלְמוֹדָד); Elmodam, an Israelite:--Elmodam.

ἐλπίζω.shortDef: from ἐλπίς; to expect or confide:--(have, thing) hope(-d) (for), trust.

ἐλπίς.shortDef: from a primary  (to anticipate, usually with pleasure); expectation (abstractly or concretely) or confidence:--faith, hope.

ἐλύμας.shortDef: of foreign origin; Elymas, a wizard:--Elymas.

glosses: of Chaldean origin (אֱלָהּ with pronominal suffix) my God:--Eloi.
ἐλοΐ.shortDef: of Chaldean origin (אֱלָהּ with pronominal suffix) my God:--Eloi.

glosses: genitive case compound of ἐμοῦ and αὐτός
ἐμαυτοῦ.shortDef: genitive case compound of ἐμοῦ and αὐτός; of myself so likewise the dative case        , and accusative case        :--me, mine own (self), myself.

glosses: from ἐν and the base of βάσις
ἐμβαίνω.shortDef: from ἐν and the base of βάσις; to walk on, i.e. embark (aboard a vessel), reach (a pool):--come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship.

ἐμβάλλω.shortDef: from ἐν and βάλλω; to throw on, i.e. (figuratively) subject to (eternal punishment):--cast into.

ἐμβάπτω.shortDef: from ἐν and βάπτω; to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid:--dip.

glosses: from ἐν and a presumed derivative of the base of βάσις
ἐμβατεύω.shortDef: from ἐν and a presumed derivative of the base of βάσις; equivalent to ἐμβαίνω; to intrude on (figuratively):--intrude into.

ἐμβιβάζω.shortDef: from ἐν and  (to mount; causative of ἐμβαίνω); to place on, i.e. transfer (aboard a vessel):--put in.

ἐμβλέπω.shortDef: from ἐν and βλέπω; to look on, i.e. (relatively) to observe fixedly, or (absolutely) to discern clearly:--behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see.

glosses: from ἐν and  (to snort with anger)
ἐμβριμάομαι.shortDef: from ἐν and  (to snort with anger); to have indignation on, i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specially) to sternly enjoin:--straitly charge, groan, murmur against.

ἐμέ.shortDef: a prolonged form of μέ; me:--I, me, my(-self).

ἐμέω.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; to vomit:--(will) spue.

ἐμμαίνομαι.shortDef: from ἐν and μαίνομαι; to rave on, i.e. rage at:--be mad against.

ἐμμανουήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עִמָּנוּאֵל); God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ:--Emmanuel.

ἐμμαούς.shortDef: probably of Hebrew origin (compare יֵם); Emmaus, a place in Palestine:--Emmaus.

ἐμμένω.shortDef: from ἐν and μένω; to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere:--continue.

ἐμμόρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חֲמוֹר); Emmor (i.e. Chamor), a Canaanite:--Emmor.

ἐμοί.shortDef: a prolonged form of μοί; to me:--I, me, mine, my.

glosses: from the oblique cases of ἐγώ (ἐμοί
ἐμός.shortDef: from the oblique cases of ἐγώ (ἐμοί, ἐμοῦ, ἐμέ); my:--of me, mine (own), my.

ἐμοῦ.shortDef: a prolonged form of μόχθος; of me:--me, mine, my.

ἐμπαίζω.shortDef: from ἐν and παίζω; to jeer at, i.e. deride:--mock.

ἐμπαίκτης.shortDef: from ἐμπαίζω; a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher:--mocker, scoffer.

ἐμπεριπατέω.shortDef: from ἐν and περιπατέω; to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons:--walk in.

glosses: from ἐν and the base of πλεῖστος
ἐμπίπλημι.shortDef: from ἐν and the base of πλεῖστος;to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively):--fill.

ἐμπίπτω.shortDef: from ἐν and πίπτω; to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with:--fall among (into).

ἐμπλέκω.shortDef: from ἐν and πλέκω; to entwine, i.e. (figuratively) involve with:--entangle (in, self with).

ἐμπλοκή.shortDef: from ἐμπλέκω; elaborate braiding of the hair:--plaiting.

ἐμπνέω.shortDef: from ἐν and πνέω; to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon):--breathe.

ἐμπορεύομαι.shortDef: from ἐν and πορεύομαι; to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade:--buy and sell, make merchandise.

glosses: from ἐν and the base of πορεύομαι
ἔμπορος.shortDef: from ἐν and the base of πορεύομαι; a (wholesale) tradesman:--merchant.

glosses: from ἐν and  (to blow a flame)
ἐμπρήθω.shortDef: from ἐν and  (to blow a flame); to enkindle, i.e. set on fire:--burn up.

ἔμπροσθεν.shortDef: from ἐν and πρός; in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time):--against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.

ἐμπτύω.shortDef: from ἐν and πτύω; to spit at or on:--spit (upon).

glosses: from a compound of ἐν and φαίνω
ἐμφανής.shortDef: from a compound of ἐν and φαίνω; apparent in self:--manifest, openly.

ἐμφανίζω.shortDef: from ἐμφανής; to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words):--appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.

ἔμφοβος.shortDef: from ἐν and φόβος; in fear, i.e. alarmed:--affrighted, afraid, tremble.

ἐμφυσάω.shortDef: from ἐν and  (to puff) (compare φύω); to blow at or on:--breathe on.

glosses: from ἐν and a derivative of φύω
ἔμφυτος.shortDef: from ἐν and a derivative of φύω; implanted (figuratively):--engrafted.

glosses: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place
ἐν.shortDef: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between εἰς and ἐκ); "in," at, (up-)on, by, etc.:--about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (… sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, (speedi-)ly, X that, X there(-in, -on), through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while, with(-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same import; rarely with verbs of motion, and then not to indicate direction, except (elliptically) by a separate (and different) preposition.

glosses: from ἐν and a derivative of ἀγκάλη
ἐναγκαλίζομαι.shortDef: from ἐν and a derivative of ἀγκάλη; to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace:--take up in arms.

ἐνάλιος.shortDef: from ἐν and ἅλς; in the sea, i.e. marine:--thing in the sea.

ἔναντι.shortDef: from ἐν and ἀντί; in front (i.e. figuratively, presence) of:--before.

ἐναντίον.shortDef: neuter of ἐναντίος; (adverbially) in the presence (view) of:--before, in the presence of.

ἐναντίος.shortDef: from ἔναντι; opposite; figuratively, antagonistic:--(over) against, contrary.

ἐνάρχομαι.shortDef: from ἐν and ἄρχομαι; to commence on:--rule (by mistake for ἄρχω).

glosses: from a compound of ἐν and δέω (in the sense of lacking)
ἐνδεής.shortDef: from a compound of ἐν and δέω (in the sense of lacking); deficient in:--lacking.

ἐνδείκνυμι.shortDef: from ἐν and δεικνύω; to indicate (by word or act):--do, show (forth).

ἔνδειξις.shortDef: from ἐνδείκνυμι; indication (abstractly):--declare, evident token, proof.

glosses: from (the neuter of) εἷς and δέκα
ἕνδεκα.shortDef: from (the neuter of) εἷς and δέκα; one and ten, i.e. eleven:--eleven.

glosses: third person singular present of a compound of ἐν and δέχομαι
ἐνδέχεται.shortDef: third person singular present of a compound of ἐν and δέχομαι; (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible):--can (+ not) be.

glosses: from a compound of ἐν and δῆμος
ἐνδημέω.shortDef: from a compound of ἐν and δῆμος; to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively):--be at home (present).

ἐνδιδύσκω.shortDef: a prolonged form of ἐνδύω; to invest (with a garment):--clothe in, wear.

ἔνδικος.shortDef: from ἐν and δίκη; in the right, i.e. equitable:--just.

glosses: from a compound of ἐν and a derivative of the base of δῆμος
ἐνδόμησις.shortDef: from a compound of ἐν and a derivative of the base of δῆμος; a housing in (residence), i.e. structure:--building.

ἔνδοξος.shortDef: from ἐν and δόξα; in glory, i.e. splendid, (figuratively) noble:--glorious, gorgeous(-ly), honourable.

ἔνδυμα.shortDef: from ἐνδύω; apparel (especially the outer robe):--clothing, garment, raiment.

ἐνδυναμόω.shortDef: from ἐν and δυναμόω; to empower:--enable, (increase in) strength(-en), be (make) strong.

ἐνδύνω.shortDef: from ἔννομος and δύνω; to sink (by implication, wrap (compare ἐνδύω) on, i.e. (figuratively) sneak:--creep.

ἔνδυσις.shortDef: from ἐνδύω; investment with clothing:--putting on.

glosses: from ἐν and δύνω (in the sense of sinking into a garment)
ἐνδύω.shortDef: from ἐν and δύνω (in the sense of sinking into a garment); to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively):--array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on.

glosses: feminine from ἐν and the base of ἑδραῖος
ἐνέδρα.shortDef: feminine from ἐν and the base of ἑδραῖος; an ambuscade, i.e. (figuratively) murderous purpose:--lay wait. See also ἔνεδρον.

ἐνεδρεύω.shortDef: from ἐνέδρα; to lurk, i.e. (figuratively) plot assassination:--lay wait for.

glosses: neuter of the same as ἐνέδρα
ἔνεδρον.shortDef: neuter of the same as ἐνέδρα; an ambush, i.e. (figuratively) murderous design:--lying in wait.

glosses: from ἔννομος and the base of εἱλίσσω
ἐνειλέω.shortDef: from ἔννομος and the base of εἱλίσσω; to enwrap:--wrap in.

ἔνειμι.shortDef: from ἔννομος and εἰμί; to be within (neuter participle plural):--such things as … have. See also ἔνι.

ἕνεκα.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; on account of:--because, for (cause, sake), (where-)fore, by reason of, that.

ἐνεργέω.shortDef: from ἐνεργής; to be active, efficient:--do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).

ἐνεργής.shortDef: from ἐν and ἔργον; active, operative:--effectual, powerful.

ἐνευλογέω.shortDef: from ἐν and εὐλογέω; to confer a benefit on:--bless.

ἐνέχω.shortDef: from ἐν and ἔχω; to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge:--entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.

glosses: from a prolonged form of ἐν
ἐνθάδε.shortDef: from a prolonged form of ἐν; properly, within, i.e. (of place) here, hither:--(t-)here, hither.

glosses: from a compound of ἐν and θυμός
ἐνθυμέομαι.shortDef: from a compound of ἐν and θυμός; to be inspirited, i.e. ponder:--think.

glosses: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of ἔνειμι
ἔνι.shortDef: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of ἔνειμι; impersonally, there is in or among:--be, (there) is.

ἐνιαυτός.shortDef: prolongation from a primary  (a year); a year:--year.

ἐνίστημι.shortDef: from ἐν and ἵστημι; to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant:--come, be at hand, present.

ἐνισχύω.shortDef: from ἐν and ἰσχύω; to invigorate (transitively or reflexively):--strengthen.

glosses: from a (tenth) multiple of ἐννέα and ἐννέα itself
ἐννενηκονταεννέα.shortDef: from a (tenth) multiple of ἐννέα and ἐννέα itself; ninety-nine:--ninety and nine.

ἐννεός.shortDef: from ἐννεύω; dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment:--speechless.

ἐννεύω.shortDef: from ἐν and νεύω; to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture:--make signs.

glosses: from a compound of ἐν and νοῦς
ἔννοια.shortDef: from a compound of ἐν and νοῦς; thoughtfulness, i.e. moral understanding:--intent, mind.

ἔννομος.shortDef: from ἐν and νόμος; (subjectively) legal, or (objectively) subject to:--lawful, under law.

glosses: neuter of a compound of ἐν and νύξ
ἔννυχον.shortDef: neuter of a compound of ἐν and νύξ; (adverbially) by night:--before day.

ἐνοικέω.shortDef: from ἐν and οἰκέω; to inhabit (figuratively):--dwell in.

ἐνοχλέω.shortDef: from ἐν and ὀχλέω; to crowd in, i.e. (figuratively) to annoy:--trouble.

ἔνοχος.shortDef: from ἐνέχω; liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation):--in danger of, guilty of, subject to.

ἔνταλμα.shortDef: from ἐντέλλομαι; an injunction, i.e. religious precept:--commandment.

glosses: from a compound of ἐν and τάφος
ἐνταφιάζω.shortDef: from a compound of ἐν and τάφος; to inswathe with cerements for interment:--bury.

glosses: from ἐν and the base of τέλος
ἐντέλλομαι.shortDef: from ἐν and the base of τέλος; to enjoin:--(give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.

ἐντεῦθεν.shortDef: from the same as ἐνθάδε; hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated) on both sides:--(from) hence, on either side.

ἔντευξις.shortDef: from ἐντυγχάνω; an interview, i.e. (specially) supplication:--intercession, prayer.

ἔντιμος.shortDef: from ἐν and τιμή; valued (figuratively):--dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.

ἐντολή.shortDef: from ἐντέλλομαι; injunction, i.e. an authoritative prescription:--commandment, precept.

ἐντόπιος.shortDef: from ἐν and τόπος; a resident:--of that place.

glosses: from ἐν and the base of τροπή
ἐντρέπω.shortDef: from ἐν and the base of τροπή; to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound:--regard, (give) reference, shame.

ἐντρέφω.shortDef: from ἐν and τρέφω; (figuratively) to educate:--nourish up in.

ἔντρομος.shortDef: from ἐν and τρόμος; terrified:--X quake, X trembled.

ἐντρυφάω.shortDef: from ἐν and τρυφάω; to revel in:--sporting selves.

ἐντυγχάνω.shortDef: from ἐν and τυγχάνω; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against):--deal with, make intercession.

ἐντυλίσσω.shortDef: from ἐν and  (to twist; probably akin to εἱλίσσω); to entwine, i.e. wind up in:--wrap in (together).

glosses: from ἐν and a derivative of τύπος
ἐντυπόω.shortDef: from ἐν and a derivative of τύπος; to enstamp, i.e. engrave:--engrave.

ἐνυβρίζω.shortDef: from ἐν and ὑβρίζω; to insult:--do despite unto.

ἐνυπνιάζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐνύπνιον; to dream:--dream(-er).

ἐνύπνιον.shortDef: from ἐν and ὕπνος; something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream):--dream.

glosses: neuter of a compound of ἐν and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι
ἐνώπιον.shortDef: neuter of a compound of ἐν and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; in the face of (literally or figuratively):--before, in the presence (sight) of, to.

ἐνώς.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֱנוֹשׁ); Enos (i.e. Enosh), a patriarch:--Enos.

glosses: middle voice from a compound of ἐν and οὖς
ἐνωτίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from a compound of ἐν and οὖς; to take in one's ear, i.e. to listen:--hearken.

ἐνώχ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חֲנוֹךְ); Enoch (i.e. Chanok), an antediluvian:--Enoch.

glosses: from ἐκ and the base of ἄγγελος
ἐξαγγέλλω.shortDef: from ἐκ and the base of ἄγγελος; to publish, i.e. celebrate:--shew forth.

ἐξαγοράζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀγοράζω; to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity):--redeem.

ἐξάγω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἄγω; to lead forth:--bring forth (out), fetch (lead) out.

ἐξαιρέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and αἱρέομαι; actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release:--deliver, pluck out, rescue.

ἐξαίρω.shortDef: from ἐκ and αἴρω; to remove:--put (take) away.

glosses: middle voice from ἐκ and αἰτέω
ἐξαιτέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐκ and αἰτέω; to demand (for trial):--desire.

glosses: from ἐκ and the base of αἰφνίδιος
ἐξαίφνης.shortDef: from ἐκ and the base of αἰφνίδιος; of a sudden (unexpectedly):--suddenly. Compare ἐξάπινα.

ἐξακολουθέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀκολουθέω; to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to:--follow.

glosses: plural ordinal from ἕξ and ἑκατόν
ἑξακόσιοι.shortDef: plural ordinal from ἕξ and ἑκατόν; six hundred:--six hundred.

ἐξαλείφω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀλείφω; to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin):--blot out, wipe away.

ἐξάλλομαι.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἅλλομαι; to spring forth :--leap up.

ἐξανάστασις.shortDef: from ἐξανίστημι; a rising from death:--resurrection.

ἐξανατέλλω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀνατέλλω; to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate:--spring up.

ἐξανίστημι.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀνίστημι; objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object:--raise (rise) up.

ἐξαπατάω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀπατάω; to seduce wholly:--beguile, deceive.

glosses: from ἐκ and a derivative of the same as αἰφνίδιος
ἐξάπινα.shortDef: from ἐκ and a derivative of the same as αἰφνίδιος; of a sudden, i.e. unexpectedly:--suddenly. Compare ἐξαίφνης.

glosses: middle voice from ἐκ and ἀπορέω
ἐξαπορέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐκ and ἀπορέω; to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond:--(in) despair.

ἐξαποστέλλω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀποστέλλω; to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss:--send (away, forth, out).

glosses: from ἐκ and a derivative of ἄρτιος
ἐξαρτίζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and a derivative of ἄρτιος; to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher):--accomplish, thoroughly furnish.

ἐξαστράπτω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἀστράπτω; to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments):--glistening.

glosses: from ἐκ and the genitive case singular feminine of αὐτός (ὥρα being understood)
ἐξαυτῆς.shortDef: from ἐκ and the genitive case singular feminine of αὐτός (ὥρα being understood); from that hour, i.e. instantly:--by and by, immediately, presently, straightway.

ἐξεγείρω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἐγείρω; to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction):--raise up.

ἔξειμι.shortDef: from ἐκ and  (to go); to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore):--depart, get (to land), go out.

ἐξελέγχω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἐλέγχω; to convict fully, i.e. (by implication) to punish:--convince.

ἐξέλκω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἑλκύω; to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin):--draw away.

glosses: from a comparative of ἐκ and a presumed  (to spue)
ἐξέραμα.shortDef: from a comparative of ἐκ and a presumed  (to spue); vomit, i.e. food disgorged:--vomit.

ἐξερευνάω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἐρευνάω; to explore (figuratively):--search diligently.

ἐξέρχομαι.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἔρχομαι; to issue (literally or figuratively):--come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.

glosses: third person singular present indicative of a compound of ἐκ and εἰμί
ἔξεστι.shortDef: third person singular present indicative of a compound of ἐκ and εἰμί; so also         neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of εἰμί expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public):--be lawful, let, X may(-est).

ἐξετάζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and  (to examine); to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate:--ask, enquire, search.

ἐξηγέομαι.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἡγέομαι; to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold:--declare, tell.

ἑξήκοντα.shortDef: the tenth multiple of ἕξ; sixty:--sixty(-fold), threescore.

glosses: from ἔχω (in the sense of taking hold of
ἑξῆς.shortDef: from ἔχω (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining); successive:--after, following, X morrow, next.

glosses: middle voice from ἐκ and ἠχέω
ἐξηχέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐκ and ἠχέω; to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported):--sound forth.

ἕξις.shortDef: from ἔχω; habit, i.e. (by implication) practice:--use.

ἐξίστημι.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἵστημι; to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane:--amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.

ἐξισχύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ἰσχύω; to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent:--be able.

ἔξοδος.shortDef: from ἐκ and ὁδός; an exit, i.e. (figuratively) death:--decease, departing.

ἐξολοθρεύω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ὀλοθρεύω; to extirpate:--destroy.

ἐξομολογέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ὁμολογέω; to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent) agree fully:--confess, profess, promise.

ἐξορκίζω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ὁρκίζω; to exact an oath, i.e. conjure:--adjure.

ἐξορκιστής.shortDef: from ἐξορκίζω; one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer):--exorcist.

ἐξορύσσω.shortDef: from ἐκ and ὀρύσσω; to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing):--break up, pluck out.

glosses: from ἐκ and a derivative of the neuter of οὐδείς
ἐξουδενόω.shortDef: from ἐκ and a derivative of the neuter of οὐδείς; to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise:--set at nought. See also ἐξουθενέω.

glosses: a variation of ἐξουδενόω and meaning the same:--contemptible
ἐξουθενέω.shortDef: a variation of ἐξουδενόω and meaning the same:--contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought.

glosses: from ἔξεστι (in the sense of ability)
ἐξουσία.shortDef: from ἔξεστι (in the sense of ability); privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence:--authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength.

ἐξουσιάζω.shortDef: from ἐξουσία; to control:--exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of.

glosses: from a compound of ἐκ and ἔχω (meaning to stand out)
ἐξοχή.shortDef: from a compound of ἐκ and ἔχω (meaning to stand out); prominence (figuratively):--principal.

ἐξυπνίζω.shortDef: from ἔξυπνος; to waken:--awake out of sleep.

ἔξυπνος.shortDef: from ἐκ and ὕπνος; awake:--X out of sleep.

ἔξω.shortDef: adverb from ἐκ; out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively:--away, forth, (with-)out (of, -ward), strange.

ἐξωθέω.shortDef: from ἐκ and  (to push); to expel; by implication, to propel:--drive out, thrust in.

ἑορτάζω.shortDef: from ἑορτή; to observe a festival:--keep the feast.

ἑορτή.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a festival:--feast, holyday.

ἐπαγγελία.shortDef: from ἐπαγγέλλω; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good):--message, promise.

glosses: from ἐπί and the base of ἄγγελος
ἐπαγγέλλω.shortDef: from ἐπί and the base of ἄγγελος; to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself:--profess, (make) promise.

ἐπάγγελμα.shortDef: from ἐπαγγέλλω; a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good):--promise.

ἐπάγω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἄγω; to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime):--bring upon.

ἐπαγωνίζομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀγωνίζομαι; to struggle for:--earnestly contend for.

ἐπαθροίζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and  (to assemble); to accumulate:--gather thick together.

ἐπαίνετος.shortDef: from ἐπαινέω; praised; Epænetus, a Christian:--Epenetus.

ἐπαινέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and αἰνέω; to applaud:--commend, laud, praise.

glosses: from ἐπί and the base of αἰνέω
ἔπαινος.shortDef: from ἐπί and the base of αἰνέω; laudation; concretely, a commendable thing:--praise.

ἐπαίρω.shortDef: from ἐπί and αἴρω; to raise up (literally or figuratively):--exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.

ἐπαισχύνομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and αἰσχύνομαι; to feel shame for something:--be ashamed.

ἐπαιτέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and αἰτέω; to ask for:--beg.

ἐπακολουθέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀκολουθέω; to accompany:--follow (after).

ἐπακούω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀκούω; to hearken (favorably) to:--hear.

glosses: from ἐπί and the base of ἀκροατής
ἐπακροάομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and the base of ἀκροατής; to listen (intently) to:--hear.

ἐπάν.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἄν; a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as:--when.

glosses: neuter of a presumed compound of ἐπί and ἀνάγκη
ἐπάναγκες.shortDef: neuter of a presumed compound of ἐπί and ἀνάγκη; (adverbially) on necessity, i.e. necessarily:--necessary.

ἐπανάγω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀνάγω; to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return:--launch (thrust) out, return.

ἐπαναμιμνήσκω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀναμιμνήσκω; to remind of:--put in mind.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and ἀναπαύω
ἐπαναπαύομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and ἀναπαύω; to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely):--rest in (upon).

ἐπανέρχομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀνέρχομαι; to come up on, i.e. return:--come again, return.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and ἀνίστημι
ἐπανίσταμαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and ἀνίστημι; to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack:--rise up against.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and ἀνορθόω
ἐπανόρθωσις.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and ἀνορθόω; a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation):-- correction.

ἐπάνω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἄνω; up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.):--above, more than, (up-)on, over.

ἐπαρκέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀρκέω; to avail for, i.e. help:--relieve.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and ἄρχω (meaning a governor of a district
ἐπαρχία.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and ἄρχω (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch"); a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture:--province.

glosses: from ἐπί and an equivalent of αὐλή
ἔπαυλις.shortDef: from ἐπί and an equivalent of αὐλή; a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling:--habitation.

ἐπαύριον.shortDef: from ἐπί and αὔριον; occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (ἡμέρα being implied) to-morrow:--day following, morrow, next day (after).

glosses: from ἐπί and αὐτός and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of  (a thief)
ἐπαυτοφώρῳ.shortDef: from ἐπί and αὐτός and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of  (a thief); in theft itself, i.e. (by analogy) in actual crime:--in the very act.

ἐπαφρᾶς.shortDef: contracted from Ἐπαφρόδιτος; Epaphras, a Christian:--Epaphras.

ἐπαφρίζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἀφρίζω; to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion):--foam out.

glosses: from ἐπί (in the sense of devoted to) and  (Venus)
ἐπαφρόδιτος.shortDef: from ἐπί (in the sense of devoted to) and  (Venus); Epaphroditus, a Christian:--Epaphroditus. Compare Ἐπαφρᾶς.

ἐπεγείρω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἐγείρω; to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against:--raise, stir up.

ἐπεί.shortDef: from ἐπί and εἰ; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause):--because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.

ἐπειδή.shortDef: from ἐπεί and δή; since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas:--after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.

ἐπειδήπερ.shortDef: from ἐπειδή and περ; since indeed (of cause):--forasmuch.

glosses: and other moods and persons of the same tense
ἐπεῖδον.shortDef: and other moods and persons of the same tense; from ἐπί and εἴδω; to regard (favorably or otherwise):--behold, look upon.

ἐπείπερ.shortDef: from ἐπεί and περ; since indeed (of cause):--seeing.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and εἰσάγω
ἐπεισαγωγή.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and εἰσάγω; a superintroduction:--bringing in.

ἔπειτα.shortDef: from ἐπί and εἶτα; thereafter:--after that(-ward), then.

glosses: from ἐπί and (the accusative case plural neuter of) ἐκεῖνος
ἐπέκεινα.shortDef: from ἐπί and (the accusative case plural neuter of) ἐκεῖνος; upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of:--beyond.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and ἐκτείνω
ἐπεκτείνομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and ἐκτείνω; to stretch (oneself) forward upon:--reach forth.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and ἐνδύω
ἐπενδύομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and ἐνδύω; to invest upon oneself:--be clothed upon.

ἐπενδύτης.shortDef: from ἐπενδύομαι; a wrapper, i.e. outer garment:--fisher's coat.

ἐπέρχομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἔρχομαι; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence:--come (in, upon).

ἐπερωτάω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἐρωτάω; to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek:--ask (after, questions), demand, desire, question.

ἐπέχω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἔχω; to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of νοῦς) to pay attention to:--give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.

glosses: from a comparative of ἐπί and (probably)  (threats)
ἐπηρεάζω.shortDef: from a comparative of ἐπί and (probably)  (threats); to insult, slander:--use despitefully, falsely accuse.

ἐπί.shortDef: a primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.:--about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with. In compounds it retains essentially the same import, at, upon, etc. (literally or figuratively).

glosses: from ἐπί and the base of βάσις
ἐπιβαίνω.shortDef: from ἐπί and the base of βάσις; to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive:--come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship.

ἐπιβάλλω.shortDef: from ἐπί and βάλλω; to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with ἑαυτοῦ implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to:--beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.

ἐπιβαρέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and βαρέω; to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards:--be chargeable to, overcharge.

glosses: from ἐπί and a reduplicated derivative of the base of βάσις (compare ἀναβιβάζω)
ἐπιβιβάζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and a reduplicated derivative of the base of βάσις (compare ἀναβιβάζω); to cause to mount (an animal):--set on.

ἐπιβλέπω.shortDef: from ἐπί and βλέπω; to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality):--look upon, regard, have respect to.

ἐπιβοάω.shortDef: from ἐπί and βοάω; to exclaim against:--cry.

glosses: from a presumed compound of ἐπί and βούλομαι
ἐπιβουλή.shortDef: from a presumed compound of ἐπί and βούλομαι; a plan against someone, i.e. a plot:--laying (lying) in wait.

glosses: from ἐπί and a derivative of γάμος
ἐπιγαμβρεύω.shortDef: from ἐπί and a derivative of γάμος; to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way:--marry.

ἐπίγειος.shortDef: from ἐπί and γῆ; worldly (physically or morally):--earthly, in earth, terrestrial.

ἐπιγίνομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and γίνομαι; to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind):--blow.

ἐπιγινώσκω.shortDef: from ἐπί and γινώσκω; to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge:--(ac-, have, take)know(-ledge, well), perceive.

ἐπίγνωσις.shortDef: from ἐπιγινώσκω; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement:--(ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).

ἐπιγράφω.shortDef: from ἐπί and γράφω; to inscribe (physically or mentally):--inscription, write in (over, thereon).

ἐπιδείκνυμι.shortDef: from ἐπί and δεικνύω; to exhibit (physically or mentally):--shew.

ἐπιδέχομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and δέχομαι; to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher):--receive.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and δῆμος
ἐπιδημέω.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and δῆμος; to make oneself at home, i.e. (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country):--(be) dwelling (which were) there, stranger.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and διατάσσω
ἐπιδιατάσσομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and διατάσσω; to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil):--add to.

ἐπιδίδωμι.shortDef: from ἐπί and δίδωμι; to give over (by hand or surrender):--deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer.

glosses: from ἐπί and a derivative of ὀρθός
ἐπιδιορθόω.shortDef: from ἐπί and a derivative of ὀρθός; to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally:--set in order.

ἐπιδύω.shortDef: from ἐπί and δύνω; to set fully (as the sun):--go down.
