ἐπιείκεια.shortDef: from ἐπιεικής; suitableness, i.e. (by implication) equity, mildness:--clemency, gentleness.

ἐπιεικής.shortDef: from ἐπί and εἴκω; appropriate, i.e. (by implication) mild:--gentle, moderation, patient.

ἐπιζητέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ζητέω; to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave:--desire, enquire, seek (after, for).

ἐπιθανάτιος.shortDef: from ἐπί and θάνατος; doomed to death:--appointed to death.

ἐπίθεσις.shortDef: from ἐπιτίθημι; an imposition (of hands officially):--laying (putting) on.

ἐπιθυμέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and θυμός; to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise):--covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).

ἐπιθυμητής.shortDef: from ἐπιθυμέω; a craver:--+ lust after.

ἐπιθυμία.shortDef: from ἐπιθυμέω; a longing (especially for what is forbidden):--concupiscence, desire, lust (after).

ἐπικαθίζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and καθίζω; to seat upon:--set on.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and καλέω
ἐπικαλέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and καλέω; to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.):--appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.

ἐπικάλυμα.shortDef: from ἐπικαλύπτω; a covering, i.e. (figuratively) pretext:--cloke.

ἐπικαλύπτω.shortDef: from ἐπί and καλύπτω; to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive:--cover.

glosses: from ἐπί and a derivative of καταράομαι
ἐπικατάρατος.shortDef: from ἐπί and a derivative of καταράομαι; imprecated, i.e. execrable:--accursed.

ἐπίκειμαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and κεῖμαι; to rest upon (literally or figuratively):--impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.

ἐπικούρειος.shortDef: from  (compare ἐπικουρία) (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus:--Epicurean.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and a (prolonged) form of the base of κοράσιον (in the sense of servant)
ἐπικουρία.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and a (prolonged) form of the base of κοράσιον (in the sense of servant); assistance:--help.

ἐπικρίνω.shortDef: from ἐπί and κρίνω; to adjudge:--give sentence.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and λαμβάνω
ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and λαμβάνω; to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively):--catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on).

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and λανθάνω
ἐπιλανθάνομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and λανθάνω; to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect:--(be) forget(-ful of).

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and λέγω
ἐπιλέγομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and λέγω; to surname, select:--call, choose.

ἐπιλείπω.shortDef: from ἐπί and λείπω; to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for:--fail.

ἐπιλησμονή.shortDef: from a derivative of ἐπιλανθάνομαι; negligence:--X forgetful.

ἐπίλοιπος.shortDef: from ἐπί and λοιποί; left over, i.e. remaining:--rest.

ἐπιλύω.shortDef: from ἐπί and λύω; to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide:--determine, expound.

ἐπιμαρτυρέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and μαρτυρέω; to attest further, i.e. corroborate:--testify.

ἐπιμέλεια.shortDef: from ἐπιμελέομαι; carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality):--+ refresh self.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and the same as μέλω
ἐπιμελέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and the same as μέλω; to care for (physically or otherwise):--take care of.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of ἐπιμελέομαι
ἐπιμελῶς.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of ἐπιμελέομαι; carefully:--diligently.

ἐπιμένω.shortDef: from ἐπί and μένω; to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere):--abide (in), continue (in), tarry.

ἐπινεύω.shortDef: from ἐπί and νεύω; to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent:--consent.

ἐπίνοια.shortDef: from ἐπί and νοῦς; attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication) purpose:--thought.

ἐπιορκέω.shortDef: from ἐπίορκος; to commit perjury:--forswear self.

ἐπίορκος.shortDef: from ἐπί and ὅρκος; on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer:--perjured person.

glosses: feminine singular participle of a comparative of ἐπί and  (to go)
ἐπιοῦσα.shortDef: feminine singular participle of a comparative of ἐπί and  (to go); supervening, i.e. (ἡμέρα or νύξ being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night:--following, next.

glosses: perhaps from the same as ἐπιοῦσα
ἐπιούσιος.shortDef: perhaps from the same as ἐπιοῦσα; tomorrow's; but more probably from ἐπί and a derivative of the present participle feminine of εἰμί; for subsistence, i.e. needful:--daily.

ἐπιπίπτω.shortDef: from ἐπί and πίπτω; to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively):--fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon.

ἐπιπλήσσω.shortDef: from ἐπί and πλήσσω; to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid:--rebuke.

ἐπιπνίγω.shortDef: from ἐπί and πνίγω; to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrow:--choke.

ἐπιποθέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and potheo (to yearn); to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully):--(earnestly) desire (greatly), (greatly) long (after), lust.

ἐπιπόθησις.shortDef: from ἐπιποθέω; a longing for:--earnest (vehement) desire.

glosses: from ἐπί and a derivative of the latter part of ἐπιποθέω
ἐπιπόθητος.shortDef: from ἐπί and a derivative of the latter part of ἐπιποθέω; yearned upon, i.e. greatly loved:--longed for.

ἐπιπορεύομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and πορεύομαι; to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach):--come.

glosses: from ἐπί and the base of ῥαφίς
ἐπιῤῥάπτω.shortDef: from ἐπί and the base of ῥαφίς; to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle:--sew on.

ἐπιῤῥίπτω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ῥίπτω; to throw upon (literally or figuratively):--cast upon.

glosses: from ἐπί and some form of the base of σημαίνω
ἐπίσημος.shortDef: from ἐπί and some form of the base of σημαίνω; remarkable, i.e. (figuratively) eminent:--notable, of note.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and a derivative of σῖτος
ἐπισιτισμός.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and a derivative of σῖτος; a provisioning, i.e. (concretely) food:--victuals.

glosses: middle voice from ἐπί and the base of σκοπός
ἐπισκέπτομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἐπί and the base of σκοπός; to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve:--look out, visit.

ἐπισκηνόω.shortDef: from ἐπί and σκηνόω; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with :--rest upon.

glosses: from ἐπί and a derivative of σκιά
ἐπισκιάζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and a derivative of σκιά; to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence:--overshadow.

ἐπισκοπέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and σκοπέω; to oversee; by implication, to beware:--look diligently, take the oversight.

ἐπισκοπή.shortDef: from ἐπισκέπτομαι; inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate":--the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation.

glosses: from ἐπί and σκοπός (in the sense of ἐπισκοπέω)
ἐπίσκοπος.shortDef: from ἐπί and σκοπός (in the sense of ἐπισκοπέω); a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively):--bishop, overseer.

ἐπισπάομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and σπάω; to draw over, i.e. (with ἀκροβυστία implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin):--become uncircumcised.

glosses: apparently a middle voice of ἐφίστημι (with νοῦς implied)
ἐπίσταμαι.shortDef: apparently a middle voice of ἐφίστημι (with νοῦς implied); to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with:--know, understand.

glosses: from ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ἵστημι
ἐπιστάτης.shortDef: from ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ἵστημι; an appointee over, i.e. commander (teacher):--master.

ἐπιστέλλω.shortDef: from ἐπί and στέλλω; to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose):--write (a letter, unto).

ἐπιστηρίζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and στηρίζω; to support further, i.e. reestablish:--confirm, strengthen.

ἐπιστολή.shortDef: from ἐπιστέλλω; a written message:--"epistle," letter.

ἐπιστομίζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and στόμα; to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence:--stop mouths.

ἐπιστρέφω.shortDef: from ἐπί and στρέφω; to revert (literally, figuratively or morally):--come (go) again, convert, (re-)turn (about, again).

ἐπιστροφή.shortDef: from ἐπιστρέφω; reversion, i.e. morally, revolution:--conversion.

ἐπισυνάγω.shortDef: from ἐπί and συνάγω; to collect upon the same place:--gather (together).

ἐπισυναγωγή.shortDef: from ἐπισυνάγω; a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship):--assembling (gathering) together.

ἐπισυντρέχω.shortDef: from ἐπί and συντρέχω; to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion):--come running together.

glosses: from the middle voice of a compound of ἐπί and συνιστάω
ἐπισύστασις.shortDef: from the middle voice of a compound of ἐπί and συνιστάω; a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly):--that which cometh upon, + raising up.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and  (to trip)
ἐπισφαλής.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and  (to trip); figuratively, insecure:--dangerous.

ἐπισχύω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἰσχύω; to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly:--be the more fierce.

ἐπισωρεύω.shortDef: from ἐπί and σωρεύω; to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally:--heap.

ἐπιταγή.shortDef: from ἐπιτάσσω; an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness:--authority, commandment.

ἐπιτάσσω.shortDef: from ἐπί and τάσσω; to arrange upon, i.e. order:--charge, command, injoin.

ἐπιτελέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and τελέω; to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo:--accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform(X -ance).

ἐπιτήδειος.shortDef: from  (enough); serviceable, i.e. (by implication) requisite:--things which are needful.

ἐπιτίθημι.shortDef: from ἐπί and τίθημι; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense):--add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound.

ἐπιτιμάω.shortDef: from ἐπί and τιμάω; to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid:--(straitly) charge, rebuke.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and τιμή
ἐπιτιμία.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and τιμή; properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of ἐπιτιμάω) of a penalty:--punishment.

glosses: from ἐπί and the base of τροπή
ἐπιτρέπω.shortDef: from ἐπί and the base of τροπή; to turn over (transfer), i.e. allow:--give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

ἐπιτροπή.shortDef: from ἐπιτρέπω; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power:--commission.

glosses: from ἐπί and τρόπος (in the sense of ἐπιτροπή)
ἐπίτροπος.shortDef: from ἐπί and τρόπος (in the sense of ἐπιτροπή); a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian:--steward, tutor.

ἐπιτυγχάνω.shortDef: from ἐπί and τυγχάνω; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain:--obtain.

ἐπιφαίνω.shortDef: from ἐπί and φαίνω; to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known:--appear, give light.

ἐπιφάνεια.shortDef: from ἐπιφανής; a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future):--appearing, brightness.

ἐπιφαύω.shortDef: a form of ἐπιφαίνω; to illuminate (figuratively):--give light.

ἐπιφέρω.shortDef: from ἐπί and φέρω; to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce:--add, bring (against), take.

ἐπιφωνέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and φωνέω; to call at something, i.e. exclaim:--cry (against), give a shout.

ἐπιφώσκω.shortDef: a form of ἐπιφαύω; to begin to grow light:--begin to dawn, X draw on.

ἐπιχειρέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and χείρ; to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake:--go about, take in hand (upon).

ἐπιχέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and  (to pour); --to pour upon:--pour in.

ἐπιχορηγέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and χορηγέω; to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute:--add, minister (nourishment, unto).

ἐπιχρίω.shortDef: from ἐπί and χρίω; to smear over:--anoint.

ἐποικοδομέω.shortDef: from ἐπί and οἰκοδομέω; to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up:--build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).

ἐποκέλλω.shortDef: from ἐπί and  (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel:--run aground.

ἐπονομάζω.shortDef: from ἐπί and ὀνομάζω; to name further, i.e. denominate:--call.

glosses: from ἐπί and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι
ἐποπτεύω.shortDef: from ἐπί and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; to inspect, i.e. watch:--behold.

glosses: from ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι
ἐπόπτης.shortDef: from ἐπί and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; a looker-on:--eye-witness.

ἐπουράνιος.shortDef: from ἐπί and οὐρανός; above the sky:--celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.

ἑπτάκις.shortDef: adverb from ἑπτά; seven times:--seven times.

ἑπτακισχίλιοι.shortDef: from ἑπτάκις and χίλιοι; seven times a thousand:--seven thousand.

glosses: a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense
ἔπω.shortDef: a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from ἐρέω, ῥέω, and φημί); to speak or say (by word or writing):--answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell. Compare λέγω.

ἔραστος.shortDef: from  (to love); beloved; Erastus, a Christian:--Erastus.

ἐργάζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from ἔργον; to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc.:--commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work.

ἐργασία.shortDef: from ἐργάτης; occupation; by implication, profit, pains:--craft, diligence, gain, work.

ἐργάτης.shortDef: from ἔργον; a toiler; figuratively, a teacher:--labourer, worker(-men).

ἔργον.shortDef: from a primary (but obsolete)  (to work); toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act:--deed, doing, labour, work.

glosses: from a presumed prolonged form of ἔρις
ἐρεθίζω.shortDef: from a presumed prolonged form of ἔρις; to stimulate (especially to anger):--provoke.

ἐρείδω.shortDef: of obscure affinity; to prop, i.e. (reflexively) get fast:--stick fast.

ἐρεύγομαι.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out:--utter.

glosses: apparently from ἐρέω (through the idea of inquiry)
ἐρευνάω.shortDef: apparently from ἐρέω (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate:--search.

glosses: probably a fuller form of ῥέω
ἐρέω.shortDef: probably a fuller form of ῥέω; an alternate for ἔπω in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say:--call, say, speak (of), tell.

ἔρημος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, χώρα being implied):--desert, desolate, solitary, wilderness.

ἐρημόω.shortDef: from ἔρημος; to lay waste (literally or figuratively):--(bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought.

glosses: perhaps as the same as ἐρεθίζω
ἐριθεία.shortDef: perhaps as the same as ἐρεθίζω; properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication) faction:--contention(-ious), strife.

ἔρις.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a quarrel, i.e. (by implication) wrangling:--contention, debate, strife, variance.

ἐρίφιον.shortDef: from ἔριφος; a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person):--goat.

glosses: perhaps from the same as ἔριον (through the idea of hairiness)
ἔριφος.shortDef: perhaps from the same as ἔριον (through the idea of hairiness); a kid or (genitive case) goat:--goat, kid.

ἑρμᾶς.shortDef: probably from Ἑρμῆς; Hermas, a Christian:--Hermas.

ἑρμηνεία.shortDef: from the same as ἑρμηνεύω; translation:--interpretation.

glosses: from a presumed derivative of Ἑρμῆς (as the god of language)
ἑρμηνεύω.shortDef: from a presumed derivative of Ἑρμῆς (as the god of language); to translate:--interpret.

ἑρμῆς.shortDef: perhaps from ἐρέω; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian:--Hermes, Mercury.

ἑρμογένης.shortDef: from Ἑρμῆς and γίνομαι; born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian:--Hermogenes.

glosses: neuter of a derivative of  (to creep)
ἑρπετόν.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of  (to creep); a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare רֶמֶשׂ)) a small animal:--creeping thing, serpent.

ἐρυθρός.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with θάλασσα) the Red Sea:--red.

glosses: middle voice of a primary verb  (used only in the present and imperfect tenses
ἔρχομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a primary verb  (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being  supplied by a kindred (middle voice)               ,    or (active)        ,        which do not otherwise occur); to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and  figuratively):--accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.

ἐρωτάω.shortDef: apparently from ἐρέω (compare ἐρευνάω); to interrogate; by implication, to request:--ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray. Compare πυνθάνομαι.

ἐσθής.shortDef: from  (to clothe); dress:--apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.

ἔσθησις.shortDef: from a derivative of ἐσθής; clothing (concretely):--government.

ἐσθίω.shortDef: strengthened for a primary  (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by φάγω; to eat (usually literal):--devour, eat, live.

ἐσλί.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (probably for אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי); Esli, an Israelite:--Esli.

glosses: first person plural indicative of εἰμί
ἐσμέν.shortDef: first person plural indicative of εἰμί; we are:--are, be, have our being, X have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us.

ἔσομαι.shortDef: future of εἰμί; will be:--shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.

glosses: from εἰς and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι
ἔσοπτρον.shortDef: from εἰς and a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; a mirror (for looking into):--glass. Compare κατοπτρίζομαι.

ἑσπέρα.shortDef: feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (ὥρα being implied):--evening(-tide).

ἐσρώμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חֶצְרוֹן); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite:--Esrom.

glosses: second person plural present indicative of εἰμί
ἐστέ.shortDef: second person plural present indicative of εἰμί; ye are:--be, have been, belong.

glosses: third person singular present indicative of εἰμί
ἐστί.shortDef: third person singular present indicative of εἰμί; he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are:--are, be(-long), call, X can(-not), come, consisteth, X dure for a while, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle.

glosses: second person singular present imperative of εἰμί
ἔστω.shortDef: second person singular present imperative of εἰμί; be thou;  also    , third person of the same; let them be:--be.

glosses: a superlative probably from ἔχω (in the sense of contiguity)
ἔσχατος.shortDef: a superlative probably from ἔχω (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time):--ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.

ἐσχάτως.shortDef: adverb from ἔσχατος; finally, i.e. (with ἔχω) at the extremity of life:--point of death.

ἔσω.shortDef: from εἰς; inside (as preposition or adjective):-- (with-)in(-ner, -to, -ward).

ἔσωθεν.shortDef: from ἔσω; from inside; also used as equivalent to ἔσω (inside):--inward(-ly), (from) within, without.

ἑτερόγλωσσος.shortDef: from ἕτερος and γλῶσσα; other- tongued, i.e. a foreigner:--man of other tongue.

ἑτεροδιδασκαλέω.shortDef: from ἕτερος and διδάσκαλος; to instruct differently:--teach other doctrine(-wise).

glosses: from a compound of ἕτερος and ζυγός
ἑτεροζυγέω.shortDef: from a compound of ἕτερος and ζυγός; to yoke up differently, i.e. (figuratively) to associate discordantly:--unequally yoke together with.

ἕτερος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; (an-, the) other or different:--altered, else, next (day), one, (an-)other, some, strange.

ἔτι.shortDef: perhaps akin to ἔτος; "yet," still (of time or degree):--after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet.

ἑτοιμάζω.shortDef: from ἕτοιμος; to prepare:--prepare, provide, make ready. Compare κατασκευάζω.

ἕτοιμος.shortDef: from an old noun  (fitness); adjusted, i.e. ready:--prepared, (made) ready(-iness, to our hand).

ἔτος.shortDef: apparently a primary word; a year:--year.

εὖ.shortDef: neuter of a primary  (good); (adverbially) well:--good, well (done).

εὖα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (חַוָּה); Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman:--Eve.

εὐαγγελίζω.shortDef: from εὖ and ἄγγελος; to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel:--declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel).

εὐαγγέλιον.shortDef: from the same as εὐαγγελίζω; a good message, i.e. the gospel:--gospel.

εὐαγγελιστής.shortDef: from εὐαγγελίζω; a preacher of the gospel:--evangelist.

εὐάρεστος.shortDef: from εὖ and ἀρεστός; fully agreeable:--acceptable(-ted), wellpleasing.

εὐαρέστως.shortDef: adverb from εὐάρεστος; quite agreeably:--acceptably, + please well.

εὔβουλος.shortDef: from εὖ and βούλομαι; good-willer; Eubulus, a Christian:--Eubulus.

εὐγενής.shortDef: from εὖ and γίνομαι; well born, i.e. (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous:--more noble, nobleman.

glosses: feminine from εὖ and the alternate of Ζεύς (as the god of the weather)
εὐδία.shortDef: feminine from εὖ and the alternate of Ζεύς (as the god of the weather); a clear sky, i.e. fine weather:--fair weather.

εὐδοκέω.shortDef: from εὖ and δοκέω; to think well of, i.e. approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing):--think good, (be well) please(-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing.

glosses: from a presumed compound of εὖ and the base of δοκέω
εὐδοκία.shortDef: from a presumed compound of εὖ and the base of δοκέω; satisfaction, i.e. (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose:--desire, good pleasure (will), X seem good.

εὐεργεσία.shortDef: from εὐεργέτης; beneficence (genitive case or specially):--benefit, good deed done.

εὐεργετέω.shortDef: from εὐεργέτης; to be philanthropic:--do good.

glosses: from εὖ and the base of ἔργον
εὐεργέτης.shortDef: from εὖ and the base of ἔργον; a worker of good, i.e. (specially) a philanthropist:--benefactor.

glosses: from εὖ and a derivative of τίθημι
εὔθετος.shortDef: from εὖ and a derivative of τίθημι; well placed, i.e. (figuratively) appropriate:--fit, meet.

εὐθέως.shortDef: adverb from εὐθύς; directly, i.e. at once or soon:--anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.

εὐθυδρομέω.shortDef: from εὐθύς and δρόμος; to lay a straight course, i.e. sail direct:--(come) with a straight course.

εὐθυμέω.shortDef: from εὔθυμος; to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully:--be of good cheer (merry).

εὔθυμος.shortDef: from εὖ and θυμός; in fine spirits, i.e. cheerful:--of good cheer, the more cheerfully.

εὐθύνω.shortDef: from εὐθύς; to straighten (level); technically, to steer:--governor, make straight.

εὐθύς.shortDef: perhaps from εὖ and τίθημι; straight, i.e. (literally) level, or (figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once:--anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway.

εὐκαιρέω.shortDef: from εὔκαιρος; to have good time, i.e. opportunity or leisure:--have leisure (convenient time), spend time.

εὔκαιρος.shortDef: from εὖ and καιρός; well-timed, i.e. opportune:--convenient, in time of need.

εὐκαίρως.shortDef: adverb from εὔκαιρος; opportunely:--conveniently, in season.

glosses: comparative of a compound of εὖ and κόπος
εὐκοπώτερος.shortDef: comparative of a compound of εὖ and κόπος; better for toil, i.e. more facile:--easier.

εὐλάβεια.shortDef: from εὐλαβής; properly, caution, i.e. (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication, dread (concretely):--fear(-ed).

εὐλαβέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from εὐλαβής; to be circumspect, i.e. (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence:--(moved with) fear.

εὐλαβής.shortDef: from εὖ and λαμβάνω; taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect (religiously, pious):--devout.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and λόγος
εὐλογέω.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and λόγος; to speak well of, i.e. (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper):--bless, praise.

εὐλογία.shortDef: from the same as εὐλογέω; fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess:--blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.

glosses: from εὖ and a presumed derivative of μεταδίδωμι
εὐμετάδοτος.shortDef: from εὖ and a presumed derivative of μεταδίδωμι; good at imparting, i.e. liberal:--ready to distribute.

εὐνίκη.shortDef: from εὖ and νίκη; victorious; Eunice, a Jewess:--Eunice.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and νοῦς
εὐνοέω.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and νοῦς; to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile:--agree.

εὔνοια.shortDef: from the same as εὐνοέω; kindness; euphemistically, conjugal duty:--benevolence, good will.

εὐνουχίζω.shortDef: from εὐνοῦχος; to castrate (figuratively, live unmarried):--make…eunuch.

εὐνοῦχος.shortDef: from  (a bed) and ἔχω; a castrated person (such being employed in Oriental bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication, a chamberlain (state-officer):--eunuch.

εὐοδία.shortDef: from the same as εὐοδόω; fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman:--Euodias.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and ὁδός
εὐοδόω.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and ὁδός; to help on the road, i.e. (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business affairs:--(have a) prosper(-ous journey).

εὐπειθής.shortDef: from εὖ and πείθω; good for persuasion, i.e. (intransitively) complaint:--easy to be intreated.

glosses: from εὖ and a derivative of a presumed compound of περί and ἵστημι
εὐπερίστατος.shortDef: from εὖ and a derivative of a presumed compound of περί and ἵστημι; well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case):--which doth so easily beset.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and ποιέω
εὐποιΐα.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and ποιέω; well-doing, i.e. beneficence:--to do good.

glosses: from a compound of ἑτοιμάζω and the base of πορεία
εὐπορέω.shortDef: from a compound of ἑτοιμάζω and the base of πορεία; (intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary means:--ability.

εὐπορία.shortDef: from the same as εὐπορέω; pecuniary resources:--wealth.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and πρέπω
εὐπρέπεια.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and πρέπω; good suitableness, i.e. gracefulness:--grace.

glosses: from εὖ and a derivative of προσδέχομαι
εὐπρόσδεκτος.shortDef: from εὖ and a derivative of προσδέχομαι; well-received, i.e. approved, favorable:--acceptable(-ted).

glosses: from εὖ and the same as προσεδρεύω
εὐπρόσεδρος.shortDef: from εὖ and the same as προσεδρεύω; sitting well towards, i.e. (figuratively) assiduous (neuter, diligent service):--X attend upon.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and πρόσωπον
εὐπροσωπέω.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and πρόσωπον; to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display:--make a fair show.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary
εὑρίσκω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary               ,      which                                 (together with another cognate form)                   is used for it in all the tenses                                except the present and imperfect; to find (literally or figuratively):--find, get, obtain, perceive, see.

εὐροκλύδων.shortDef: from  (the east wind) and κλύδων; a storm from the East (or southeast), i.e. (in modern phrase) a Levanter:--Euroklydon.

εὐσέβεια.shortDef: from εὐσεβής; piety; specially, the gospel scheme:--godliness, holiness.

εὐσεβέω.shortDef: from εὐσεβής; to be pious, i.e. (towards God) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support):--show piety, worship.

εὐσεβής.shortDef: from εὖ and σέβομαι; well-reverent, i.e. pious:--devout, godly.

glosses: from εὖ and the base of σημαίνω
εὔσημος.shortDef: from εὖ and the base of σημαίνω; well indicated, i.e. (figuratively) significant:--easy to be understood.

εὔσπλαγχνος.shortDef: from εὖ and σπλάγχνον; well compassioned, i.e. sympathetic:--pitiful, tender-hearted.

εὐσχήμων.shortDef: from εὖ and σχῆμα; well-formed, i.e. (figuratively) decorous, noble (in rank):--comely, honourable.

glosses: adverb from a compound of εὖ and a derivative of  (to stretch)
εὐτόνως.shortDef: adverb from a compound of εὖ and a derivative of  (to stretch); in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely):--mightily, vehemently.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and a derivative of the base of τροπή (meaning well-turned
εὐτραπελία.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and a derivative of the base of τροπή (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose); witticism, i.e. (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry:--jesting.

glosses: from εὖ and a derivative of τυγχάνω
εὔτυχος.shortDef: from εὖ and a derivative of τυγχάνω; well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man:--Eutychus.

εὐφημία.shortDef: from εὔφημος; good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute):--good report.

εὔφημος.shortDef: from εὖ and φήμη; well spoken of, i.e. reputable:--of good report.

εὐφορέω.shortDef: from εὖ and φορέω; to bear well, i.e. be fertile:--bring forth abundantly.

εὐφραίνω.shortDef: from εὖ and φρήν; to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good frame of mind, i.e. rejoice:--fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice.

εὐφράτης.shortDef: of foreign origin (compare פְּרָת); Euphrates, a river of Asia:--Euphrates.

εὐφροσύνη.shortDef: from the same as εὐφραίνω; joyfulness:--gladness, joy.

εὐχαριστέω.shortDef: from εὐχάριστος; to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal:--(give) thank(-ful, -s).

εὐχαριστία.shortDef: from εὐχάριστος; gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act of worship):--thankfulness, (giving of) thanks(-giving).

glosses: from εὖ and a derivative of χαρίζομαι
εὐχάριστος.shortDef: from εὖ and a derivative of χαρίζομαι; well favored, i.e. (by implication) grateful:--thankful.

εὐχή.shortDef: from εὔχομαι; properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation:--prayer, vow.

glosses: middle voice of a primary verb
εὔχομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a primary verb; to wish; by implication, to pray to God:--pray, will, wish.

εὔχρηστος.shortDef: from εὖ and χρηστός; easily used, i.e. useful:--profitable, meet for use.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and ψυχή
εὐψυχέω.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and ψυχή; to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged:--be of good comfort.

glosses: from a compound of εὖ and a derivative of ὄζω
εὐωδία.shortDef: from a compound of εὖ and a derivative of ὄζω; good-scentedness, i.e. fragrance:--sweet savour (smell, -smelling).

εὐώνυμος.shortDef: from εὖ and ὄνομα; properly, well-named (good-omened), i.e. the left (which was the lucky side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as adverbial, at the left hand:--(on the) left.

ἐφάλλομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἅλλομαι; to spring upon:--leap on.

ἐφάπαξ.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἅπαξ; upon one occasion (only):--(at) once (for all).

ἐφεσῖνος.shortDef: from Ἔφεσος; Ephesine, or situated at Ephesus:--of Ephesus.

ἐφέσιος.shortDef: from Ἔφεσος; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus:--Ephesian, of Ephesus.

ἔφεσος.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor:--Ephesus.

glosses: from a compound of ἐπί and εὑρίσκω
ἐφευρετής.shortDef: from a compound of ἐπί and εὑρίσκω; a discoverer, i.e. contriver:--inventor.

ἐφημερία.shortDef: from ἐφήμερος; diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families:--course.

ἐφήμερος.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἡμέρα; for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal:--daily.

glosses: from ἐπί and a cognate of ἥκω
ἐφικνέομαι.shortDef: from ἐπί and a cognate of ἥκω; to arrive upon, i.e. extend to:--reach.

ἐφίστημι.shortDef: from ἐπί and ἵστημι; to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal); --assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over).

glosses: of Hebrew origin (אֶפְרַיִם or better עֶפְרוֹן)
ἐφραίμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֶפְרַיִם or better עֶפְרוֹן); Ephraim, a place in Palestine:--Ephraim.

ἔχθρα.shortDef: feminine of ἐχθρός; hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition:--enmity, hatred.

ἐχθρός.shortDef: from a primary  (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially Satan):--enemy, foe.

ἔχιδνα.shortDef: of uncertain origin; an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively):--viper.

ἔχω.shortDef: a primary verb; to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability, contiuity, relation, or condition):--be (able, X hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can(+ -not), X conceive, count, diseased, do + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, + lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, + recover, + reign, + rest, + return, X sick, take for, + tremble, + uncircumcised, use.

ἕως.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place):--even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s).

ζαβουλών.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (זְבוּלוּן); Zabulon (i.e. Zebulon), a region of Palestine:--Zabulon.

ζακχαῖος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (compare זַכַּי); Zacchæus, an Israelite:--Zacchæus.

ζαρά.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (זֶרַח); Zara, (i.e. Zerach), an Israelite:--Zara.

ζαχαρίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (זְכַרְיָה); Zacharias (i.e. Zechariah), the name of two Israelites:--Zacharias.

ζάω.shortDef: a primary verb; to live (literally or figuratively):--life(-time), (a-)live(-ly), quick.

ζεβεδαῖος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (compare זַבְדִּי); Zebedæus, an Israelite:--Zebedee.

ζεστός.shortDef: from ζέω; boiled, i.e. (by implication) calid (figuratively, fervent):--hot.

ζεῦγος.shortDef: from the same as ζυγός; a couple, i.e. a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together):--yoke, pair.

glosses: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as ζυγός
ζευκτηρία.shortDef: feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as ζυγός; a fastening (tiller-rope):--band.

ζεύς.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name        , which is otherwise obsolete;        Zeus or Dis (among the Latins, Jupiter or Jove), the supreme deity of the Greeks:--Jupiter.

ζέω.shortDef: a primary verb; to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest):--be fervent.

ζῆλος.shortDef: from ζέω; properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice):--emulation, envy(-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.

ζηλόω.shortDef: from ζῆλος; to have warmth of feeling for or against:--affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealous(-ly affect).

ζηλωτής.shortDef: the same as ζηλωτής; a Zealot, i.e. (specially) partisan for Jewish political independence:--Zelotes.

glosses: probably akin to the base of δαμάζω (through the idea of violence)
ζημία.shortDef: probably akin to the base of δαμάζω (through the idea of violence); detriment:--damage, loss.

ζημιόω.shortDef: from ζημία; to injure, i.e. (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment:--be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.

glosses: probably contracted from a poetic form of Ζεύς and δῶρον
ζηνᾶς.shortDef: probably contracted from a poetic form of Ζεύς and δῶρον; Jove-given; Zenas, a Christian:--Zenas.

ζητέω.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life):--be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare πυνθάνομαι.

ζήτημα.shortDef: from ζητέω; a search (properly concretely), i.e. (in words) a debate:--question.

ζήτησις.shortDef: from ζητέω; a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its theme:--question.

ζιζάνιον.shortDef: of uncertain origin; darnel or false grain:--tares.

ζοροβάβελ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (זְרֻבָּבֶל); Zorobabel (i.e. Zerubbabel), an Israelite:--Zorobabel.

glosses: akin to the base of νέφος
ζόφος.shortDef: akin to the base of νέφος; gloom (as shrouding like a cloud):--blackness, darkness, mist.

ζυγός.shortDef: from the root of  (to join, especially by a "yoke"); a coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales):--pair of balances, yoke.

ζύμη.shortDef: probably from ζέω; ferment (as if boiling up):--leaven.

ζυμόω.shortDef: from ζύμη; to cause to ferment:--leaven.

glosses: from the same as ζῶον and ἀγρεύω
ζωγρέω.shortDef: from the same as ζῶον and ἀγρεύω; to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare:--take captive, catch.

ζωή.shortDef: from ζάω; life (literally or figuratively):--life(-time). Compare ψυχή.

glosses: probably akin to the base of ζυγός
ζώνη.shortDef: probably akin to the base of ζυγός; a belt; by implication, a pocket:--girdle, purse.

ζώννυμι.shortDef: from ζώνη; to bind about (especially with a belt):--gird.

glosses: from the same as ζῶον and a derivative of γίνομαι
ζωογονέω.shortDef: from the same as ζῶον and a derivative of γίνομαι; to engender alive, i.e. (by analogy) to rescue (passively, be saved) from death:--live, preserve.

glosses: neuter of a derivative of ζάω
ζῶον.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of ζάω; a live thing, i.e. an animal:--beast.

glosses: from the same as ζῶον and ποιέω
ζωοποιέω.shortDef: from the same as ζῶον and ποιέω; to (re-)vitalize (literally or figuratively):--make alive, give life, quicken.

glosses: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms
ἤ.shortDef: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, or; comparative, than:--and, but (either), (n-)either, except it be, (n-)or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially ἤδη, ἤπερ, ἤτοι.

ἦ.shortDef: an adverb of confirmation; perhaps intensive of ἤ; used only (in the New Testament) before μέν; assuredly:--surely.

ἡγεμονεύω.shortDef: from ἡγεμών; to act as ruler:--be governor.

ἡγεμονία.shortDef: from ἡγεμών; government, i.e. (in time) official term:--reign.

ἡγεμών.shortDef: from ἡγέομαι; a leader, i.e. chief person (or figuratively, place) of a province:--governor, prince, ruler.

glosses: middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of ἄγω
ἡγέομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of ἄγω; to lead, i.e. command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e. consider:--account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have the rule over, suppose, think.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή
ἡδέως.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of the base of ἡδονή; sweetly, i.e. (figuratively) with pleasure:--gladly.

glosses: apparently from ἤ (or possibly ἦ) and δή
ἤδη.shortDef: apparently from ἤ (or possibly ἦ) and δή; even now:--already, (even) now (already), by this time.

glosses: neuter plural of the superlative of the same as ἡδέως
ἥδιστα.shortDef: neuter plural of the superlative of the same as ἡδέως; with great pleasure:--most (very) gladly.

ἡδονή.shortDef: from  (to please); sensual delight; by implication, desire:--lust, pleasure.

glosses: neuter of the compound of the same as ἡδέως and ὀσμή
ἡδύοσμον.shortDef: neuter of the compound of the same as ἡδέως and ὀσμή; a sweet-scented plant, i.e. mint:--mint.

ἦθος.shortDef: a strengthened form of ἔθος; usage, i.e. (plural) moral habits:--manners.

ἥκω.shortDef: a primary verb; to arrive, i.e. be present (literally or figuratively):--come.

glosses: of Hebrew origin (אֵל with pronominal suffix)
ἠλί.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֵל with pronominal suffix); my God:-- Eli.

ἡλί.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֵלִי); Heli (i.e. Eli), an Israelite:--Heli.

ἡλίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֵלִיָּה); Helias (i.e. Elijah), an Israelite:--Elias.

ἡλικία.shortDef: from the same as ἡλίκος; maturity (in years or size):--age, stature.

ἡλίκος.shortDef: from  (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age); as big as, i.e. (interjectively) how much:--how (what) great.

ἥλιος.shortDef: from  (a ray; perhaps akin to the alternate of αἱρέομαι); the sun; by implication, light:--+ east, sun.

ἧλος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a stud, i.e. spike:--nail.

ἡμᾶς.shortDef: accusative case plural of ἐγώ; us:--our, us, we.

ἡμεῖς.shortDef: nominative plural of ἐγώ; we (only used when emphatic):--us, we (ourselves).

glosses: feminine (with ὥρα implied) of a derivative of  (to sit
ἡμέρα.shortDef: feminine (with ὥρα implied) of a derivative of  (to sit; akin to the base of ἑδραῖος) meaning tame, i.e. gentle; day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context):--age, + alway, (mid-)day (by day, (-ly)), + for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years.

ἡμέτερος.shortDef: from θνητός; our:--our, your (by a different reading).

ἤμην.shortDef: a prolonged form of ἦν; I was:--be, was. (Sometimes unexpressed).

glosses: from a presumed compound of the base of ἥμισυ and θνήσκω
ἡμιθανής.shortDef: from a presumed compound of the base of ἥμισυ and θνήσκω; half dead, i.e. entirely exhausted:--half dead.

ἡμῖν.shortDef: dative case plural of ἐγώ; to (or for, with, by) us:--our, (for) us, we.

glosses: neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to ἅμα (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-
ἥμισυ.shortDef: neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to ἅμα (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-; (as noun) half:--half.

glosses: from the base of ἥμισυ and ὥρα
ἡμιώριον.shortDef: from the base of ἥμισυ and ὥρα; a half-hour:--half an hour.

ἡμῶν.shortDef: genitive case plural of ἐγώ; of (or from) us:--our (company), us, we.

ἦν.shortDef: imperfect of εἰμί; I (thou, etc.) was (wast or were):--+ agree, be, X have (+ charge of), hold, use, was(-t), were.

ἡνίκα.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; at which time:--when.

ἤπερ.shortDef: from ἤ and περ; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed):--than.

ἤπιος.shortDef: probably from ἔπος; properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind:--gentle.

ἤρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֵר); Er, an Israelite:--Er.

glosses: perhaps by transposition from ἔρημος (through the idea of stillness)
ἤρεμος.shortDef: perhaps by transposition from ἔρημος (through the idea of stillness); tranquil:--quiet.

ἡρώδης.shortDef: compound of  (a "hero") and εἶδος; heroic; Herod, the name of four Jewish kings:--Herod.

glosses: plural of a derivative of Ἡρώδης
ἡρωδιανοί.shortDef: plural of a derivative of Ἡρώδης; Herodians, i.e. partisans of Herod:--Herodians.

ἡρωδιάς.shortDef: from Ἡρώδης; Herodias, a woman of the Heodian family:--Herodias.

ἡσαΐας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְשַׁעְיָה); Hesaias (i.e. Jeshajah), an Israelite:--Esaias.

ἠσαῦ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (עֵשָׂו); Esau, an Edomite:--Esau.

ἡσυχάζω.shortDef: from the same as ἡσύχιος; to keep still (intransitively), i.e. refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech:--cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest.

ἡσυχία.shortDef: feminine of ἡσύχιος; (as noun) stillness, i.e. desistance from bustle or language:--quietness, silence.

glosses: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of ἑδραῖος and perhaps ἔχω
ἡσύχιος.shortDef: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of ἑδραῖος and perhaps ἔχω; properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e. (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing):--peaceable, quiet.

ἤτοι.shortDef: from ἤ and τοί; either indeed:--whether.

ἡττάω.shortDef: from the same as ἥττον; to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower:--be inferior, overcome.

ἥττημα.shortDef: from ἡττάω; a deterioration, i.e. (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss:--diminishing, fault.

glosses: neuter of comparative of  (slightly) used for that of κακός
ἥττον.shortDef: neuter of comparative of  (slightly) used for that of κακός; worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.

glosses: third person singular imperative of εἰμί
ἤτω.shortDef: third person singular imperative of εἰμί; let him (or it) be:--let … be.

ἠχέω.shortDef: from ἦχος; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.

ἦχος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar; figuratively, a rumor:--fame, sound.

θαδδαῖος.shortDef: of uncertain origin; Thaddæus, one of the Apostles:--Thaddæus.

θάλασσα.shortDef: probably prolonged from ἅλς; the sea (genitive case or specially):--sea.

θάλπω.shortDef: probably akin to  (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster:--cherish.

θάμαρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (תָּמָר); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar.

θαμβέω.shortDef: from θάμβος; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.

θάμβος.shortDef: akin to an obsolete  (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), i.e. astonishment:--X amazed, + astonished, wonder.

glosses: from (the feminine form of) θάνατος and φέρω
θανατήφορος.shortDef: from (the feminine form of) θάνατος and φέρω; death-bearing, i.e. fatal:--deadly.

θάνατος.shortDef: from θνήσκω; (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively):--X deadly, (be…) death.

glosses: from θάνατος to kill (literally or figuratively):--become dead
θανατόω.shortDef: from θάνατος to kill (literally or figuratively):--become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.

θάπτω.shortDef: a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter:--bury.

θάρα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (תֶּרַח); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham:--Thara.

θαῤῥέω.shortDef: another form for θαρσέω; to exercise courage:--be bold, X boldly, have confidence, be confident. Compare τολμάω.

θαρσέω.shortDef: from θάρσος; to have courage:--be of good cheer (comfort). Compare θαῤῥέω.

glosses: apparently from a form of θεάομαι
θαῦμα.shortDef: apparently from a form of θεάομαι; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract):--admiration.

θαυμάζω.shortDef: from θαῦμα; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.

θαυμάσιος.shortDef: from θαῦμα; wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle:--wonderful thing.

θαυμαστός.shortDef: from θαυμάζω; wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful:--marvel(-lous).

θεά.shortDef: feminine of θεός; a female deity:--goddess.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb
θεάομαι.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit:--behold, look (upon), see. Compare ὀπτάνομαι.

θεατρίζω.shortDef: from θέατρον; to expose as a spectacle:--make a gazing stock.

θέατρον.shortDef: from θεάομαι; a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e. general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively):--spectacle, theatre.

glosses: probably neuter of θεῖος (in its original sense of flashing)
θεῖον.shortDef: probably neuter of θεῖος (in its original sense of flashing); sulphur:--brimstone.

θεῖος.shortDef: from θεός; godlike (neuter as noun, divinity):-- divine, godhead.

θειώδης.shortDef: from θεῖον and 1491; sulphur-like, i.e. sulphurous:--brimstone.

glosses: from the prolonged form of θέλω
θέλημα.shortDef: from the prolonged form of θέλω; a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination:-- desire, pleasure, will.

θέλησις.shortDef: from θέλω; determination (properly, the act), i.e. option:--will.

glosses: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι
θέλω.shortDef: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι; to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas βούλομαι properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in:--desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly)).

θεμέλιος.shortDef: from a derivative of τίθημι; something put down, i.e. a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively):--foundation.

θεμελιόω.shortDef: from θεμέλιος; to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate:--(lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.

θεοδίδακτος.shortDef: from θεός and διδάσκω; divinely instructed:--taught of God.

θεομαχέω.shortDef: from θεομάχος; to resist deity:--fight against God.

θεομάχος.shortDef: from θεός and μάχομαι; an opponent of deity:--to fight against God.

glosses: from θεός and a presumed derivative of πνέω
θεόπνευστος.shortDef: from θεός and a presumed derivative of πνέω; divinely breathed in:--given by inspiration of God.

θεός.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with ὁ) the supreme Divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very:--X exceeding, God, god(-ly, -ward).

θεοσεβής.shortDef: from θεός and σέβομαι; reverent of God, i.e. pious:--worshipper of God.

glosses: from θεός and the base of στυγνητός
θεοστυγής.shortDef: from θεός and the base of στυγνητός; hateful to God, i.e. impious:--hater of God.

θεόφιλος.shortDef: from θεός and φίλος; friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian:--Theophilus.

θεραπεία.shortDef: from θεραπεύω; attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics:--healing, household.

θεραπεύω.shortDef: from the same as θεράπων; to wait upon menially, i.e. (figuratively) to adore (God), or (specially) to relieve (of disease):--cure, heal, worship.

glosses: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of θέρος
θεράπων.shortDef: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of θέρος; a menial attendant (as if cherishing):--servant.

glosses: from θέρος (in the sense of the crop)
θερίζω.shortDef: from θέρος (in the sense of the crop); to harvest:--reap.

θερισμός.shortDef: from θερίζω; reaping, i.e. the crop:--harvest.

θερμαίνω.shortDef: from θέρμη; to heat (oneself):--(be) warm(-ed, self).

θέρμη.shortDef: from the base of θέρος; warmth:--heat.

θέρος.shortDef: from a primary  (to heat); properly, heat, i.e. summer:--summer.

θεσσαλονικεύς.shortDef: from Θεσσαλονίκη; a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of Thessalonice:--Thessalonian.

θεσσαλονίκη.shortDef: from  (a Thessalian) and νίκη; Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor:--Thessalonica.

θευδᾶς.shortDef: of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite:--Theudas.

glosses: from a derivative of θεάομαι (perhaps by addition of ὁράω)
θεωρέω.shortDef: from a derivative of θεάομαι (perhaps by addition of ὁράω); to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge)):--behold, consider, look on, perceive, see. Compare ὀπτάνομαι.

θεωρία.shortDef: from the same as θεωρέω; spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a spectacle:--sight.

θήκη.shortDef: from τίθημι; a receptacle, i.e. scabbard:--sheath.

θηλάζω.shortDef: from  (the nipple); to suckle, (by implication) to suck:--(give) suck(-ling).

θῆλυς.shortDef: from the same as θηλάζω; female:--female, woman.

θήρα.shortDef: from  (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively) destruction:--trap.

θηρεύω.shortDef: from θήρα; to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at:--catch.

glosses: from a compound of θηρίον and μάχομαι
θηριομαχέω.shortDef: from a compound of θηρίον and μάχομαι; to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e. (figuratively) to encounter (furious men):--fight with wild beasts.

glosses: diminutive from the same as θήρα
θηρίον.shortDef: diminutive from the same as θήρα; a dangerous animal:--(venomous, wild) beast.

θησαυρίζω.shortDef: from θησαυρός; to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively):--lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).

θησαυρός.shortDef: from τίθημι; a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively):--treasure.

glosses: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary  (to finger)
θιγγάνω.shortDef: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary  (to finger); to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure:--handle, touch.

glosses: akin to the base of τρίβος
θλίβω.shortDef: akin to the base of τρίβος; to crowd (literally or figuratively):--afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.

θλῖψις.shortDef: from θλίβω; pressure (literally or figuratively):--afflicted(-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.

glosses: a strengthened form of a simpler primary   (which is used for it only in certain tenses)
θνήσκω.shortDef: a strengthened form of a simpler primary   (which is used for it only in certain tenses); to die (literally or figuratively):--be dead, die.

θορυβέω.shortDef: from θόρυβος; to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor:--make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.

θόρυβος.shortDef: from the base of θροέω; a disturbance:--tumult, uproar.

θραύω.shortDef: a primary verb; to crush:--bruise. Compare ῥήγνυμι.

θρέμμα.shortDef: from τρέφω; stock (as raised on a farm):--cattle.

θρῆνος.shortDef: from the base of θροέω; wailing:--lamentation.

θρησκεία.shortDef: from a derivative of θρησκός; ceremonial observance:--religion, worshipping.

glosses: probably from the base of θροέω
θρησκός.shortDef: probably from the base of θροέω; ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious:--religious.

glosses: from a prolonged compound of the base of θροέω
θριαμβεύω.shortDef: from a prolonged compound of the base of θροέω; and a derivative of ἅπτομαι (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory:--(cause) to triumph (over).

θρίξ.shortDef: genitive case , etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair:--hair. Compare κόμη.

θροέω.shortDef: from  to wail; to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to frighten:--trouble.

glosses: perhaps from τρέφω (in the sense of thickening)
θρόμβος.shortDef: perhaps from τρέφω (in the sense of thickening); a clot:--great drop.

θρόνος.shortDef: from  (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate:--seat, throne.

θυάτειρα.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor:--Thyatira.

θυγάτηρ.shortDef: apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant):--daughter.

glosses: from θύω (in the sense of blowing) a storm:--tempest.
θύελλα.shortDef: from θύω (in the sense of blowing) a storm:--tempest.

glosses: from a derivative of θύω (in the sense of blowing
θύϊνος.shortDef: from a derivative of θύω (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron-wood:--thyine.

θυμίαμα.shortDef: from θυμιάω; an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself:--incense, odour.

θυμιαστήριον.shortDef: from a derivative of θυμιάω; a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of incense (in the Temple):--censer.

glosses: from a derivative of θύω (in the sense of smoking)
θυμιάω.shortDef: from a derivative of θύω (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes:--burn incense.

glosses: from a presumed compound of θυμός and μάχομαι
θυμομαχέω.shortDef: from a presumed compound of θυμός and μάχομαι; to be in a furious fight, i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated:--be highly displeased.

θυμός.shortDef: from θύω; passion (as if breathing hard):--fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare ψυχή.

θυμόω.shortDef: from θυμός; to put in a passion, i.e. enrage:--be wroth.

θύρα.shortDef: apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively):--door, gate.

θυρεός.shortDef: from θύρα; a large shield (as door-shaped):--shield.

θυρίς.shortDef: from θύρα; an aperture, i.e. window:--window.

θυρωρός.shortDef: from θύρα and  (a watcher); a gate- warden:--that kept the door, porter.

θυσία.shortDef: from θύω; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively):--sacrifice.

θυσιαστήριον.shortDef: from a derivative of θυσία; a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative):--altar.

θύω.shortDef: a primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose):--kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.

θωμᾶς.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare תָּאוֹם); the twin; Thomas, a Christian:--Thomas.

θώραξ.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet:--breast-plate.

ἰάειρος.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יָאִיר); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite:--Jairus.

ἰακώβ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יַעֲקֹב); Jacob (i.e. Ja`akob), the progenitor of the Israelites:--also an Israelite:--Jacob.

ἰάκωβος.shortDef: the same as Ἰακώβ Græcized; Jacobus, the name of three Israelites:--James.

ἰαμβρῆς.shortDef: of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian:--Jambres.

ἰαννά.shortDef: probably of Hebrew origin (compare יָנָה); Janna, an Israelite:--Janna.

ἰαννῆς.shortDef: of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian:--Jannes.

glosses: middle voice of apparently a primary verb
ἰάομαι.shortDef: middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to cure (literally or figuratively):--heal, make whole.

ἰάρεδ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יֶרֶד); Jared (i.e. Jered), an antediluvian:--Jared.

ἴασπις.shortDef: probably of foreign origin (see יָשְׁפֵה); "jasper", a gem:--jasper.

glosses: future active participle masculine of ἰάομαι
ἰάσων.shortDef: future active participle masculine of ἰάομαι; about to cure; Jason, a Christian:--Jason.

glosses: second person singular imperative active of εἴδω
ἴδε.shortDef: second person singular imperative active of εἴδω; used as an interjection to denote surprise; lo!:--behold, lo, see.

ἰδέα.shortDef: from εἴδω; a sight (comparative figuratively "idea"), i.e. aspect:--countenance.

ἴδιος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by implication, private or separate:--X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their (own).

ἰδιώτης.shortDef: from ἴδιος; a private person, i.e. (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot"):--ignorant, rude, unlearned.

glosses: second person singular imperative middle voice of εἴδω
ἰδού.shortDef: second person singular imperative middle voice of εἴδω; used as imperative lo!; --behold, lo, see.

ἰδουμαία.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אֱדֹם); Idumæa (i.e. Edom), a region East (and South) of Palestine:--Idumæa.

glosses: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat)
ἱδρώς.shortDef: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat); perspiration:--sweat.

ἰεζαβήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אִיזֶבֶל); Jezabel (i.e. Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher):--Jezabel.

ἱεράπολις.shortDef: from ἱερός and πόλις; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor:--Hierapolis.

ἱερατεία.shortDef: from ἱερατεύω; priestliness, i.e. the sacerdotal function:--office of the priesthood, priest's office.

ἱεράτευμα.shortDef: from ἱερατεύω; the priestly fraternity, i.e. sacerdotal order (figuratively):--priesthood.

ἱερατεύω.shortDef: prolongation from ἱερεύς; to be a priest, i.e. perform his functions:--execute the priest's office.

ἱερεμίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יִרְמְיָה); Hieremias (i.e. Jermijah), an Israelite:--Jeremiah.

ἱερεύς.shortDef: from ἱερός; a priest (literally or figuratively):--(high) priest.

ἱεριχώ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְרִיחוֹ); Jericho, a place in Palestine:--Jericho.

ἱερόν.shortDef: neuter of ἱερός; a sacred place, i.e. the entire precincts (whereas ναός denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere):--temple.

glosses: from ἱερός and the same as πρέπω
ἱεροπρεπής.shortDef: from ἱερός and the same as πρέπω; reverent:--as becometh holiness.

ἱεροσόλυμα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם); Hierosolyma (i.e. Jerushalaim), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare Ἱερουσαλήμ.

ἱεροσολυμίτης.shortDef: from Ἱεροσόλυμα; a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma:--of Jerusalem.

ἱεροσυλέω.shortDef: from ἱερόσυλος; to be a temple-robber (figuratively):--commit sacrilege.

ἱερόσυλος.shortDef: from ἱερόν and συλάω; a temple-despoiler:--robber of churches.

glosses: from a compound of ἱερόν and the base of ἔργον
ἱερουργέω.shortDef: from a compound of ἱερόν and the base of ἔργον; to be a temple-worker, i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively):--minister.

ἱερουσαλήμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare Ἱεροσόλυμα.

ἱερωσύνη.shortDef: from ἱερός; sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly office:--priesthood.

ἰεσσαί.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יִשַׁי); Jessæ (i.e. Jishai), an Israelite:--Jesse.

ἰεφθάε.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יִפְתָּח); Jephthaë (i.e. Jiphtach), an Israelite:--Jephthah.

ἰεχονίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְכׇנְיָה); Jechonias (i.e. Jekonjah), an Israelite:--Jechonias.

ἰησοῦς.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְהוֹשׁוּעַ); Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites:--Jesus.

ἱκανός.shortDef: from  ( or , akin to ἥκω) (to arrive); competent (as if coming in season), i.e. ample (in amount) or fit (in character):--able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.

ἱκανόω.shortDef: from ἱκανός; to enable, i.e. qualify:--make able (meet).

glosses: from a derivative of the base of ἱκανός (through the idea of approaching for a favor)
ἱκετηρία.shortDef: from a derivative of the base of ἱκανός (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty:--supplication.

ἰκόνιον.shortDef: perhaps from εἰκών; image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor:--Iconium.

ἱλαρός.shortDef: from the same as ἵλεως; propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e. prompt or willing:--cheerful.

glosses: middle voice from the same as ἵλεως
ἱλάσκομαι.shortDef: middle voice from the same as ἵλεως; to conciliate, i.e. (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious:--be merciful, make reconciliation for.

glosses: neuter of a derivative of ἱλάσκομαι
ἱλαστήριον.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of ἱλάσκομαι; an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple):--mercyseat, propitiation.

glosses: perhaps from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι
ἵλεως.shortDef: perhaps from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι; cheerful (as attractive), i.e. propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, i.e. (in averting some calamity) far be it:--be it far, merciful.

glosses: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation
ἰλλυρικόν.shortDef: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation; (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe:--Illyricum.

glosses: perhaps from the same as ἅμα
ἱμάς.shortDef: perhaps from the same as ἅμα; a strap, i.e. (specially) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge):--latchet, thong.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on)
ἱμάτιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on); a dress (inner or outer):--apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.

ἱματισμός.shortDef: from ἱματίζω; clothing:--apparel (X -led), array, raiment, vesture.

ἱμείρομαι.shortDef: middle voice from  (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long for:--be affectionately desirous.

glosses: probably from the same as the former part of ἑαυτοῦ (through the demonstrative idea
ἵνα.shortDef: probably from the same as the former part of ἑαυτοῦ (through the demonstrative idea; compare ὁ); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result):--albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to. Compare ἵνα μή.

ἱνατί.shortDef: from ἵνα and τίς; for what reason ?, i.e. why?:--wherefore, why.

ἰόππη.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יָפוֹ); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine:--Joppa.

ἰορδάνης.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יַרְדֵּן); the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of Palestine:--Jordan.

ἰός.shortDef: perhaps from  (to go) or  (to send); rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents):--poison, rust.

glosses: of Hebrew origin (יְהוּדָה or perhaps יֻטָּה)
ἰουδά.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְהוּדָה or perhaps יֻטָּה); Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine:--Judah.

ἰουδαία.shortDef: feminine of Ἰουδαῖος (with γῆ implied); the Judæan land (i.e. Judæa), a region of Palestine:--Judæa.

ἰουδαΐζω.shortDef: from Ἰουδαῖος; to become a Judæan, i.e. "Judaize":--live as the Jews.

ἰουδαϊκός.shortDef: from Ἰουδαῖος; Judaïc, i.e. resembling a Judæan:--Jewish.

ἰουδαϊκῶς.shortDef: adverb from Ἰουδαϊκός; Judaïcally or in a manner resembling a Judæan:--as do the Jews.

glosses: from Ἰουδά (in the sense of Ἰούδας as a country)
ἰουδαῖος.shortDef: from Ἰουδά (in the sense of Ἰούδας as a country); Judæan, i.e. belonging to Jehudah:--Jew(-ess), of Judæa.

ἰουδαϊσμός.shortDef: from Ἰουδαΐζω; "Judaism", i.e. the Jewish faith and usages:--Jews' religion.

ἰούδας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְהוּדָה); Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region:--Juda(-h, -s); Jude.

glosses: feminine of the same as Ἰούλιος
ἰουλία.shortDef: feminine of the same as Ἰούλιος; Julia, a Christian woman:--Julia.

ἰούλιος.shortDef: of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion:--Julius.

ἰουνιᾶς.shortDef: of Latin origin; Junias, a Christian:--Junias.

ἰοῦστος.shortDef: of Latin origin ("just"); Justus, the name of three Christian:--Justus.

ἱππεύς.shortDef: from ἵππος; an equestrian, i.e. member of a cavalry corps:--horseman.

glosses: neuter of a derivative of ἵππος
ἱππικόν.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of ἵππος; the cavalry force:--horse(-men).

glosses: perhaps from ἐρέω (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities)
ἶρις.shortDef: perhaps from ἐρέω (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris"):--rainbow.

ἰσαάκ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יִצְחָק); Isaac (i.e. Jitschak), the son of Abraham:--Isaac.

ἰσάγγελος.shortDef: from ἴσος and ἄγγελος; like an angel, i.e. angelic:--equal unto the angels.

ἰσαχάρ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יִשָּׂשכָר); Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively, his descendant):--Issachar.

glosses: assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of εἴδω
ἴσημι.shortDef: assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of εἴδω; to know:--know.

glosses: second person imperative present of εἰμί
ἴσθι.shortDef: second person imperative present of εἰμί; be thou:--+ agree, be, X give thyself wholly to.

glosses: of Hebrew origin (probably אִישׁ and קִרְיָא)
ἰσκαριώτης.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (probably אִישׁ and קִרְיָא); inhabitant of Kerioth; Iscariotes (i.e. Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor:--Iscariot.

glosses: probably from εἴδω (through the idea of seeming)
ἴσος.shortDef: probably from εἴδω (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount and kind):--+ agree, as much, equal, like.

ἰσότιμος.shortDef: from ἴσος and τιμή; of equal value or honor:--like precious.

ἰσόψυχος.shortDef: from ἴσος and ψυχή; of similar spirit:--likeminded.

ἰσραήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יִשְׂרָאֵל); Israel (i.e. Jisrael), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively):--Israel.

ἰσραηλίτης.shortDef: from Ἰσραήλ; an "Israelite", i.e. descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively):--Israelite.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary   (of the same meaning
ἵστημι.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary   (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively):--abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up). Compare τίθημι.

ἱστορέω.shortDef: from a derivative of εἴδω; to be knowing (learned), i.e. (by implication) to visit for information (interview):--see.

ἰσχυρός.shortDef: from ἰσχύς; forcible (literally or figuratively):--boisterous, mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.

ἰσχύς.shortDef: from a derivative of  (force; compare , a form of ἔχω); forcefulness (literally or figuratively):--ability, might(-ily), power, strength.

ἰσχύω.shortDef: from ἰσχύς; to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively):--be able, avail, can do(-not), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.

ἴσως.shortDef: adverb from ἴσος; likely, i.e. perhaps:--it may be.

ἰταλία.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe:--Italy.

ἰταλικός.shortDef: from Ἰταλία; Italic, i.e. belonging to Italia:--Italian.

ἰτουραΐα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְטוּר); Ituræa (i.e. Jetur), a region of Palestine:--Ituræa.

ἰχθύδιον.shortDef: diminutive from ἰχθύς; a petty fish:--little (small) fish.

ἴχνος.shortDef: from  (to arrive; compare ἥκω); a track (figuratively):--step.

ἰωάθαμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יוֹתָם); Joatham (i.e. Jotham), an Israelite:--Joatham.

glosses: feminine of the same as Ἰωάννης
ἰωάννα.shortDef: feminine of the same as Ἰωάννης; Joanna, a Christian:--Joanna.

ἰωαννᾶς.shortDef: a form of Ἰωάννης; Joannas, an Israelite:--Joannas.

ἰωάννης.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יוֹחָנָן); Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four Israelites:--John.

ἰώβ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (אִיּוֹב); Job (i.e. Ijob), a patriarch:--Job.

ἰωήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יוֹאֵל); Joel, an Israelite:--Joel.

ἰωνάν.shortDef: probably for Ἰωάννης or Ἰωνᾶς; Jonan, an Israelite:--Jonan.

ἰωνᾶς.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יוֹנָה); Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two Israelites:--Jonas.

ἰωράμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יוֹרָם); Joram, an Israelite:--Joram.

ἰωρείμ.shortDef: perhaps for Ἰωράμ; Jorim, an Israelite:--Jorim.

ἰωσαφάτ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יְהוֹשָׁפָט); Josaphat (i.e. Jehoshaphat), an Israelite:--Josaphat.

ἰωσή.shortDef: genitive case of Ἰωσῆς; Jose, an Israelite:--Jose.

ἰωσῆς.shortDef: perhaps for Ἰωσήφ; Joses, the name of two Israelites:--Joses. Compare Ἰωσή.

ἰωσήφ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יוֹסֵף); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites:--Joseph.

ἰωσίας.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (יֹאשִׁיָּה); Josias (i.e. Joshiah), an Israelite:--Josias.

glosses: of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet)
ἰῶτα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet); "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything:--jot.

κἀγώ.shortDef: from καί and ἐγώ;   so also the dative case          ,  and accusative case                and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me:--(and, even, even so, so) I  (also, in like wise), both me, me also.

glosses: from κατά and the neuter plural of ὅς
καθά.shortDef: from κατά and the neuter plural of ὅς; according to which things, i.e. just as:--as.

καθαίρεσις.shortDef: from καθαιρέω; demolition; figuratively, extinction:--destruction, pulling down.

glosses: from κατά and αἱρέομαι (including its alternate)
καθαιρέω.shortDef: from κατά and αἱρέομαι (including its alternate); to lower (or with violence) demolish (literally or figuratively):--cast (pull, put, take) down, destroy.

καθαίρω.shortDef: from καθαρός; to cleanse, i.e. (specially) to prune; figuratively, to expiate:--purge.

καθάπερ.shortDef: from καθά and περ; exactly as:--(even, as well) as.

καθάπτω.shortDef: from κατά and ἅπτομαι; to seize upon:--fasten on.

καθαρίζω.shortDef: from καθαρός; to cleanse (literally or figuratively):--(make) clean(-se), purge, purify.

καθαρισμός.shortDef: from καθαρίζω; a washing off, i.e. (ceremonially) ablution, (morally) expiation:--cleansing, + purge, purification(-fying).

καθαρός.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; clean (literally or figuratively):--clean, clear, pure.

glosses: from κατά and the same as ἑδραῖος
καθέδρα.shortDef: from κατά and the same as ἑδραῖος; a bench (literally or figuratively):--seat.

glosses: from κατά and the base of ἑδραῖος
καθέζομαι.shortDef: from κατά and the base of ἑδραῖος; to sit down:--sit.

καθεξῆς.shortDef: from κατά and ἑξῆς; thereafter, i.e. consecutively; as a noun (by ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time:--after(-ward), by (in) order.

καθεύδω.shortDef: from κατά and  (to sleep); to lie down to rest, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)sleep.

glosses: from a compound of κατά and ἡγέομαι
καθηγητής.shortDef: from a compound of κατά and ἡγέομαι; a guide, i.e. (figuratively) a teacher:--master.

καθήκω.shortDef: from κατά and ἥκω; to reach to, i.e. (neuter of present active participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming:-- convenient, fit.

κάθημαι.shortDef: from κατά; and  (to sit; akin to the base of ἑδραῖος); to sit down; figuratively, to remain, reside:--dwell, sit (by, down).

καθίζω.shortDef: another (active) form for καθέζομαι; to seat down, i.e. set (figuratively, appoint); intransitively, to sit (down); figuratively, to settle (hover, dwell):--continue, set, sit (down), tarry.

καθίημι.shortDef: from κατά; and  (to send); to lower:--let down.

καθίστημι.shortDef: from κατά and ἵστημι; to place down (permanently), i.e. (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy:--appoint, be, conduct, make, ordain, set.

καθό.shortDef: from κατά and ὅς; according to which thing, i.e. precisely as, in proportion as:--according to that, (inasmuch) as.

καθόλου.shortDef: from κατά and ὅλος; on the whole, i.e. entirely:--at all.

καθοπλίζω.shortDef: from κατά; and ὁπλίζω; to equip fully with armor:--arm.

καθοράω.shortDef: from κατά and ὁράω; to behold fully, i.e. (figuratively) distinctly apprehend:--clearly see.

καθότι.shortDef: from κατά; and ὅς and τὶς; according to which certain thing, i.e. as far (or inasmuch) as:--(according, forasmuch) as, because (that).

καθώς.shortDef: from κατά and ὡς; just (or inasmuch) as, that:--according to, (according, even) as, how, when.

καί.shortDef: apparently, a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also a cumulative force; and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words:--and, also, both, but, even, for, if, or, so, that, then, therefore, when, yet.

καϊάφας.shortDef: of Chaldee origin; the dell; Caiaphas (i.e. Cajepha), an Israelite:--Caiaphas.

καίγε.shortDef: from καί and γέ; and at least (or even, indeed):--and, at least.

κάϊν.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (קַיִן); Cain, (i.e. Cajin), the son of Adam:--Cain.

καϊνάν.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (קֵינָן); Cainan (i.e. Kenan), the name of two patriarchs:--Cainan.

καινός.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; new (especially in freshness; while νέος is properly so with respect to age:--new.

καίπερ.shortDef: from καί and περ; and indeed, i.e. nevertheless or notwithstanding:--and yet, although.

καιρός.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; an occasion, i.e. set or proper time:--X always, opportunity, (convenient, due) season, (due, short, while) time, a while. Compare χρόνος.

καῖσαρ.shortDef: of Latin origin; Cæsar, a title of the Roman emperor:--Cæsar.

καισάρεια.shortDef: from Καῖσαρ; Cæsaria, the name of two places in Palestine:--Cæsarea.

καίτοι.shortDef: from καί and τοί; and yet, i.e. nevertheless:--although.

καίτοιγε.shortDef: from καίτοι and γέ; and yet indeed, i.e. although really:--nevertheless, though.

καίω.shortDef: apparently a primary verb; to set on fire, i.e. kindle or (by implication) consume:--burn, light.

κἀκεῖ.shortDef: from καί and ἐκεῖ; likewise in that place:--and there, there (thither) also.

κἀκεῖθεν.shortDef: from καί and ἐκεῖθεν; likewise from that place (or time):--and afterward (from) (thence), thence also.

κἀκεῖνος.shortDef: from καί and ἐκεῖνος; likewise that (or those):--and him (other, them), even he, him also, them (also), (and) they.

κακία.shortDef: from κακός; badness, i.e. (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble:--evil, malice(-iousness), naughtiness, wickedness.

glosses: from a compound of κακός and ἦθος
κακοήθεια.shortDef: from a compound of κακός and ἦθος; bad character, i.e. (specially) mischievousness:--malignity.

glosses: from a compound of κακός and λόγος
κακολογέω.shortDef: from a compound of κακός and λόγος; to revile:--curse, speak evil of.

glosses: from a compound of ἡμιώριον and πάθος
κακοπάθεια.shortDef: from a compound of ἡμιώριον and πάθος; hardship:--suffering affliction.

κακοπαθέω.shortDef: from the same as κακοπάθεια; to undergo hardship:--be afflicted, endure afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble.

κακοποιέω.shortDef: from κακοποιός; to be a bad-doer, i.e. (objectively) to injure, or (genitive) to sin:--do(ing) evil.

κακοποιός.shortDef: from κακός and ποιέω; a bad-doer; (specially), a criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.

κακός.shortDef: apparently a primary word; worthless (intrinsically, such; whereas πονηρός properly refers to effects), i.e. (subjectively) depraved, or (objectively) injurious:--bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked.

glosses: from κακός and the base of ἔργον
κακοῦργος.shortDef: from κακός and the base of ἔργον; a wrong-doer, i.e. criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.

glosses: from a presumed compound of κακός and ἔχω
κακουχέω.shortDef: from a presumed compound of κακός and ἔχω; to maltreat:--which suffer adversity, torment.

κακόω.shortDef: from κακός; to injure; figuratively, to exasperate:--make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex.

κακῶς.shortDef: from κακός; badly (physically or morally):--amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore.

καλάμη.shortDef: feminine of κάλαμος; a stalk of grain, i.e. (collectively) stubble:--stubble.

κάλαμος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication, a pen:--pen, reed.

glosses: akin to the base of κελεύω
καλέω.shortDef: akin to the base of κελεύω; to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise):--bid, call (forth), (whose, whose sur-)name (was (called)).

glosses: from the base of καλλίον and ἐλαία
καλλιέλαιος.shortDef: from the base of καλλίον and ἐλαία; a cultivated olive tree, i.e. a domesticated or improved one:--good olive tree.

glosses: neuter of the (irregular) comparative of καλός
καλλίον.shortDef: neuter of the (irregular) comparative of καλός; (adverbially) better than many:--very well.
