πάσχα.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare פֶּסַח); the Passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it):--Easter, Passover.

πάσχω.shortDef: apparently a primary verb; to experience a sensation or impression (usually painful):--feel, passion, suffer, vex.

πάταρα.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; Patara, a place in Asia Minor:--Patara.

πατάσσω.shortDef: probably prolongation from παίω; to knock (gently or with a weapon or fatally):--smite, strike. Compare τύπτω.

glosses: from a derivative probably of παίω (meaning a "path")
πατέω.shortDef: from a derivative probably of παίω (meaning a "path"); to trample (literally or figuratively):--tread (down, under foot).

πατήρ.shortDef: apparently a primary word; a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote):--father, parent.

πάτμος.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Patmus, an islet in the Mediterranean:--Patmos.

glosses: from πατήρ and the same as the latter part of μητραλῴας
πατραλῴας.shortDef: from πατήρ and the same as the latter part of μητραλῴας; a parricide:--murderer of fathers.

glosses: as if feminine of a derivative of πατήρ
πατριά.shortDef: as if feminine of a derivative of πατήρ; paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation):--family, kindred, lineage.

πατριάρχης.shortDef: from πατριά and ἄρχω; a progenitor ("patriarch"):--patriarch.

πατρικός.shortDef: from πατήρ; paternal, i.e. ancestral:--of fathers.

πατρίς.shortDef: from παράσημος; a father-land, i.e. native town; (figuratively) heavenly home:--(own) country.

glosses: perhaps a contraction for  (a compound of πατήρ and βίος)
πατροβᾶς.shortDef: perhaps a contraction for  (a compound of πατήρ and βίος); father's life; Patrobas, a Christian:--Patrobas.

glosses: from πατήρ and a derivative of παραδίδωμι (in the sense of handing over or down)
πατροπαράδοτος.shortDef: from πατήρ and a derivative of παραδίδωμι (in the sense of handing over or down); traditionary:--received by tradition from fathers.

πατρῷος.shortDef: from πατήρ; paternal, i.e. hereditary:--of fathers.

παῦλος.shortDef: of Latin origin; (little; but remotely from a derivative of παύω, meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an apostle:--Paul, Paulus.

παύω.shortDef: a primary verb ("pause"); to stop (transitively or intransitively), i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end:--cease, leave, refrain.

πάφος.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; Paphus, a place in Cyprus:--Paphos.

glosses: from a derivative of πήγνυμι (meaning thick)
παχύνω.shortDef: from a derivative of πήγνυμι (meaning thick); to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous):--wax gross.

πέδη.shortDef: ultimately from πούς; a shackle for the feet:--fetter.

glosses: from a derivative of πούς (meaning the ground)
πεδινός.shortDef: from a derivative of πούς (meaning the ground); level (as easy for the feet):--plain.

πεζεύω.shortDef: from the same as πεζῇ; to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land:--go afoot.

glosses: dative case feminine of a derivative of πούς (as adverb)
πεζῇ.shortDef: dative case feminine of a derivative of πούς (as adverb); foot-wise, i.e. by walking:--a- (on) foot.

glosses: from a compound of πείθω and ἄρχω
πειθαρχέω.shortDef: from a compound of πείθω and ἄρχω; to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice:--hearken, obey (magistrates).

πείθω.shortDef: a primary verb; to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty):--agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield.

glosses: from the same as πένης (through the idea of pinching toil
πεινάω.shortDef: from the same as πένης (through the idea of pinching toil; "pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave:--be an hungered.

glosses: from the base of πέραν (through the idea of piercing)
πεῖρα.shortDef: from the base of πέραν (through the idea of piercing); a test, i.e. attempt, experience:--assaying, trial.

πειράζω.shortDef: from πεῖρα; to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline:--assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try.

πειρασμός.shortDef: from πειράζω; a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity:--temptation, X try.

πειράω.shortDef: from πεῖρα; to test (subjectively), i.e. (reflexively) to attempt:--assay.

glosses: from a presumed derivative of πείθω
πεισμονή.shortDef: from a presumed derivative of πείθω; persuadableness, i.e. credulity:--persuasion.

πέλαγος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; deep or open sea, i.e. the main:--depth, sea.

glosses: from a derivative of πλήσσω (meaning an axe)
πελεκίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of πλήσσω (meaning an axe); to chop off (the head), i.e. truncate:--behead.

πέμπω.shortDef: apparently a primary verb; to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas  (as a stronger form of ) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and στέλλω denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield:--send, thrust in.

glosses: from a primary  (to toil for daily subsistence)
πένης.shortDef: from a primary  (to toil for daily subsistence); starving, i.e. indigent:--poor. Compare πτωχός.

πενθερά.shortDef: feminine of πενθερός; a wife's mother:--mother in law, wife's mother.

πενθερός.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a wife's father:--father in law.

πενθέω.shortDef: from πένθος; to grieve (the feeling or the act):--mourn, (be-)wail.

glosses: strengthened from the alternate of πάσχω
πένθος.shortDef: strengthened from the alternate of πάσχω; grief:--mourning, sorrow.

glosses: prolongation from the base of πένης
πενιχρός.shortDef: prolongation from the base of πένης; necessitous:--poor.

πεντάκις.shortDef: multiplicative adverb from πέντε; five times:--five times.

πεντακισχίλιοι.shortDef: from πεντάκις and χίλιοι; five times a thousand:--five thousand.

πεντακόσιοι.shortDef: from πέντε and ἑκατόν; five hundred:--five hundred.

glosses: from πέντε and καί and δέκατος
πεντεκαιδέκατος.shortDef: from πέντε and καί and δέκατος; five and tenth:--fifteenth.

glosses: feminine of the ordinal of πεντήκοντα
πεντηκοστή.shortDef: feminine of the ordinal of πεντήκοντα; fiftieth (ἡμέρα being implied) from Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost":--Pentecost.

glosses: from the perfect of the alternate of πάσχω
πεποίθησις.shortDef: from the perfect of the alternate of πάσχω; reliance:--confidence, trust.

περ.shortDef: from the base of πέραν; an enclitic particle significant of abundance (thoroughness), i.e. emphasis; much, very or ever:--(whom-)soever.

glosses: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of  (to "pierce")
πέραν.shortDef: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of  (to "pierce"); through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across:--beyond, farther (other) side, over.

πέρας.shortDef: from the same as πέραν; an extremity:--end, ut-(ter-)most participle

πέργαμος.shortDef: from πύργος; fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor:--Pergamos.

glosses: probably from the same as Πέργαμος
πέργη.shortDef: probably from the same as Πέργαμος; a tower; Perga, a place in Asia Minor:--Perga.

περί.shortDef: from the base of πέραν; properly, through (all over), i.e. around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period):--(there-)about, above, against, at, on behalf of, X and his company, which concern, (as) concerning, for, X how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on, over, pertaining (to), for sake, X (e-)state, (as) touching, (where-)by (in), with. In comparative, it retains substantially the same meaning of circuit (around), excess (beyond), or completeness (through).

περιάγω.shortDef: from περί and ἄγω; to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to walk around:--compass, go (round) about, lead about.

glosses: from περί and αἱρέομαι (including its alternate)
περιαιρέω.shortDef: from περί and αἱρέομαι (including its alternate); to remove all around, i.e. unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate:--take away (up).

περιαστράπτω.shortDef: from περί and ἀστράπτω; to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light:--shine round (about).

περιβάλλω.shortDef: from περί and βάλλω; to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade or with clothing):--array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on.

περιβλέπω.shortDef: from περί and βλέπω; to look all around:--look (round) about (on).

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of περιβάλλω
περιβόλαιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of περιβάλλω; something thrown around one, i.e. a mantle, veil:--covering, vesture.

περιδέω.shortDef: from περί and δέω; to bind around one, i.e. enwrap:--bind about.

περιεργάζομαι.shortDef: from περί and ἐργάζομαι; to work all around, i.e. bustle about (meddle):--be a busybody.

περίεργος.shortDef: from περί and ἔργον; working all around, i.e. officious (meddlesome, neuter plural magic):--busybody, curious arts.

glosses: from περί and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate)
περιέρχομαι.shortDef: from περί and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to come all around, i.e. stroll, vacillate, veer:--fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about.

περιέχω.shortDef: from περί and ἔχω; to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp (figuratively):--+ astonished, contain, after (this manner).

περιζώννυμι.shortDef: from περί and ζώννυμι; to gird all around, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively):--gird (about, self).

περίθεσις.shortDef: from περιτίθημι; a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself with:--wearing.

περιΐστημι.shortDef: from περί and ἵστημι; to stand all around, i.e. (near) to be a bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from:--avoid, shun, stand by (round about).

glosses: from a compound of περί and καθαίρω
περικάθαρμα.shortDef: from a compound of περί and καθαίρω; something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively):--filth.

περικαλύπτω.shortDef: from περί and καλύπτω; to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface):--blindfold, cover, overlay.

περίκειμαι.shortDef: from περί and κεῖμαι; to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively):--be bound (compassed) with, hang about.

glosses: feminine of a compound of περί and κεφαλή
περικεφαλαία.shortDef: feminine of a compound of περί and κεφαλή; encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet:--helmet.

περικρατής.shortDef: from περί and κράτος; strong all around, i.e. a master (manager):--+ come by.

περικρύπτω.shortDef: from περί and κρύπτω; to conceal all around, i.e. entirely:--hide.

περικυκλόω.shortDef: from περί and κυκλόω; to encircle all around, i.e. blockade completely:--compass round.

περιλάμπω.shortDef: from περί and λάμπω; to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo:--shine round about.

περιλείπω.shortDef: from περί and λείπω; to leave all around, i.e. (passively) survive:--remain.

περίλυπος.shortDef: from περί and λύπη; grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad:--exceeding (very) sorry(-owful).

περιμένω.shortDef: from περί and μένω; to stay around, i.e. await:--wait for.

πέριξ.shortDef: adverb from περί; all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent:--round about.

περιοικέω.shortDef: from περί and οἰκέω; to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor:--dwell round about.

περίοικος.shortDef: from περί and οἶκος; housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun):--neighbour.

glosses: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and εἰμί
περιούσιος.shortDef: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and εἰμί; being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own):--peculiar.

περιοχή.shortDef: from περιέχω; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed):--place.

περιπατέω.shortDef: from περί and πατέω; to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary):--go, be occupied with, walk (about).

glosses: from περί and the base of πέραν
περιπείρω.shortDef: from περί and the base of πέραν; to penetrate entirely, i.e. transfix (figuratively):--pierce through.

περιπίπτω.shortDef: from περί and πίπτω; to fall into something that is all around, i.e. light among or upon, be surrounded with:--fall among (into).

glosses: middle voice from περί and ποιέω
περιποιέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from περί and ποιέω; to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy):--purchase.

περιποίησις.shortDef: from περιποιέομαι; acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension, preservation:--obtain(-ing), peculiar, purchased, possession, saving.

περιῤῥήγνυμι.shortDef: from περί and ῥήγνυμι; to tear all around, i.e. completely away:--rend off.

περισπάω.shortDef: from περί and σπάω; to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to distract (with care):--cumber.

περισσεία.shortDef: from περισσεύω; surplusage, i.e. superabundance:--abundance(-ant, (-ly)), superfluity.

περίσσευμα.shortDef: from περισσεύω; a surplus, or superabundance:--abundance, that was left, over and above.

περισσεύω.shortDef: from περισσός; to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel:--(make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above).

glosses: from περί (in the sense of beyond)
περισσός.shortDef: from περί (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with ἐκ) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence:--exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly).

περισσότερον.shortDef: neuter of περισσότερος (as adverb); in a more superabundant way:--more abundantly, a great deal, far more.

περισσότερος.shortDef: comparative of περισσός; more superabundant (in number, degree or character):--more abundant, greater (much) more, overmuch.

περισσοτέρως.shortDef: adverb from περισσότερος; more superabundantly:--more abundant(-ly), X the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much more, the rather.

περισσῶς.shortDef: adverb from περισσός; superabundantly:--exceedingly, out of measure, the more.

περιστερά.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; a pigeon:--dove, pigeon.

glosses: from περί and the base of τομώτερος
περιτέμνω.shortDef: from περί and the base of τομώτερος; to cut around, i.e. (specially) to circumcise:--circumcise.

περιτίθημι.shortDef: from περί and τίθημι; to place around; by implication, to present:--bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about.

περιτομή.shortDef: from περιτέμνω; circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively):--X circumcised, circumcision.

glosses: from περί and the base of τροπή
περιτρέπω.shortDef: from περί and the base of τροπή; to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze:--+ make mad.

glosses: from περί and τρέχω (including its alternate)
περιτρέχω.shortDef: from περί and τρέχω (including its alternate); to run around, i.e. traverse:--run through.

περιφέρω.shortDef: from περί and φέρω; to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither:--bear (carry) about.

περιφρονέω.shortDef: from περί and φρονέω; to think beyond, i.e. depreciate (contemn):--despise.

περίχωρος.shortDef: from περί and χώρα; around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with γῆ implied vicinity):--country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about.

glosses: from a comparative of περί and  (to rub)
περίψωμα.shortDef: from a comparative of περί and  (to rub); something brushed all around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum):--offscouring.

περπερεύομαι.shortDef: middle voice from  (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the base of πέραν); to boast:--vaunt itself.

πέρυσι.shortDef: adverb from πέρας; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year:--+ a year ago.

glosses: neuter of a derivative of πέτομαι
πετεινόν.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of πέτομαι; a flying animal, i.e. bird:--bird, fowl.

glosses: middle voice of a primary verb
πέτομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a primary verb; to fly:--fly(-ing).

glosses: feminine of the same as Πέτρος
πέτρα.shortDef: feminine of the same as Πέτρος; a (mass of) rock (literally or figuratively):--rock.

πέτρος.shortDef: apparently a primary word; a (piece of) rock (larger than λίθος); as a name, Petrus, an apostle:--Peter, rock. Compare Κηφᾶς.

πετρώδης.shortDef: from πέτρα and εἶδος; rock-like, i.e. rocky:--stony.

πήγανον.shortDef: from πήγνυμι; rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves):--rue.

glosses: probably from πήγνυμι (through the idea of gushing plumply)
πηγή.shortDef: probably from πήγνυμι (through the idea of gushing plumply); a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring):--fountain, well.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses)
πήγνυμι.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e. (specially) to set up (a tent):--pitch.

glosses: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of  (the blade of an oar
πηδάλιον.shortDef: neuter of a (presumed) derivative of  (the blade of an oar; from the same as πέδη); a "pedal", i.e. helm:--rudder.

glosses: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of πού
πηλίκος.shortDef: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of πού; how much (as an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity:--how great (large).

πήρα.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food:--scrip.

πῆχυς.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a cubit:--cubit.

πιάζω.shortDef: probably another form of βιάζω; to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture)):--apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take. Compare πιέζω.

πιέζω.shortDef: another form for πιάζω; to pack:--press down.

glosses: from a compound of a derivative of πείθω and λόγος
πιθανολογία.shortDef: from a compound of a derivative of πείθω and λόγος; persuasive language:--enticing words.

πικραίνω.shortDef: from πικρός; to embitter (literally or figuratively):--be (make) bitter.

πικρία.shortDef: from πικρός; acridity (especially poison), literally or figuratively:--bitterness.

glosses: perhaps from πήγνυμι (through the idea of piercing)
πικρός.shortDef: perhaps from πήγνυμι (through the idea of piercing); sharp (pungent), i.e. acrid (literally or figuratively):--bitter.

πικρῶς.shortDef: adverb from πικρός; bitterly, i.e. (figuratively) violently:--bitterly.

πιλᾶτος.shortDef: of Latin origin; close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman:--Pilate.

glosses: a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary
πίμπρημι.shortDef: a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary  ; which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fire, i.e. burn (figuratively and passively, become inflamed with fever):--be (X should have) swollen.

πινακίδιον.shortDef: diminutive of πίναξ; a tablet (for writing on):--writing table.

πίναξ.shortDef: apparently a form of πλάξ; a plate:--charger, platter.

πίνω.shortDef: a prolonged form of        ;  which (together with another form)        ; occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses;  to imbibe (literally or figuratively):--drink.

πιότης.shortDef: from  (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of πίνω through the idea of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness (oiliness):--fatness.

πιπράσκω.shortDef: contracted from  (to traverse; from the base of πέραν); to traffic (by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively):--sell.

glosses: probably akin to πέτομαι through the idea of alighting
πίπτω.shortDef: probably akin to πέτομαι through the idea of alighting; to fall (literally or figuratively):--fail, fall (down), light on.

πισιδία.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pisidia.

πιστεύω.shortDef: from πίστις; to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to Christ):--believe(-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with.

πίστις.shortDef: from πείθω; persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth itself:--assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity.

πιστός.shortDef: from πείθω; objectively, trustworthy; subjectively, trustful:--believe(-ing, -r), faithful(-ly), sure, true.

πλανάω.shortDef: from πλάνη; to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue):--go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way.

πλάνη.shortDef: feminine of πλάνος (as abstractly); objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety:--deceit, to deceive, delusion, error.

πλανήτης.shortDef: from πλάνος; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher:--wandering.

πλάνος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader; --deceiver, seducing.

πλάξ.shortDef: from πλάσσω; a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively):--table.

πλάσσω.shortDef: a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate:--form.

πλαστός.shortDef: from πλάσσω; moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false):--feigned.

πλατεῖα.shortDef: feminine of πλατύς; a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square:--street.

πλατύνω.shortDef: from πλατύς; to widen (literally or figuratively):--make broad, enlarge.

πλατύς.shortDef: from πλάσσω; spread out "flat" ("plot"), i.e. broad:--wide.

πλέγμα.shortDef: from πλέκω; a plait (of hair):--broidered hair.

πλεῖστος.shortDef: irregular superlative of πολύς; the largest number or very large:--very great, most.

πλείων.shortDef: comparative of πολύς; more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion:--X above, + exceed, more  excellent, further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but.

πλέκω.shortDef: a primary word; to twine or braid:--plait.

πλεονάζω.shortDef: from πλείων; to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound:--abound, abundant, make to increase, have over.

πλεονεκτέω.shortDef: from πλεονέκτης; to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach:--get an advantage, defraud, make a gain.

πλεονέκτης.shortDef: from πλείων and ἔχω; holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder):--covetous.

πλεονεξία.shortDef: from πλεονέκτης; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency, extortion:--covetous(-ness) practices, greediness.

πλευρά.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side:--side.

glosses: probably a form of πλύνω (through the idea of plunging through the water)
πλέω.shortDef: probably a form of πλύνω (through the idea of plunging through the water); to pass in a vessel:--sail. See also πλήθω.

πληγή.shortDef: from πλήσσω; a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity:--plague, stripe, wound(-ed).

πλῆθος.shortDef: from πλήθω; a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace:--bundle, company, multitude.

πληθύνω.shortDef: from another form of πλῆθος; to increase (transitively or intransitively):--abound, multiply.

glosses: a prolonged form of a primary            (which appears only as an alternate in                          certain tenses and in the reduplicated form                          pimplemi)
πλήθω.shortDef: a prolonged form of a primary            (which appears only as an alternate in                          certain tenses and in the reduplicated form                          pimplemi); to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time):--accomplish, full (…come), furnish.

πλήκτης.shortDef: from πλήσσω; a smiter, i.e. pugnacious (quarrelsome):--striker.

πλήμμυρα.shortDef: prolonged from πλήθω; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet:--flood.

πλήν.shortDef: from πλείων; moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather, yet:--but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.

πλήρης.shortDef: from πλήθω; replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete:--full.

πληροφορέω.shortDef: from πλήρης and φορέω; to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish:--most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of.

πληρόω.shortDef: from πλήρης; to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.:--accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply.

πλήρωμα.shortDef: from πληρόω; repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period):--which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.

πλησίον.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of  (near); (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or friend):--near, neighbour.

glosses: from a presumed derivative of πλήθω
πλησμονή.shortDef: from a presumed derivative of πλήθω; a filling up, i.e. (figuratively) gratification:--satisfying.

glosses: apparently another form of πλάσσω (through the idea of flattening out)
πλήσσω.shortDef: apparently another form of πλάσσω (through the idea of flattening out); to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity):--smite. Compare τύπτω.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of πλοῖον
πλοιάριον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of πλοῖον; a boat:--boat, little (small) ship.

πλοῖον.shortDef: from πλέω; a sailer, i.e. vessel:--ship(-ing).

πλόος.shortDef: from πλέω; a sail, i.e. navigation:--course, sailing, voyage.

πλούσιος.shortDef: from πλοῦτος; wealthy; figuratively, abounding with:--rich.

πλουτέω.shortDef: from πλουτίζω; to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively):--be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.

πλουτίζω.shortDef: from πλοῦτος; to make wealthy (figuratively):--en- (make) rich.

πλοῦτος.shortDef: from the base of πλήθω; wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment:--riches.

glosses: a prolonged form of an obsolete  (to "flow")
πλύνω.shortDef: a prolonged form of an obsolete  (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e. launder clothing:--wash. Compare λούω, νίπτω.

πνεῦμα.shortDef: from πνέω; a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit:--ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind. Compare ψυχή.

πνευματικός.shortDef: from πνεῦμα; non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (dæmoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious:--spiritual. Compare ψυχικός.

πνευματικῶς.shortDef: adverb from πνευματικός; non-physically, i.e. divinely, figuratively:--spiritually.

πνέω.shortDef: a primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. breeze:--blow. Compare ψύχω.

πνίγω.shortDef: strengthened from πνέω; to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown):--choke, take by the throat.

πνικτός.shortDef: from πνίγω; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled):--strangled.

πνοή.shortDef: from πνέω; respiration, a breeze:--breath, wind.

glosses: from πούς and another element of uncertain affinity
ποδήρης.shortDef: from πούς and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress (ἐσθής implied) reaching the ankles:--garment down to the foot.

glosses: from the base of πόσις with enclitic adverb of origin
πόθεν.shortDef: from the base of πόσις with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause:--whence.

glosses: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary
ποιέω.shortDef: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct):--abide, + agree, appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have, hold, X journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, X mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform, provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, X secure, shew, X shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield. Compare πράσσω.

ποίημα.shortDef: from ποιέω; a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively):--thing that is made, workmanship.

ποίησις.shortDef: from ποιέω; action, i.e. performance (of the law):--deed.

ποιητής.shortDef: from ποιέω; a performer; specially, a "poet"; --doer, poet.

ποικίλος.shortDef: of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. various in character:--divers, manifold.

ποιμαίνω.shortDef: from ποιμήν; to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser):--feed (cattle), rule.

ποιμήν.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; a shepherd (literally or figuratively):--shepherd, pastor.

ποίμνη.shortDef: contraction from ποιμαίνω; a flock (literally or figuratively):--flock, fold.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of ποίμνη
ποίμνιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of ποίμνη; a flock, i.e. (figuratively) group (of believers):--flock.

glosses: from the base of ποῦ and οἷος
ποῖος.shortDef: from the base of ποῦ and οἷος; individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one:--what (manner of), which.

πολεμέω.shortDef: from πόλεμος; to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. to battle (literally or figuratively):--fight, (make) war.

πόλεμος.shortDef: from  (to bustle); warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series):--battle, fight, war.

glosses: probably from the same as πόλεμος
πόλις.shortDef: probably from the same as πόλεμος, or perhaps from πολύς; a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size):--city.

πολιτάρχης.shortDef: from πόλις and ἄρχω; a town-officer, i.e. magistrate:--ruler of the city.

πολιτεία.shortDef: from πολίτης ("polity"); citizenship; concretely, a community:--commonwealth, freedom.

πολίτευμα.shortDef: from πολιτεύομαι; a community, i.e. (abstractly) citizenship (figuratively):--conversation.

glosses: middle voice of a derivative of πολίτης
πολιτεύομαι.shortDef: middle voice of a derivative of πολίτης; to behave as a citizen (figuratively):--let conversation be, live.

πολλάκις.shortDef: multiplicative adverb from πολύς; many times, i.e. frequently:--oft(-en, -entimes, -times).

glosses: from πολύς and probably a derivative of πλέκω
πολλαπλασίων.shortDef: from πολύς and probably a derivative of πλέκω; manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more:--manifold more.

glosses: from a compound of πολύς and λόγος
πολυλογία.shortDef: from a compound of πολύς and λόγος; loquacity, i.e. prolixity:--much speaking.

glosses: adverb from a compound of πολύς and μέρος
πολυμερῶς.shortDef: adverb from a compound of πολύς and μέρος; in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal):--at sundry times.

πολυποίκιλος.shortDef: from πολύς and ποικίλος; much variegated, i.e. multifarious:--manifold.

glosses: including the forms from the alternate
πολύς.shortDef: including the forms from the alternate ; (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely:--abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly. Compare πλεῖστος, πλείων.

πολύσπλαγχνος.shortDef: from πολύς and σπλάγχνον (figuratively); extremely compassionate:--very pitiful.

πολυτελής.shortDef: from πολύς and τέλος; extremely expensive:--costly, very precious, of great price.

πολύτιμος.shortDef: from πολύς and τιμή; extremely valuable:--very costly, of great price.

glosses: adverb from a compound of πολύς and τρόπος
πολυτρόπως.shortDef: adverb from a compound of πολύς and τρόπος; in many ways, i.e. variously as to method or form:--in divers manners.

πόμα.shortDef: from the alternate of πίνω; a beverage:--drink.

πονηρία.shortDef: from πονηρός; depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins:--iniquity, wickedness.

πονηρός.shortDef: from a derivative of πόνος; hurtful, i.e. evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from κακός, which refers rather to essential character, as well as from σαπρός, which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill, i.e. diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e. derelict, vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural) guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners:--bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness). See also πονηρότερος.

πονηρότερος.shortDef: comparative of πονηρός; more evil:--more wicked.

πόνος.shortDef: from the base of πένης; toil, i.e. (by implication) anguish:--pain.

ποντικός.shortDef: from Πόντος; a Pontican, i.e. native of Pontus:--born in Pontus.

πόντιος.shortDef: of Latin origin; apparently bridged; Pontius, a Roman:--Pontius.

πόντος.shortDef: of Latin origin; a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor:--Pontus.

πόπλιος.shortDef: of Latin origin; apparently "popular"; Poplius (i.e. Publius), a Roman:--Publius.

πορεία.shortDef: from πορεύομαι; travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. career:--journey(-ing), ways.

glosses: middle voice from a derivative of the same as πεῖρα
πορεύομαι.shortDef: middle voice from a derivative of the same as πεῖρα; to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.); --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.

πορθέω.shortDef: prolongation from  (to sack); to ravage (figuratively):--destroy, waste.

πορισμός.shortDef: from a derivative of  (a way, i.e. means); furnishing (procuring), i.e. (by implication) money-getting (acquisition):--gain.

πόρκιος.shortDef: of Latin origin; apparently swinish; Porcius, a Roman:--Porcius.

πορνεία.shortDef: from πορνεύω; harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry:--fornication.

πορνεύω.shortDef: from πόρνη; to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry:--commit (fornication).

πόρνη.shortDef: feminine of πόρνος; a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater:--harlot, whore.

πόρνος.shortDef: from  (to sell; akin to the base of πιπράσκω); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine):--fornicator, whoremonger.

πόῤῥω.shortDef: adverb from πρό; forwards, i.e. at a distance:--far, a great way off. See also πόῤῥωθεν.

glosses: from πόῤῥω with adverbial enclitic of source
πόῤῥωθεν.shortDef: from πόῤῥω with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly:--afar off.

ποῤῥωτέρω.shortDef: adverb comparative of πόῤῥω; further, i.e. a greater distance:--farther.

πορφύρα.shortDef: of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it:--purple.

πορφυροῦς.shortDef: from πορφύρα; purpureal, i.e. bluish red:--purple.

glosses: feminine of a compound of πορφύρα and πωλέω
πορφυρόπωλις.shortDef: feminine of a compound of πορφύρα and πωλέω; a female trader in purple cloth:--seller of purple.

ποσάκις.shortDef: multiplicative from πόσος; how many times:--how oft(-en).

πόσις.shortDef: from the alternate of πίνω; a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught:--drink.

πόσος.shortDef: from an absolute  (who, what) and ὅς; interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many):--how great (long, many), what.

glosses: probably from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (compare πότος)
ποταμός.shortDef: probably from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω (compare πότος); a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water:--flood, river, stream, water.

glosses: from ποταμός and a derivative of φορέω
ποταμοφόρητος.shortDef: from ποταμός and a derivative of φορέω; river-borne, i.e. overwhelmed by a stream:--carried away of the flood.

glosses: apparently from πότε and the base of ποῦ
ποταπός.shortDef: apparently from πότε and the base of ποῦ; interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort:--what (manner of).

glosses: from the base of πού and τέ
ποτέ.shortDef: from the base of πού and τέ; indefinite adverb, at some time, ever:--afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n- )ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when.

glosses: from the base of ποῦ and τέ
πότε.shortDef: from the base of ποῦ and τέ; interrogative adverb, at what time:--+ how long, when.

glosses: neuter of a comparative of the base of ποῦ
πότερον.shortDef: neuter of a comparative of the base of ποῦ; interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that:--whether.

glosses: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of πίνω
ποτήριον.shortDef: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of πίνω; a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate:--cup.

glosses: from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω
ποτίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of the alternate of πίνω; to furnish drink, irrigate:--give (make) to drink, feed, water.

ποτίολοι.shortDef: of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy:--Puteoli.

πότος.shortDef: from the alternate of πίνω; a drinking-bout or carousal:--banqueting.

glosses: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun  (some) otherwise obsolete (compare πόσος)
πού.shortDef: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun  (some) otherwise obsolete (compare πόσος); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly:--about, a certain place.

glosses: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun  (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as πού used with the rising slide of inquiry)
ποῦ.shortDef: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun  (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as πού used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality:--where, whither.

πούδης.shortDef: of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian:--Pudens.

πούς.shortDef: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally):--foot(-stool).

πρᾶγμα.shortDef: from πράσσω; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material):--business, matter, thing, work.

πραγματεία.shortDef: from πραγματεύομαι; a transaction, i.e. negotiation:--affair.

πραγματεύομαι.shortDef: from πρᾶγμα; to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade:--occupy.

πραιτώριον.shortDef: of Latin origin; the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp):--(common, judgment) hall (of judgment), palace, prætorium.

πράκτωρ.shortDef: from a derivative of πράσσω; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector:--officer.

πρᾶξις.shortDef: from πράσσω; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function:--deed, office, work.

πρᾷος.shortDef: a form of πραΰς, used in certain parts; gentle, i.e. humble:--meek.

πρᾳότης.shortDef: from πρᾷος; gentleness, by implication, humility:--meekness.

πρασιά.shortDef: perhaps from  (a leek, and so an onion-patch); a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement):--in ranks.

πράσσω.shortDef: a primary verb; to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from ποιέω, which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally):--commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts.

πραΰς.shortDef: apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble:--meek. See also πρᾷος.

πραΰτης.shortDef: from πραΰς; mildness, i.e. (by implication) humility:--meekness.

πρέπω.shortDef: apparently a primary verb; to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right):--become, comely.

πρεσβεία.shortDef: from πρεσβεύω; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors):--ambassage, message.

πρεσβεύω.shortDef: from the base of πρεσβύτερος; to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher):--be an ambassador.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of πρεσβύτερος
πρεσβυτέριον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of πρεσβύτερος; the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery":--(estate of) elder(-s), presbytery.

πρεσβύτερος.shortDef: comparative of  (elderly); older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter":-- elder(-est), old.

πρεσβύτης.shortDef: from the same as πρεσβύτερος; an old man:--aged (man), old man.

πρεσβῦτις.shortDef: feminine of πρεσβύτης; an old woman:--aged woman.

πρηνής.shortDef: from πρό; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head foremost:--headlong.

glosses: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw)
πρίζω.shortDef: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw); to saw in two:--saw asunder.

πρίν.shortDef: adverb from πρό; prior, sooner:--before (that), ere.

πρίσκα.shortDef: of Latin origin; feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian woman:--Prisca. See also Πρίσκιλλα.

πρίσκιλλα.shortDef: diminutive of Πρίσκα; Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian woman:--Priscilla.

πρό.shortDef: a primary preposition; "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to:--above, ago, before, or ever. In the comparative, it retains the same significations.

προάγω.shortDef: from πρό and ἄγω; to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous)):--bring (forth, out), go before.

προαιρέομαι.shortDef: from πρό and αἱρέομαι; to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend):--purpose.

glosses: from πρό and a derivative of αἰτία
προαιτιάομαι.shortDef: from πρό and a derivative of αἰτία; to accuse already, i.e. previously charge:--prove before.

προακούω.shortDef: from πρό and ἀκούω; to hear already,i.e. anticipate:--hear before.

προαμαρτάνω.shortDef: from πρό and ἁμαρτάνω; to sin previously (to conversion):--sin already, heretofore sin.

glosses: neuter of a presumed compound of πρό and αὐλή
προαύλιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed compound of πρό and αὐλή; a forecourt, i.e. vestibule (alley-way):--porch.

glosses: from πρό and the base of βάσις
προβαίνω.shortDef: from πρό and the base of βάσις; to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years):--+ be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken.

προβάλλω.shortDef: from πρό and βάλλω; to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate:--put forward, shoot forth.

προβατικός.shortDef: from πρόβατον; relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem:--sheep (market).

glosses: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of προβαίνω
πρόβατον.shortDef: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of προβαίνω; something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively):--sheep(-fold).

glosses: from πρό and a reduplicated form of βιάζω
προβιβάζω.shortDef: from πρό and a reduplicated form of βιάζω; to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate:--draw, before instruct.

προβλέπω.shortDef: from πρό and βλέπω; to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance:--provide.

προγίνομαι.shortDef: from πρό and γίνομαι; to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired:--be past.

προγινώσκω.shortDef: from πρό and γινώσκω; to know beforehand, i.e. foresee:--foreknow (ordain), know (before).

προγράφω.shortDef: from πρό and γράφω; to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe:--before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime).

πρόδηλος.shortDef: from πρό and δῆλος; plain before all men, i.e. obvious:--evident, manifest (open) beforehand.

προδίδωμι.shortDef: from πρό and δίδωμι; to give before the other party has given:--first give.

glosses: from προδίδωμι (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands)
προδότης.shortDef: from προδίδωμι (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands); a surrender:--betrayer, traitor.

πρόδρομος.shortDef: from the alternate of προτρέχω; a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor):--forerunner.

προείδω.shortDef: from πρό and εἴδω; foresee:--foresee, saw before.

προελπίζω.shortDef: from πρό and ἐλπίζω; to hope in advance of other confirmation:--first trust.

προέπω.shortDef: from πρό and ἔπω; to say already, to predict:--forewarn, say (speak, tell) before. Compare προερέω.

προενάρχομαι.shortDef: from πρό and ἐνάρχομαι; to commence already:--begin (before).

glosses: middle voice from πρό and ἐπαγγέλλω
προεπαγγέλλομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρό and ἐπαγγέλλω; to promise of old:--promise before.

προερέω.shortDef: from πρό and ἐρέω; used as alternate of προέπω; to say already, predict:--foretell, say (speak, tell) before.

glosses: from πρό and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate)
προέρχομαι.shortDef: from πρό and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time):--go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.

προετοιμάζω.shortDef: from πρό and ἑτοιμάζω; to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively):--ordain before, prepare afore.

glosses: middle voice from πρό and εὐαγγελίζω
προευαγγελίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρό and εὐαγγελίζω; to announce glad news in advance:--preach before the gospel.

glosses: middle voice from πρό and ἔχω
προέχομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρό and ἔχω; to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel:--be better.

προηγέομαι.shortDef: from πρό and ἡγέομαι; to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference:--prefer.

πρόθεσις.shortDef: from προτίθεμαι; a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God:--purpose, shew(-bread).

glosses: from πρό and a derivative of τίθημι
προθέσμιος.shortDef: from πρό and a derivative of τίθημι; fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with ἡμέρα implied) a designated day:--time appointed.

προθυμία.shortDef: from πρόθυμος; predisposition, i.e. alacrity:--forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.

πρόθυμος.shortDef: from πρό and θυμός; forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity:--ready, willing.

προΐστημι.shortDef: from πρό and ἵστημι; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise:--maintain, be over, rule.

glosses: middle voice from πρό and καλέω
προκαλέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρό and καλέω; to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate:--provoke.

προκαταγγέλλω.shortDef: from πρό and καταγγέλλω; to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise:--foretell, have notice, (shew) before.

προκαταρτίζω.shortDef: from πρό and καταρτίζω; to prepare in advance:--make up beforehand.

πρόκειμαι.shortDef: from πρό and κεῖμαι; to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward):--be first, set before (forth).

προκηρύσσω.shortDef: from πρό and κηρύσσω; to herald (i.e. proclaim) in advance:--before (first) preach.

προκοπή.shortDef: from προκόπτω; progress, i.e. advancement (subjectively or objectively):--furtherance, profit.

προκόπτω.shortDef: from πρό and κόπτω; to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along):--increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.

glosses: from a compound of πρό and κρίνω
πρόκριμα.shortDef: from a compound of πρό and κρίνω; a prejudgment (prejudice), i.e. prepossession:--prefer one before another.

προκυρόω.shortDef: from πρό and κυρόω; to ratify previously:--confirm before.

προλαμβάνω.shortDef: from πρό and λαμβάνω; to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise:--come aforehand, overtake, take before.

προλέγω.shortDef: from πρό and λέγω; to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn:--foretell, tell before.

προμαρτύρομαι.shortDef: from πρό and μαρτύρομαι; to be a witness in advance i.e. predict:--testify beforehand.

προμελετάω.shortDef: from πρό and μελετάω; to premeditate:--meditate before.

προμεριμνάω.shortDef: from πρό and μεριμνάω; to care (anxiously) in advance:--take thought beforehand.

προνοέω.shortDef: from πρό and νοιέω; to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself):--provide (for).

πρόνοια.shortDef: from προνοέω; forethought, i.e. provident care or supply:--providence, provision.

προοράω.shortDef: from πρό and ὁράω; to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view:--foresee, see before.

προορίζω.shortDef: from πρό and ὁρίζω; to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine:--determine before, ordain, predestinate.

προπάσχω.shortDef: from πρό and πάσχω; to undergo hardship previously:--suffer before.

προπέμπω.shortDef: from πρό and πέμπω; to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel:--accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.

glosses: from a compound of πρό and πίπτω
προπετής.shortDef: from a compound of πρό and πίπτω; falling forward, i.e. headlong (figuratively, precipitate):--heady, rash(-ly).

προπορεύομαι.shortDef: from πρό and πορεύομαι; to precede (as guide or herald):--go before.

πρός.shortDef: a strengthened form of πρό; a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated):--about, according to , against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in). In the comparative case, it denotes essentially the same applications, namely, motion towards, accession to, or nearness at.

προσάββατον.shortDef: from πρό and σάββατον; a fore-sabbath, i.e. the Sabbath-eve:--day before the sabbath. Compare παρασκευή.

glosses: from πρός and a derivative of ἀγορά (mean to harangue)
προσαγορεύω.shortDef: from πρός and a derivative of ἀγορά (mean to harangue); to address, i.e. salute by name:--call.

προσάγω.shortDef: from πρός and ἄγω; to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach:--bring, draw near.

προσαιτέω.shortDef: from πρός and αἰτέω; to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. solicit:--beg.

προσαναβαίνω.shortDef: from πρός and ἀναβαίνω; to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat):--go up.

προσαναλίσκω.shortDef: from πρός and ἀναλίσκω; to expend further:--spend.

προσαναπληρόω.shortDef: from πρός and ἀναπληρόω; to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully:--supply.

προσανατίθημι.shortDef: from πρός and ἀνατίθεμαι; to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult:--in conference add, confer.

προσαπειλέω.shortDef: from πρός and ἀπειλέω; to menace additionally:--i.e. threaten further.

προσδαπανάω.shortDef: from πρός and δαπανάω; to expend additionally:--spend more.

προσδέομαι.shortDef: from πρός and δέομαι; to require additionally, i.e. want further:--need.

προσδέχομαι.shortDef: from πρός and δέχομαι; to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience):--accept, allow, look (wait) for, take.

προσδοκάω.shortDef: from πρός and dokeuo (to watch); to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await:--(be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for.

προσδοκία.shortDef: from προσδοκάω; apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated:--expectation, looking after.

προσεάω.shortDef: from πρός and ἐάω; to permit further progress:--suffer.

προσεγγίζω.shortDef: from πρός and ἐγγίζω; to approach near:--come nigh.

glosses: from a compound of πρός and the base of ἑδραῖος
προσεδρεύω.shortDef: from a compound of πρός and the base of ἑδραῖος; to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant:--wait at.

προσεργάζομαι.shortDef: from πρός and ἐργάζομαι; to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides:--gain.

glosses: from πρός and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate)
προσέρχομαι.shortDef: from πρός and ἔρχομαι (including its alternate); to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to:--(as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto).

προσευχή.shortDef: from προσεύχομαι; prayer (worship); by implication, an oratory (chapel):--X pray earnestly, prayer.

προσεύχομαι.shortDef: from πρός and εὔχομαι; to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship:--pray (X earnestly, for), make prayer.

προσέχω.shortDef: from πρός and ἔχω; (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to:--(give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard.

glosses: from πρός and a derivative of ἧλος
προσηλόω.shortDef: from πρός and a derivative of ἧλος; to peg to, i.e. spike fast:--nail to.

προσήλυτος.shortDef: from the alternate of προσέρχομαι; an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte"):--proselyte.

πρόσκαιρος.shortDef: from πρός and καιρός; for the occasion only, i.e. temporary:--dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal.

glosses: middle voice from πρός and καλέω
προσκαλέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρός and καλέω; to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite:--call (for, to, unto).

προσκαρτερέω.shortDef: from πρός and καρτερέω; to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor):--attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually).

glosses: neuter of a presumed compound of πρός and κεφαλή
προσκεφάλαιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed compound of πρός and κεφαλή; something for the head, i.e. a cushion:--pillow.

προσκληρόω.shortDef: from πρός and κληρόω; to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with:--consort with.

glosses: from a compound of πρός and κλίνω
πρόσκλισις.shortDef: from a compound of πρός and κλίνω; a leaning towards, i.e. (figuratively) proclivity (favoritism):--partiality.

προσκολλάω.shortDef: from πρός and κολλάω; to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere:--cleave, join (self).

πρόσκομμα.shortDef: from προσκόπτω; a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy:--offence, stumbling(-block, (-stone)).

προσκοπή.shortDef: from προσκόπτω; a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin:--offence.

προσκόπτω.shortDef: from πρός and κόπτω; to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively):--beat upon, dash, stumble (at).

προσκυλίω.shortDef: from πρός and κυλιόω; to roll towards, i.e. block against:--roll (to).

glosses: from πρός and a probable derivative of κύων (meaning to kiss
προσκυνέω.shortDef: from πρός and a probable derivative of κύων (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand); to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore):--worship.

προσλαλέω.shortDef: from πρός and λαλέω; to talk to, i.e. converse with:--speak to (with).

προσλαμβάνω.shortDef: from πρός and λαμβάνω; to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality):--receive, take (unto).

προσμένω.shortDef: from πρός and μένω; to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in:--abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with).

glosses: from πρός and a derivative of the same as ὁρμή (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull)
προσορμίζω.shortDef: from πρός and a derivative of the same as ὁρμή (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull); to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at:--draw to the shore.

προσοφείλω.shortDef: from πρός and ὀφείλω; to be indebted additionally:--over besides.

glosses: from πρός and a form of  (to be vexed with something irksome)
προσοχθίζω.shortDef: from πρός and a form of  (to be vexed with something irksome); to feel indignant at:--be grieved at.

glosses: from πρός and the same as πεινάω
πρόσπεινος.shortDef: from πρός and the same as πεινάω; hungering further, i.e. intensely hungry:--very hungry.

προσπήγνυμι.shortDef: from πρός and πήγνυμι; to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross):--crucify.

προσπίπτω.shortDef: from πρός and πίπτω; to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm):--beat upon, fall (down) at (before).

glosses: middle voice from πρός and ποιέω
προσποιέομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρός and ποιέω; to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing):--make as though.

προσπορεύομαι.shortDef: from πρός and πορεύομαι; to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as προπορεύομαι):--go before.

προσρήγνυμι.shortDef: from πρός and ῥήγνυμι; to tear towards, i.e. burst upon (as a tempest or flood):--beat vehemently against (upon).

προστάσσω.shortDef: from πρός and τάσσω; to arrange towards, i.e. (figuratively) enjoin:--bid, command.

glosses: feminine of a derivative of προΐστημι
προστάτις.shortDef: feminine of a derivative of προΐστημι; a patroness, i.e. assistant:--succourer.

προστίθημι.shortDef: from πρός and τίθημι; to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat:--add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more.

glosses: from πρός and τρέχω (including its alternate)
προστρέχω.shortDef: from πρός and τρέχω (including its alternate); to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join:--run (thither to, to).

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of πρός and φάγω
προσφάγιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of πρός and φάγω; something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare ὀψάριον):--meat.

glosses: from πρό and a derivative of σφάζω
πρόσφατος.shortDef: from πρό and a derivative of σφάζω; previously (recently) slain (fresh), i.e. (figuratively) lately made:--new.

glosses: from πρός and φέρω (including its alternate)
προσφέρω.shortDef: from πρός and φέρω (including its alternate); to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat:--bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to.

glosses: from a presumed compound of πρός and φιλέω
προσφιλής.shortDef: from a presumed compound of πρός and φιλέω; friendly towards, i.e. acceptable:--lovely.

προσφορά.shortDef: from προσφέρω; presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice:--offering (up).

προσφωνέω.shortDef: from πρός and φωνέω; to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon:--call unto, speak (un-)to.

glosses: from a comparative of πρός and  (to pour)
πρόσχυσις.shortDef: from a comparative of πρός and  (to pour); a shedding forth, i.e. affusion:--sprinkling.

προσψαύω.shortDef: from πρός and  (to touch); to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve):--touch.

προσωποληπτέω.shortDef: from προσωπολήπτης; to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality:--have respect to persons.

προσωπολήπτης.shortDef: from πρόσωπον and λαμβάνω; an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality:--respecter of persons.

προσωποληψία.shortDef: from προσωπολήπτης; partiality, i.e. favoritism:--respect of persons.

πρόσωπον.shortDef: from πρός and  (the visage, from ὀπτάνομαι); the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person:--(outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence.

προτάσσω.shortDef: from πρό and τάσσω; to pre-arrange, i.e. prescribe:--before appoint.

προτείνω.shortDef: from πρό and  (to stretch); to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging):--bind.

glosses: neuter of πρότερος as adverb (with or without the article)
πρότερον.shortDef: neuter of πρότερος as adverb (with or without the article); previously:--before, (at the) first, former.

πρότερος.shortDef: comparative of πρό; prior or previous:--former.

glosses: middle voice from πρό and τίθημι
προτίθεμαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρό and τίθημι; to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine):--purpose, set forth.

glosses: middle voice from πρό and the base of τροπή
προτρέπομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρό and the base of τροπή; to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage:--exhort.

glosses: from πρό and τρέχω (including its alternate)
προτρέχω.shortDef: from πρό and τρέχω (including its alternate); to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede:--outrun, run before.

προϋπάρχω.shortDef: from πρό and ὑπάρχω; to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously:--+ be before(-time).

glosses: from a compound of πρό and φαίνω
πρόφασις.shortDef: from a compound of πρό and φαίνω; an outward showing, i.e. pretext:--cloke, colour, pretence, show.

προφέρω.shortDef: from πρό and φέρω; to bear forward, i.e. produce:--bring forth.

προφητεία.shortDef: from προφήτης ("prophecy"); prediction (scriptural or other):--prophecy, prophesying.

προφητεύω.shortDef: from προφήτης; to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office:--prophesy.

glosses: from a compound of πρό and φημί
προφήτης.shortDef: from a compound of πρό and φημί; a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet:--prophet.

προφητικός.shortDef: from προφήτης; pertaining to a foreteller ("prophetic"):--of prophecy, of the prophets.

προφῆτις.shortDef: feminine of προφήτης; a female foreteller or an inspired woman:--prophetess.

προφθάνω.shortDef: from πρό and φθάνω; to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate:--prevent.

glosses: middle voice from πρό and a derivative of χείρ
προχειρίζομαι.shortDef: middle voice from πρό and a derivative of χείρ; to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose:--choose, make.

προχειροτονέω.shortDef: from πρό and χειροτονέω; to elect in advance:--choose before.

πρόχορος.shortDef: from πρό and χορός; before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian:--Prochorus.

πρύμνα.shortDef: feminine of  (hindmost); the stern of a ship:--hinder part, stern.

πρωΐ.shortDef: adverb from πρό; at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch:--early (in the morning), (in the) morning.

glosses: feminine of a derivative of πρωΐ as noun
πρωΐα.shortDef: feminine of a derivative of πρωΐ as noun; day-dawn:--early, morning.

πρώϊμος.shortDef: from πρωΐ; dawning, i.e. (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season):--early.

πρωϊνός.shortDef: from πρωΐ; pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal:--morning.

glosses: feminine of a presumed derivative of πρό as noun
πρῶρα.shortDef: feminine of a presumed derivative of πρό as noun; the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel:--forepart(-ship).

πρωτεύω.shortDef: from πρῶτος; to be first (in rank or influence):--have the preeminence.

πρωτοκαθεδρία.shortDef: from πρῶτος and καθέδρα; a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council:--chief (highest, uppermost) seat.

πρωτοκλισία.shortDef: from πρῶτος and κλισία; a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e. preeminence at meals:--chief (highest, uppermost) room.

glosses: neuter of πρῶτος as adverb (with or without ὁ)
πρῶτον.shortDef: neuter of πρῶτος as adverb (with or without ὁ); firstly (in time, place, order, or importance):--before, at the beginning, chiefly (at, at the) first (of all).

πρῶτος.shortDef: contracted superlative of πρό; foremost (in time, place, order or importance):--before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former.

πρωτοστάτης.shortDef: from πρῶτος and ἵστημι; one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion):--ringleader.

glosses: from πρῶτος and the alternate of τίκτω
πρωτότοκος.shortDef: from πρῶτος and the alternate of τίκτω; first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively):--firstbegotten(-born).

πταίω.shortDef: a form of πίπτω; to trip, i.e. (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation):--fall, offend, stumble.

glosses: neuter of a presumed derivative of πτέρυξ
πτερύγιον.shortDef: neuter of a presumed derivative of πτέρυξ; a winglet, i.e. (figuratively) extremity (top corner):--pinnacle.

glosses: from a derivative of πέτομαι (meaning a feather)
πτέρυξ.shortDef: from a derivative of πέτομαι (meaning a feather); a wing:--wing.

glosses: probably akin to the alternate of πίπτω (through the idea of causing to fall) or to πέτομαι (through that of causing to fly away)
πτοέω.shortDef: probably akin to the alternate of πίπτω (through the idea of causing to fall) or to πέτομαι (through that of causing to fly away); to scare:--frighten.

πτολεμαΐς.shortDef: from  (Ptolemy, after whom it was named); Ptolemais, a place in Palestine:--Ptolemais.

πτύον.shortDef: from πτύω; a winnowing-fork (as scattering like spittle):--fan.

glosses: from a presumed derivative of πτύω (and thus akin to πτοέω)
πτύρω.shortDef: from a presumed derivative of πτύω (and thus akin to πτοέω); to frighten:--terrify.

πτύσσω.shortDef: probably akin to  (to spread; and thus apparently allied to πέτομαι through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare πατέω); to fold, i.e. furl a scroll:--close.

πτύω.shortDef: a primary verb (compare πτύσσω); to spit:--spit.

πτῶμα.shortDef: from the alternate of πίπτω; a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion):--dead body, carcase, corpse.

πτῶσις.shortDef: from the alternate of πίπτω; a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively):--fall.

πτωχεία.shortDef: from πτωχεύω; beggary, i.e. indigence (literally or figuratively):--poverty.

πτωχεύω.shortDef: from πτωχός; to be a beggar, i.e. (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively):--become poor.

πτωχός.shortDef: from  (to crouch); akin to πτοέω and the alternate of πίπτω); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas πένης properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed):--beggar(-ly), poor.

glosses: from a primary  (the fist as a weapon)
πυγμή.shortDef: from a primary  (the fist as a weapon); the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing):--oft.

glosses: from  (the name of the region where Delphi
πύθων.shortDef: from  (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located); a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying):-- divination.

πυκνός.shortDef: from the same as σκηνοποιός; clasped (thick), i.e. (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently:--often(-er).

glosses: from a derivative of the same as πυγμή
πυκτέω.shortDef: from a derivative of the same as πυγμή; to box (with the fist), i.e. contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively):--fight.

πύλη.shortDef: apparently a primary word; a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively):--gate.

πυλών.shortDef: from πύλη; a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule:--gate, porch.

glosses: middle voice prolonged from a primary  (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses)
πυνθάνομαι.shortDef: middle voice prolonged from a primary  (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to question, i.e. ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from ἐρωτάω, which properly means a request as a favor; and from αἰτέω, which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from ζητέω, which implies a search for something hidden; and from δέομαι, which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence):--ask, demand, enquire, understand.

πῦρ.shortDef: a primary word; "fire" (literally or figuratively, specially, lightning):--fiery, fire.

πύργος.shortDef: apparently a primary word ("burgh"); a tower or castle:--tower.

πυρέσσω.shortDef: from πυρά; to be on fire, i.e. (specially), to have a fever:--be sick of a fever.

πυρετός.shortDef: from πυρέσσω; inflamed, i.e. (by implication) feverish (as noun, fever):--fever.

πύρινος.shortDef: from πυρά; fiery, i.e. (by implication) flaming:--of fire.

πυρόω.shortDef: from πῦρ; to kindle, i.e. (passively) to be ignited, glow (literally), be refined (by implication), or (figuratively) to be inflamed (with anger, grief, lust):--burn, fiery, be on fire, try.

πυῤῥός.shortDef: from πῦρ; fire-like, i.e. (specially), flame- colored:--red.

πύρωσις.shortDef: from πυρόω; ignition, i.e. (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test):--burning, trial.

glosses: another form of the base of -πώς
-πω.shortDef: another form of the base of -πώς; an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the comparative. See μηδέπω, μήπω, οὐδέπω, οὔπω, πώποτε.

πωλέω.shortDef: probably ultimately from  (to be busy, to trade); to barter (as a pedlar), i.e. to sell:--sell, whatever is sold.

πῶλος.shortDef: apparently a primary word; a "foal" or "filly", i.e. (specially), a young ass:--colt.

πώποτε.shortDef: from -πω and ποτέ; at any time, i.e. (with negative particle) at no time:--at any time, + never (…to any man), + yet, never man.

πωρόω.shortDef: apparently from  (a kind of stone); to petrify, i.e. (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous):-- blind, harden.

πώρωσις.shortDef: from πωρόω; stupidity or callousness:--blindness, hardness.

glosses: adverb from the base of πού
-πώς.shortDef: adverb from the base of πού; an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner; somehow or anyhow; used only in composition:--haply, by any (some) means, perhaps. See εἴ πως, μήπως. Compare πῶς.

glosses: adverb from the base of ποῦ
πῶς.shortDef: adverb from the base of ποῦ; an interrogative particle of manner; in what way? (sometimes the question is indirect, how?); also as exclamation, how much!:--how, after (by) what manner (means), that. (Occasionally unexpressed in English).

ῥαάβ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רָחָב); Raab (i.e. Rachab), a Canaanitess:--Rahab. See also Ῥαχάβ.

glosses: of Hebrew origin (רַב with pronominal suffix)
ῥαββί.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רַב with pronominal suffix); my master, i.e Rabbi, as an official title of honor:--Master, Rabbi.

ῥαββονί.shortDef: of Chaldee origin; corresponding to ῥαββί:--Lord, Rabboni.

ῥαβδίζω.shortDef: from ῥάβδος; to strike with a stick, i.e. bastinado:--beat (with rods).

ῥάβδος.shortDef: from the base of ῥαπίζω; a stick or wand (as a cudgel, a cane or a baton of royalty):--rod, sceptre, staff.

ῥαβδοῦχος.shortDef: from ῥάβδος and ἔχω; a rod- (the Latin fasces) holder, i.e. a Roman lictor (constable or executioner):--serjeant.

ῥαγαῦ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רְעוּ); Ragau (i.e. Reu), a patriarch:--Ragau.

ῥᾳδιούργημα.shortDef: from a comparative of  (easy, i.e. reckless) and ἔργον; easy-going behavior, i.e. (by extension) a crime:--lewdness.

ῥᾳδιουργία.shortDef: from the same as ῥᾳδιούργημα; recklessness, i.e. (by extension) malignity:--mischief.

ῥακά.shortDef: of Chaldee origin (compare רֵיק); O empty one, i.e. thou worthless (as a term of utter vilification):--Raca.

ῥάκος.shortDef: from ῥήγνυμι; a "rag," i.e. piece of cloth:--cloth.

ῥαμᾶ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רָמָה); Rama (i.e. Ramah), a place in Palestine:--Rama.

ῥαντίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of  (to sprinkle); to render besprinkled, i.e. asperse (ceremonially or figuratively):-- sprinkle.

glosses: from a derivative of a primary  (to let fall
ῥαπίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of a primary  (to let fall, "rap"); to slap:--smite (with the palm of the hand). Compare τύπτω.

ῥάπισμα.shortDef: from ῥαπίζω; a slap:--(+ strike with the) palm of the hand, smite with the hand.

ῥαφίς.shortDef: from a primary  (to sew; perhaps rather akin to the base of ῥαπίζω through the idea of puncturing); a needle:-- needle.

ῥαχάβ.shortDef: from the same as Ῥαάβ; Rachab, a Canaanitess:--Rachab.

ῥαχήλ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רָחֵל); Rachel, the wife of Jacob:--Rachel.

ῥεβέκκα.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רִבְקָה); Rebecca (i.e. Ribkah), the wife of Isaac:--Rebecca.

ῥέδα.shortDef: of Latin origin; a rheda, i.e. four-wheeled carriage (wagon for riding):--chariot.

glosses: by incorrect transliteration for a word of Hebrew origin (כִּיּוּן)
ῥεμφάν.shortDef: by incorrect transliteration for a word of Hebrew origin (כִּיּוּן); Remphan (i.e. Kijun), an Egyptian idol:--Remphan.

glosses: ἔπωperhaps akin (or identical) with ῥέω (through the idea of pouring forth)
ῥέω.shortDef: ἔπωperhaps akin (or identical) with ῥέω (through the idea of pouring forth); to utter, i.e. speak or say:--command, make, say, speak (of). Compare λέγω.

ῥήγιον.shortDef: of Latin origin; Rhegium, a place in Italy:--Rhegium.

ῥῆγμα.shortDef: from ῥήγνυμι; something torn, i.e. a fragment (by implication and abstractly, a fall):--ruin.

glosses: both prolonged forms of  (which appears only in certain forms
ῥήγνυμι.shortDef: both prolonged forms of  (which appears only in certain forms, and is itself probably a strengthened form of agnumi (see in κατάγνυμι)); to "break," "wreck" or "crack", i.e. (especially) to sunder (by separation of the parts; κατάγνυμι being its intensive (with the preposition in composition), and θραύω a shattering to minute fragments; but not a reduction to the constituent particles, like λύω) or disrupt, lacerate; by implication, to convulse (with spasms); figuratively, to give vent to joyful emotions:--break (forth), burst, rend, tear.

ῥῆμα.shortDef: from ῥέω; an utterance (individually, collectively or specially),; by implication, a matter or topic (especially of narration, command or dispute); with a negative naught whatever:--+ evil, + nothing, saying, word.

glosses: probably of Hebrew origin (apparently for רְפָיָה)
ῥησά.shortDef: probably of Hebrew origin (apparently for רְפָיָה); Resa (i.e. Rephajah), an Israelite:--Rhesa.

ῥήτωρ.shortDef: from ῥέω; a speaker, i.e. (by implication) a forensic advocate:--orator.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of ῥέω
ῥητῶς.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of ῥέω; out-spokenly, i.e. distinctly:--expressly.

ῥίζα.shortDef: apparently a primary word; a "root" (literally or figuratively):--root.

ῥιζόω.shortDef: from ῥίζα; to root (figuratively, become stable):--root.

ῥιπή.shortDef: from ῥίπτω; a jerk (of the eye, i.e. (by analogy) an instant):--twinkling.

glosses: from a derivative of ῥίπτω (meaning a fan or bellows)
ῥιπίζω.shortDef: from a derivative of ῥίπτω (meaning a fan or bellows); to breeze up, i.e. (by analogy) to agitate (into waves):--toss.

ῥιπτέω.shortDef: from a derivative of ῥίπτω; to toss up:--cast off.

glosses: a primary verb (perhaps rather akin to the base of ῥαπίζω
ῥίπτω.shortDef: a primary verb (perhaps rather akin to the base of ῥαπίζω, through the idea of sudden motion); to fling (properly, with a quick toss, thus differing from βάλλω, which denotes a deliberate hurl; and from  (see in ἐκτείνω), which indicates an extended projection); by qualification, to deposit (as if a load); by extension, to disperse:--cast (down, out), scatter abroad, throw.

ῥοβοάμ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רְחַבְעָם); Roboam (i.e. Rechobam), an Israelite:--Roboam.

ῥόδη.shortDef: probably for rhode (a rose); Rode, a servant girl:--Rhoda.

ῥόδος.shortDef: probably from  (a rose); Rhodus, an island of the Mediterranean:--Rhodes.

glosses: adverb from a derivative of  (a whir)
ῥοιζηδόν.shortDef: adverb from a derivative of  (a whir); whizzingly, i.e. with a crash:--with a great noise.

ῥομφαία.shortDef: probably of foreign origin; a sabre, i.e. a long and broad cutlass (any weapon of the kind, literally or figuratively):--sword.

ῥουβήν.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רְאוּבֵן); Ruben (i.e. Reuben), an Israelite:--Reuben.

ῥούθ.shortDef: of Hebrew origin (רוּת); Ruth, a Moabitess:--Ruth.

ῥοῦφος.shortDef: of Latin origin; red; Rufus, a Christian:--Rufus.

glosses: prolongation from ῥύομαι in its original sense
ῥύμη.shortDef: prolongation from ῥύομαι in its original sense; an alley or avenue (as crowded):--lane, street.

glosses: middle voice of an obsolete verb
ῥύομαι.shortDef: middle voice of an obsolete verb, akin to ῥέω (through the idea of a current; compare ῥύσις); to rush or draw (for oneself), i.e. rescue:--deliver(-er).

ῥυπαρός.shortDef: from ῥύπος; dirty, i.e. (relatively) cheap or shabby; morally, wicked:--vile.

ῥύπος.shortDef: of uncertain affinity; dirt, i.e. (morally) depravity:--filth.

ῥυπόω.shortDef: from ῥύπος; to soil, i.e. (intransitively) to become dirty (morally):--be filthy.

glosses: from ῥύομαι in the sense of its congener ῥέω
ῥύσις.shortDef: from ῥύομαι in the sense of its congener ῥέω; a flux (of blood):--issue.

ῥυτίς.shortDef: from ῥύομαι; a fold (as drawing together), i.e. a wrinkle (especially on the face):--wrinkle.

ῥωμαῖος.shortDef: from Ῥώμη; Romæan, i.e. Roman (as noun):--Roman, of Rome.

glosses: adverb from a presumed derivative of Ῥώμη
ῥωμαϊστί.shortDef: adverb from a presumed derivative of Ῥώμη; Romaistically, i.e. in the Latin language:--Latin.

ῥώμη.shortDef: from the base of ῥώννυμι; strength; Roma, the capital of Italy:--Rome.

ῥώννυμι.shortDef: prolongation from  (to dart; probably akin to ῥύομαι); to strengthen, i.e. (impersonal passive) have health (as a parting exclamation, good-bye):--farewell.

glosses: of Chaldee or (שְׁבַק with pronominal suffix)
σαβαχθάνι.shortDef: of Chaldee or (שְׁבַק with pronominal suffix); thou hast left me; sabachthani (i.e. shebakthani), a cry of distress:--sabachthani.

glosses: of Hebrew origin (צָבָא in feminine plural)
